2993874.h: Anderson (knee) has been ruled out for Saturday's preseason game against the Heat, Josh Lewenberg of TSN.ca reports.
2993874.s: Anderson will miss the Raptors' preseason opener after sitting out Thursday's scrimmage with a right knee contusion. His next opportunity to suit up in the preseason will come next Saturday against the Clippers.

2995706.h: Head coach Kenny Atkinson said Friday that Hezonja is "going to be in the mix" for a spot in Cleveland's rotation to begin the 2026-27 campaign, Chris Fedor of Cleveland.com reports.
2995706.s: The Cavaliers essentially have four of their starting five confirmed, and Peyton Watson (hamstring) appears likely to slot into that fifth spot. However, training camp will be important in determining who else fills out the rotation. Hezonja, the fifth overall pick in 2015, hasn't played in the NBA since the 2019-20 season but has plenty of experience overseas. The Cavaliers boast a deep roster heading into training…

2995706.h: Cleveland's acquisition of Peyton Watson adds another versatile forward to a frontcourt that already has plenty of competition for Hezonja and others.
2995706.s: Watson is coming off a breakout season in which he averaged 14.6 points and 4.9 rebounds while shooting 41.1 percent from three across 54 regular-season outings, and his new four-year, $88 million contract indicates he'll command a substantial role. Hezonja's path to consistent playing time consequently becomes more complicated, leaving him with limited fantasy appeal unless injuries thin Cleveland's rotation.

2995706.h: Hezonja agreed to a one-year, $2.8 million contract with the Cavaliers on Sunday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
2995706.s: Hezonja is set to return to the NBA for the first time since the 2019-20 campaign after spending the past six seasons overseas. The 2015 first-round pick earned 2025-26 Liga ACB MVP honors after a standout season with Real Madrid. In his return stateside, the 31-year-old is likely to serve as forward depth off the bench for the Cavaliers and could see his role increase if his scoring ability from Europe translates…

3032976.h: Gobert (back) is not listed on the injury report for Monday's game against Milwaukee.
3032976.s: Gobert didn't play in Saturday's 121-111 loss to the Spurs due to a back issue. However, he will be back on the floor Monday versus the Kings. With Gobert available, Joan Beringer, who started against San Antonio, is projected to head back to the bench.

3032976.h: Gobert (back) is out for Saturday's game against the Spurs, Dane Moore of 'The Dane Moore NBA Podcast' reports.
3032976.s: Gobert will miss his first game of the season Saturday, which could result in Joan Beringer getting the start. Trey Lyles could also see a bump in minutes. For now, Gobert should be considered questionable for Monday's meeting with Milwaukee.

3032976.h: Gobert (back) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game at San Antonio.
3032976.s: Gobert is a late addition to the injury report, so his status will be worth monitoring ahead of Saturday's 8:00 p.m. ET tipoff. Joan Beringer would likely be the top candidate to enter the Timberwolves' starting lineup if Gobert is not cleared to play in the second leg of the team's back-to-back set.

3032976.h: Gobert (rest) is expected to be available for Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Heat.
3032976.s: Gobert was one of many Timberwolves regulars who sat out the preseason finale, though the big man should be available Wednesday. He averaged 5.8 points, 5.8 rebounds and 1.5 assists in 19.9 minutes per game across four appearances this preseason.

3032976.h: Gobert (rest) won't play in Friday's preseason finale against the Bulls, Chuck Swirsky of the Bulls Radio Network reports.
3032976.s: Gobert, Anthony Edwards, LaMelo Ball and Ayo Dosunmu are all resting for the final exhibition. Gobert should be good to go for Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Heat.

3032977.h: Antetokounmpo (wrist) is available for Tuesday's game against Utah.
3032977.s: Antetokounmpo was initially listed as probable, though there was added concern regarding his availability after he was downgraded to questionable late Tuesday. However, the multi-time All-Star is good to go, avoiding his first absence of the 2026-27 campaign.

3032977.h: Antetokounmpo (wrist) is questionable for Tuesday's game against the Jazz.
3032977.s: Antetokounmpo was tagged as probable to play Tuesday, but he's now being downgraded to questionable versus Utah due to a right wrist sprain. If he can't play, Bam Adebayo, Davion Mitchell and Klay Thompson will carry the offensive burden for Miami, with Bobby Portis and Andrew Wiggins getting…

3032977.h: Antetokounmpo is probable for Tuesday's game against the Jazz due to a right wrist sprain.
3032977.s: Antetokounmpo has found his way onto the injury report over Miami's last few matchups due to a wrist issue, but he's yet to miss any time. That trend looks like it will continue Tuesday in Utah.

3032977.h: Antetokounmpo (wrist) is available for Thursday's game against the Warriors, Anthony Chiang of the Miami Herald reports.
3032977.s: With Miami on the second night of a back-to-back, Antetokounmpo's availability removes any immediate concern about the wrist issue affecting his status Thursday. The star forward should remain in his usual role, though it's worth noting his wrist was heavily taped Wednesday against the Clippers, per Chiang.

3032977.h: Antetokounmpo (wrist) is available for Wednesday's game against the Clippers.
3032977.s: As expected, Antetokounmpo will shed his probable tag due to a right wrist sprain, keeping his record of perfect attendance this season alive. The superstar forward has posted two double-doubles and two triple-doubles over the last four games, averaging 28.5 points, 15.5 rebounds, 7.8 assists and 1.8 combined steals-plus-blocks over 33.8 minutes per game during that span.

3032979.h: Schroder has been diagnosed with a left hamstring strain and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.
3032979.s: Schroder, who missed Friday's game due to what was described as a left thigh injury, has been diagnosed with a hamstring strain. He is set to be re-evaluated in two weeks, suggesting he will miss at least the next five games. Christian Anderson and Sion James could see extra minutes with Schroder sidelined.

3032979.h: Schroder (thigh) is out for Friday's game versus Boston.
3032979.s: Schroder is sitting out Friday for the first time this season due to left thigh soreness. With the veteran floor general sidelined, Coby White should see his minutes climb into the 20s for the first time this year as he works back from a preseason calf strain.

3032979.h: Schroder (thigh) is questionable for Friday's game against the Celtics.
3032979.s: The veteran floor general is at risk of missing his first game of the year Friday. Working back from a preseason calf strain, Coby White could be thrust into a larger role if Schroder is unable to play.

3032979.h: Schroder will come off the bench for Monday's game against Detroit.
3032979.s: Schroder will retreat to the bench due to Coby White returning and set to start Monday. White will be on a minutes restriction, so it wouldn't be a surprise to see Schroder receive a good chunk of playing time as the backup point guard.

3032979.h: Schroder (foot) is available for Friday's game against the Wizards.
3032979.s: After beginning the day with a questionable designation, Schroder was upgraded to probable Friday morning and is now fully cleared to suit up. The journeyman floor general has been serviceable filling in for the injured Coby White (calf) at point guard, averaging 14.0 points, 4.6 assists, 4.0 rebounds and 1.0 three-pointers in 32.4 minutes per game over five appearances thus far.

3037789.h: Bogdanovic provided no counting stats across five minutes during Wednesday's 117-107 loss to the Timberwolves.
3037789.s: Bogdanovic has seen his role evaporate in recent times, to the point where he is barely seeing the floor. In four games over the past week, he has averaged just 2.5 points in 10.0 minutes per contest, barely making him a top-400 asset. At this point, he would require a number of injuries to players ahead of him in the rotation to have any shot at putting up fantasy value.

3059318.h: Embiid (foot) is available for Sunday's game against the Bulls.
3059318.s: Embiid will avoid his third absence of the 2026-27 campaign. The 32-year-old hasn't played up to his usual standards in his eight regular-season appearances, averaging a career-low 17.9 points over 32.4 minutes per contest while shooting a miserable 10.7 percent from behind the arc.

3059318.h: Embiid (foot) is probable for Sunday's game against the Bulls.
3059318.s: Embiid continues to work through plantar fasciitis in his right foot. Philadelphia has kept their star center on an injury management routine, and with Embiid being listed as probable to suit up versus Chicago, he's likely to be active and reprise his starting role for the 8-2 76ers.

3059318.h: Embiid (foot) is available for Monday's game against the Bulls, Austin Krell of OnPattison.com reports.
3059318.s: Embiid will shake off his questionable tag and return from a one-game absence due to right foot plantar fascia injury management. The star big man's return will leave fewer minutes available for the likes of Adem Bona and Jabari Walker. Embiid has reached the 20-point threshold in three of his five regular-season outings, averaging 19.2 points, 9.4 rebounds, 5.2 assists and 1.8 combined steals-plus-blocks in 35.2…

3059318.h: Embiid (foot) is questionable for Monday's game against the Bulls.
3059318.s: Embiid missed Saturday's 109-104 win over Charlotte due to right foot plantar fascia injury management, and he's now in jeopardy of missing a second consecutive game for the same reason. If he's unable to play Monday, Adem Bona will likely earn another start, with Jabari Walker getting additional minutes off the bench.

3059318.h: Embiid (foot) is out for Saturday's game in Charlotte.
3059318.s: It's the second night of a back-to-back set, so Embiid will get hit with a maintenance day. Adem Bona will have the opportunity to start Saturday with Embiid inactive.

3059319.h: Wiggins will come off the bench during Sunday's game against the Kings, Zachary Weinberger of ClutchPoints.com reports.
3059319.s: Wiggins will shift to a reserve role for just the 13th time in his regular-season career and the first time as a member of the Heat. He has averaged just 4.0 points, 3.3 rebounds and 2.3 assists in 22.7 minutes per game over his last three appearances.

3059319.h: Wiggins (rest) is in line to play in Wednesday's preseason game against the Nets, Will Manso of Local 10 Miami reports.
3059319.s: The Heat plan to give the majority of their starters some playing time Wednesday. Wiggins figures to see some action in the first half.

3059319.h: Wiggins (rest) won't play in Saturday's preseason game against the Timberwolves, Eric Nehm of The Athletic reports.
3059319.s: Wiggins will skip Saturday's exhibition for maintenance reasons, but he should return for Wednesday's preseason game against Brooklyn. Wiggins' absence should open up minutes for Myron Gardner and Simone Fontecchio.

3059319.h: Wiggins (illness) is available for Thursday's preseason game against New Orleans, Anthony Chiang of the Miami Herald reports.
3059319.s: Wiggins has overcome an illness that bothered him earlier this week and cost him some practice time. His status for the start of the regular season is not in question.

3059319.h: Wiggins is dealing with an illness, per Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel.
3059319.s: Wiggins was limited at practice Wednesday and sat out Tuesday's scrimmage, per Eric Nehm of The Athletic. His status is in question for Thursday's preseason game against the Pelicans, but Wiggins isn't in jeopardy of missing regular-season action.

3062679.h: Hart (illness) won't play Tuesday against the Bucks, Kristian Winfield of the New York Daily News reports.
3062679.s: Hart is sick in addition to dealing with a sore right ankle, so he'll skip Tuesday's game, which will be the first of a back-to-back set. Landry Shamet should continue to start in Hart's absence, and Jordan Clarkson will have the chance for some extra minutes.

3062679.h: Hart is doubtful for Tuesday's game against the Bucks due to an illness.
3062679.s: Hart is in line to miss a third straight contest, but it appears he's moved past ankle soreness that previously bothered him. Until Hart is ready to return to the court, Landry Shamet will likely continue to start for the Knicks.

3062679.h: Hart is questionable for Tuesday's game against the Bucks due to right ankle soreness.
3062679.s: Hart is aiming to avoid missing a third straight contest with the issue. Once Hart is ready to return to the court, Landry Shamet will likely revert back to his typical role off the bench. Hart is also dealing with an illness.

3062679.h: Hart is out for Saturday's game against the Cavaliers due to right ankle soreness.
3062679.s: Hart practiced Friday, per Steve Popper of Newsday, but he's getting a bit more time to recover. Landry Shamet should draw a second consecutive start for the Knicks on Saturday.

3062679.h: Hart is out for Wednesday's game against the Bulls due to right ankle soreness.
3062679.s: Hart is sitting out for the first time this season, though he doesn't seem to be battling a significant issue. With Hart sidelined, fantasy managers can expect either Landry Shamet or Miles McBride to step into the starting lineup for the Knicks on Wednesday.

3064290.h: Gordon (calf) is available to play Monday's game against Houston.
3064290.s: Gordon was questionable to play versus the Rockets due to left calf injury management, but he's good to suit up and reprise his role in Denver's starting unit.

3064290.s: Gordon appears likely to play despite ongoing management of his left calf injury. His expected presence should bolster Denver's frontcourt rotation, particularly with Julian Strawther (knee) sidelined. Gordon's combination of scoring, rebounding and defensive contributions makes him a useful fantasy option when healthy, though his workload will be worth monitoring.

3064290.h: Gordon (lower body injury management) is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Rockets.
3064290.s: Along with Nikola Jokic (elbow), Jamal Murray (shin), Christian Braun (calf/illness), Cameron Johnson (lower body) and DeMar DeRozan (back), Gordon is questionable to play Monday. If the veteran forward is unable to go, Trevon Brazile, Spencer Jones and Alpha Diallo would be candidates for increased playing time.

3064290.h: Gordon (rest) is expected to play in Thursday's regular-season opener against the Thunder.
3064290.s: Gordon sat out Friday's preseason finale but should return to the lineup in Oklahoma City on Thursday. The veteran forward is coming off an injury-plagued 2025-26 season in which he appeared in only 36 regular-season games (33 starts), averaging 16.2 points, 5.8 rebounds and 2.7 assists in 27.9 minutes per showing.

3064290.h: Gordon (rest) won't play in Friday's preseason finale against the Lakers, Jovan Buha of The Athletic reports.
3064290.s: Gordon is being held out of Denver's final preseason game for maintenance purposes, but he should be fine for Thursday's regular-season opener in Oklahoma City. Trevon Brazile will start in Gordon's place Friday evening.

3064440.h: LaVine (elbow) is available for Monday's game against the Mavericks, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.
3064440.s: LaVine will shed the questionable tag ahead of Sacramento's matchup with Dallas. He is dealing with soreness in his right elbow after playing a season-low 21 minutes during Saturday's 136-105 loss to Memphis, but he'll fight through the issue and reprise his starting role for the 0-6 Kings.

3064440.h: LaVine (elbow) is questionable to play in Monday's game against Dallas.
3064440.s: LaVine played a season-low 21 minutes during Saturday's 136-105 loss to Memphis, but it's unclear if that was due to the elbow soreness or the game being out of reach for the Kings. Either way, his status will bear monitoring ahead of Monday's clash with the Mavericks. If he's unable to play, Darius Acuff Jr.'s usage would skyrocket, while Malik Monk, Emanuel Sharp and Nique Clifford could all see increased…

3064482.h: Portis won't start Wednesday's game against the Timberwolves, Zachary Weinberger of ClutchPoints.com reports.
3064482.s: Portis drew the start in Friday's preseason finale but will return to the second unit Wednesday. The veteran big man is expected to play a sizable role off the Heat's bench this season.

3064482.h: Portis will start Friday's preseason finale against Orlando, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.
3064482.s: With Giannis Antetokounmpo (rest) and Bam Adebayo (groin) sidelined, Portis will enter the starting five. He's expected to operate as one of the Heat's first men off the bench in the regular season.

3064514.h: Randle is expected to make his Nets debut in Tuesday's preseason opener against the Hornets, C.J. Holmes of the New York Daily News reports.
3064514.s: Randle has been a full participant throughout training camp and will get his first opportunity to play alongside his new teammates Tuesday. Coach Jordi Fernandez has experimented with using Randle in several ways offensively, including as a ballhandler, in dribble handoffs and as a playmaker out of the short roll.

3064560.h: Kornet (rest) is available for Friday's preseason game against the Kings, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.
3064560.s: Kornet will play in the Spurs' preseason finale after getting the night off Wednesday. After averaging 6.5 points, 6.1 rebounds, 1.8 assists and 1.0 blocks in 21.0 minutes per contest over 68 regular-season appearances (25 starts) in 2025-26, the big man is once again expected to operate as Victor Wembanyama's primary backup.

3064560.h: Kornet (rest) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against the Suns, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.
3064560.s: Kornet has appeared in all three of the Spurs' preseason games. As a result, he will take the night off Wednesday, with his final opportunity to suit up before the start of the 2026-27 campaign coming Friday versus Sacramento.

3064560.h: Kornet is in the starting lineup for Monday's exhibition in Utah, Tom Orsborn of the San Antonio Express-News reports.
3064560.s: Victor Wembanyama (rest) is sitting this one out, so Kornet will get some time to shine in the first unit. Over 25 starts during the 2025-26 regular season, Kornet averaged 7.8 points, 6.5 rebounds, 2.2 assists and 1.4 blocks per contest.

3078576.h: White (hip) is available for Tuesday's game against the Nets, Bobby Krivitsky of Forbes.com reports.
3078576.s: As expected, the star guard is shedding a probable designation that was caused by a right hip issue. Although it's the second half of a back-to-back, White should be able to handle a normal workload as long as Tuesday's contest remains competitive.

3078576.h: White (right hip) is probable for Tuesday's game against the Nets.
3078576.s: White is a little banged up from Monday's game against the Bulls in which he turned the ball over six times in 18 minutes. However, the veteran guard intends to play through the issue for the second leg of this back-to-back set.

3078576.h: White (rest) is expected to play in Tuesday's game against Detroit.
3078576.s: White didn't suit up for Friday's 125-120 preseason overtime win over the 76ers to rest but is expected to play versus the Pistons. The 32-year-old averaged a career-best 16.5 points along with 4.4 rebounds, 5.4 assists, 1.3 blocks and 1.1 steals over 34.1 minutes in 77 regular-season games in 2025-26. White did have some trouble finding the net, especially from deep, though he reportedly worked on his shot during…

3078576.h: White will not play in Friday's preseason finale against the 76ers, Sean Grande of NBC Sports Boston reports.
3078576.s: Most of Boston's regulars are getting the night off. White is expected to be in action for Tuesday's regular-season opener against the Pistons.

3078576.h: White (rest) is in the Celtics' starting lineup against the 76ers on Saturday, Sean Grande of NBC Sports Boston reports.
3078576.s: White and other prominent Celtics players like Jayson Tatum (rest) and Paul George (rest) will be on the floor for Saturday's exhibition contest. It'll be White's first preseason game as he gears up for Boston's regular-season opener against Detroit on Tuesday, Oct. 20.

3102529.h: Head coach Ime Udoka stated Monday that Capela (ankle) could be cleared to return either Nov. 15 in Washington or Nov. 16 in Miami, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.
3102529.s: Capela is missing a fourth straight game Monday against Denver due to a right ankle sprain, but he appears to be trending in the right direction. He'll presumably need to log 5-on-5 work before gaining clearance to play, though the Rockets haven't disclosed how far along the big man is in his rehab.

3102529.h: Capela (ankle) is listed as out for Monday's game against Denver.
3102529.s: Capela will miss his fourth consecutive game Monday, meaning his next opportunity to return will come Wednesday versus Golden State. With Steven Adams (calf) also sidelined, Jabari Smith will likely continue to spend more time at the five behind Alperen Sengun. Oscar Tshiebwe may also see a few extra minutes of work.

3102529.h: Capela (ankle) is out for Saturday's game against the Suns.
3102529.s: The veteran big man is managing a sprained right ankle, which is costing him a third consecutive contest. His next chance to return arrives Monday, when the Rockets host the Nuggets.

3102529.h: Capela (ankle) is out for Wednesday's game against the Timberwolves.
3102529.s: The veteran big man is nursing a sprained right ankle, which is costing him a second consecutive contest. His next chance to return arrives Saturday, when the Rockets visit the Suns in Phoenix.

3102529.h: Capela (ankle) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game against the Timberwolves.
3102529.s: Capela is in danger of missing his second consecutive contest and third overall of the 2026-27 campaign. With Steven Adams (calf) sidelined, Jabari Smith may spend more time in the middle behind Alperen Sengun. Oscar Tshiebwe might also see a few minutes off the bench.

3102530.h: Nurkic (toe) has begun participating in on-court activities as he continues recovering from a right foot injury sustained during an Oct. 4 preseason game against Denver. He will be re-evaluated in two weeks, the Jazz announced Friday.
3102530.s: Nurkic is progressing in his recovery, but the two-week re-evaluation timeline indicates he remains some distance from returning to game action. His absence should continue to create opportunities in Utah's frontcourt, with Jaxson Hayes and Mo Bamba among the players positioned to benefit from additional playing time. Nurkic's next evaluation will provide a clearer picture of his potential return date.

3102530.h: Nurkic (foot) is out for Wednesday's game against the Pelicans.
3102530.s: Nurkic has been a spectator to begin the season, and he's still not ready for game action due to a foot injury. The veteran big man should be considered week-to-week until the Jazz update his recovery, so Jaxson Hayes is expected to remain the team's primary center going forward.

3102530.h: Nurkic will miss at least the next four weeks due to a partial plantar plate tear of the second toe on his right foot, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.
3102530.s: Nurkic will begin the 2026-27 season on the sidelines, and given the tricky nature of foot injuries for big men, it wouldn't be shocking to see his absence extend beyond this initial four-week window. Jaren Jackson will likely spend more time at center while Nurkic is out, and there will be more minutes available for Jaxson Hayes and Mo Bamba.

3102530.h: Nurkic (foot) is listed as out for Tuesday's preseason game against Denver.
3102530.s: Nurkic is dealing with a foot issue, so he will miss Utah's second preseason game on the schedule. With Kyle Filipowski (back) also sidelined, Jaxson Hayes, Mo Bamba and Jonas Aidoo should handle the bulk of the minutes at the center position.

3102530.h: Nurkic didn't participate in Monday's practice due to a right foot injury, Shreyas Laddha of The Salt Lake Tribune reports.
3102530.s: Nurkic logged 11 minutes in Sunday's preseason-opening win over Denver, posting four points (1-5 FG, 2-2 FT, 0-2 3Pt), five rebounds, four assists, one steal and one block. The big man can be considered questionable for Tuesday's preseason rematch against Denver until the Jazz offer an update on his status.

3102531.h: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.
3102531.s: Porzingis said he was looking forward to joining the Warriors, but his body didn't respond the way he wanted it too during his ramp-up process before the season. Additionally, he said he will work with the Warriors on a solution that "makes sense." Porzingis is making this decision to prioritize his health and will hopefully turn a corner soon on that front.

3102531.h: The Warriors have stopped issuing salary payments to Porzingis (illness), who remains away from the team and is considering retirement, Anthony Slater and Shams Charania of ESPN reported Wednesday.
3102531.s: Porzingis has not returned to the Warriors' facility since leaving in October, and his absence is no longer considered excused by the organization. Golden State continues to explore trading the 31-year-old center's contract ahead of the Feb. 11 deadline rather than voiding his deal. With Porzingis reportedly leaning toward retirement and no timetable for his return, he remains an extremely risky fantasy investment,…

3102531.h: The Warriors are exploring potential trades involving Porzingis (personal/illness), who remains away from the team indefinitely while dealing with ongoing health concerns, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports.
3102531.s: Porzingis is reportedly contemplating his future in basketball as he continues to battle health issues that have plagued him for nearly two years. Golden State isn't expecting the veteran center to rejoin the team anytime soon, and his contract structure could make him an attractive trade piece despite the uncertainty surrounding his playing future. With no timetable for his return and retirement potentially on the…

3102531.h: Porzingis is contemplating his future in basketball as he deals with recurring symptoms from the autoimmune condition termed as postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
3102531.s: Charania also notes Golden State has started exploring trade routes for Porzingis, who is already considered out indefinitely to begin the 2026-27 season. Fantasy managers shouldn't expect the big man to get back on the floor anytime soon, whether it be for the Warriors or perhaps another team, and it sounds like stepping away from the game is on the table for Porzingis at this point.

3102531.h: Porzingis (undisclosed) won't travel with the Warriors and remains out indefinitely, Luca Evans of the San Francisco Chronicle reports.
3102531.s: Porzingis is going to miss the start of the regular season, and fantasy managers should treat his return as an if, not a when. The Warriors have not released any additional info on Porzingis' absence, saying it's an undisclosed health issue. Given Porzingis' medical history, both sides are going to proceed with the utmost caution.

3112335.h: Jokic (elbow) will play Monday against Houston.
3112335.s: As anticipated, Jokic has been cleared to play Monday after being upgraded to probable earlier in the day. He's yet to miss a game this year and is averaging 22.9 points, 10.1 rebounds, 9.1 assists, 2.0 steals and 1.1 blocks over eight appearances.

3112335.h: Jokic (elbow) has been upgraded to probable for Monday's game against the Rockets.
3112335.s: The probable designation suggests Jokic is on track to play despite the elbow issue. His expected availability is a significant boost for Denver's offense, as the three-time MVP remains the team's primary facilitator and offensive centerpiece. Barring a setback, fantasy managers should anticipate his usual substantial workload.

3112335.h: Jokic (elbow) is listed as questionable for Monday's game in Houston.
3112335.s: Jokic nearly had a triple-double in Saturday's 114-102 win over the Pacers. However, he's now in danger of missing his first game of the 2026-27 season due to a right elbow sprain. If Jokic isn't available to suit up, Marvin Bagley would presumably take his place in the starting lineup.

3133603.h: Oubre (calf) will be available for Saturday's game against the Nuggets, Dustin Dopirak of The Indianapolis Star reports.
3133603.s: Oubre's string of absences will end after two games now that he's recovered from a left calf contusion. His return could spell decreased opportunities for Jarace Walker and Obi Toppin.

3133603.h: Oubre (calf) is questionable for Saturday's game against Denver.
3133603.s: Oubre is trying to end a two-game absence Saturday due to a calf contusion. Less playing time would be open to Jarace Walker and Obi Toppin if Oubre is able to return.

3133603.h: Oubre (calf) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Grizzlies.
3133603.s: Oubre missed Indiana's last game with a bruised left knee and will miss a second straight game due to a left calf contusion. His next chance to play will come Saturday against Denver. In the meantime, Quenton Jackson and Jarace Walker will likely see increased playing time.

3133603.h: Oubre (knee) is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Grizzlies.
3133603.s: Oubre is trying to move past a knee contusion Wednesday. Less playing time would be available for Jarace Walker if Oubre is healthy enough to play.

3133603.h: Oubre (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Hawks.
3133603.s: Oubre is dealing with a bruised left knee and will sit out the second leg of this back-to-back set. The Pacers will be extremely shorthanded Monday, opening the door for Quenton Jackson and Jarace Walker to take on significant workloads.

3133626.h: Williams will start Monday's game against Phoenix, Brandon Rahbar of DailyThunder.com reports.
3133626.s: Chet Holmgren (knee) won't play in the second leg of this back-to-back set, joining Jalen Williams (leg) and Cason Wallace (shoulder) on the inactive list. As a result, Williams will join the starting five for the first time since Feb. 12.

3133626.h: Williams (rest) won't play in Monday's preseason game against the Hawks, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

3133628.s: Turner was one of several key Bucks players who sat out Wednesday's loss to the Bulls, but he's been given the green light to return in Milwaukee's preseason finale. 3133628.s: Turner started in all three of Milwaukee's preseason games thus far, averaging 10.3 points, 4.0 rebounds, 1.0 steals and 2.7 blocks over 21.7 minutes per contest. 3133635.h: Carter (coach's decision) did not play in Wednesday's 132-125 loss to Atlanta.
3133635.s: Carter wasn't called upon in Orlando's season opener, suggesting he'll primarily serve as backcourt depth. The veteran guard will likely need an injury or a rotation adjustment to receive consistent playing time.

3134903.h: Payton (knee) is out for Wednesday's game against Houston.
3134903.s: Payton is sidelined for a second consecutive contest with knee inflammation. Will Richard (thumb) could slot into Payton's spot in the backcourt rotation Wednesday.

3134903.s: Payton was questionable to suit up due to a right calf injury, but he will indeed be active and handle his typical role off the Warriors' bench. He's averaging 5.1 points, 1.8 rebounds and 0.7 steals in 13.4 minutes across nine outings in 2026-27.

3134903.s: We'll have a better idea on Payton's status based on his activity level at Saturday's shootaround, but if he's forced to the sidelines, that would open up some minutes for Brandon Williams and De'Anthony Melton. LJ Cryer would also have the opportunity to get into the rotation sans Payton.

3134907.h: Kuzma (rest) will play in Friday's preseason game against Indiana.
3134907.s: Kuzma was one of multiple Bucks regulars who were held out of Wednesday's loss to Chicago, though he's set to return to action in Milwaukee's preseason finale. The veteran forward started 43 of his 69 regular-season appearances last season, averaging 13.0 points, 4.5 rebounds and 2.7 assists in 26.2 minutes per contest. He figures to continue seeing meaningful playing time in 2026-27.

3134907.h: Kuzma (rest) won't play Wednesday against the Bulls, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.
3134907.s: Kuzma is joining a number of Milwaukee regulars on the sidelines for this exhibition. Friday's matchup with the Pacers is his next chance to play.

3134907.h: Kuzma will start Sunday's preseason game against the Hornets, Sam Perley of the Hornets' official site reports.
3134907.s: Kuzma shifted to a reserve role for Wednesday's preseason game against the Thunder, but he will return to the starting five Sunday. Kel'el Ware, who took his starting spot versus Oklahoma City, will shift back to the bench.

3134907.h: Kuzma won't start Wednesday's preseason game against the Thunder.
3134907.s: The Bucks will try out their double-big lineup Wednesday, with Kel'el Ware entering the starting five in Kuzma's place. 3134908.h: Poeltl (shoulder) is available to play in Friday's game versus Milwaukee.
3134908.s: Poeltl has been battling left shoulder bursitis. Despite recently missing two games because of the issue, it won't keep him off the floor against the Bucks. 3134908.s: Poeltl is still a little banged up for Toronto, but he intends to push through it. On Wednesday against Denver, he played 19 minutes off the bench with eight points, five rebounds and one assist.

3134908.s: Poeltl is available off the bench following a two-game absence due to left shoulder bursitis. Collin Murray-Boyles will get the starting nod at center.

3134908.s: Poeltl missed the Raptors' last two games due to left shoulder bursitis, though he'll shed his questionable tag and suit up for Wednesday's meeting. With the big man back in the mix, fewer minutes will be available for Collin Murray-Boyles and Trayce Jackson-Davis.

3134908.h: Poeltl is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Nuggets due to left shoulder bursitis, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports.
3134908.s: Poeltl is looking to avoid a third straight absence due to the issue. If the veteran big man is unable to give it a go Wednesday, Collin Murray-Boyles should take on the lion's share of the center minutes for the Raptors.

3135045.h: Allen will start in Friday's game against the Celtics
3135045.s: With Kon Knueppel (hamstring) and Dennis Schroder (thigh) ruled out, Allen will make his first start of the 2026-27 campaign. 3135045.h: Allen (knee) isn't listed on the injury report for Wednesday's game against the Nets.
3135045.s: Allen missed three straight preseason games due to a nagging knee issue, but he'll be good to go for Opening Night. 3135045.h: Allen (knee) didn't play in Friday's 117-98 preseason loss to the Grizzlies.
3135045.s: Allen missed a third consecutive contest due to right knee soreness. If he's unable to play in Wednesday's regular-season opener against Atlanta, Sion James and Royce O'Neale could see increased minutes.

3136777.h: Tate (coach's decision) did not play during Friday's 135-117 preseason win over the Mavericks.

The veteran forward may still have to fight for his spot on the roster in training camp, however, as Scotto notes that Tate's deal is partially guaranteed for only $1.04 million. Tate largely found himself outside of the Houston rotation in 2025-26, averaging just 8.8 minutes per game over 46 appearances.

3150844.h: Wagner is not in the starting lineup for Monday's preseason game against the Wizards.
3150844.s: With Day'Ron Sharpe (shoulder) back in action, Wagner will shift to a reserve role. As a starter Thursday against the 76ers, the veteran center totaled six points (2-3 FG, 0-1 3Pt, 2-2 FT), four steals, three rebounds and one assist across 18 minutes.

Brooks should continue to be a vital piece…

3155535.h: Looney will come off the bench for Tuesday's preseason matchup against Golden State, with Walker Kessler making his preseason debut, Ryan Ward of SI.com reports.

3155942.h: Sabonis (knee) is available for Tuesday's game against Orlando.
3155942.s: Sabonis is returning from a one-game absence after being unavailable during Sunday's defeat to the Heat. With the star big man back in action, Dylan Cardwell is set to slide back to the bench Tuesday.

3907497.h: Murray (personal) is not listed on the injury report for Monday's game against Memphis.
3907497.s: Murray has missed the last two games due to the birth of his son. However, he will be back in action Monday night versus the Grizzlies. As a result, Herbert Jones will presumably return to the bench.

3907497.h: Murray (personal) won't play in Saturday's game against the Hawks, Jim Eichenhofer of the Pelicans' official site reports.
3907497.s: Murray wasn't on the injury report but won't suit up due to the birth of his son. With Murray sidelined, Bennedict Mathurin could enter the starting lineup, with Jeremiah Fears operating as the primary ballhandler.

3907498.h: Thybulle will start Tuesday's preseason matchup against Golden State, Ryan Ward of SI.com reports.
3907498.s: Thybulle will get an opportunity with Los Angeles' first unit against the Warriors. The defensive-minded wing will look to make an impact with his steals and perimeter defense, though his offensive contributions have historically been limited. His starting assignment Tuesday doesn't necessarily indicate that he'll hold a first-unit role when the regular season begins.

3907498.h: Thybulle (rest) is available for Thursday's preseason game against the Kings, Sean Cunningham of Fox 40 Sacramento reports.
3907498.s: Thybulle sat out Tuesday's loss to Golden State but will return to action against Sacramento. He'll come off the bench Thursday after starting Monday's preseason-opening win over the Kings, during which he logged six points, two steals and one assist in 18 minutes.

3907498.h: Thybulle (rest) will skip Tuesday's exhibition against the Warriors, Luca Evans of the San Francisco Chronicle reports.
3907498.s: The Lakers are on the second leg of a back-to-back set, so they will rest their entire starting lineup and some key reserves. Jaden Hardy and Bronny James could see major minutes in Tuesday's preseason game.

3907498.h: Thybulle will start Monday's preseason game against the Kings, Khobi Price of The California Post reports.
3907498.s: The Lakers will be without Austin Reaves (ankle) and Walker Kessler (finger) in their preseason opener, so the club will start Luka Doncic, Quentin Grimes, Ziaire Williams, Kevon Looney and Thybulle. The defensive-minded swingman is competing for a starting spot ahead of the regular season.

3907498.h: Thybulle has made an immediate impact defensively during his first training camp with the Lakers, recording at least seven steals through the team's first two practices, according to Daniel Starkand of LakersNation.com.
3907498.s: Head coach JJ Redick specifically highlighted Thybulle's ability to disrupt passing lanes, joking that his teammates need to learn not to throw the ball when the veteran wing is positioned to make a play. Thybulle's defensive ability should give him a strong opportunity to earn consistent minutes as Los Angeles sorts through a crowded competition on the wing.

3907823.h: Mann (coach's decision) did not play in Wednesday's 110-103 loss to Charlotte.
3907823.s: The veteran wing was left out of Brooklyn's rotation as the team prioritized other perimeter options. Mann's experience could earn him opportunities later in the campaign, but his immediate fantasy outlook is limited.

3907823.h: Mann (knee) is unlikely to begin the 2026-27 season as a starter and appears to be buried on the depth chart.
3907823.s: Mann started 51 of his 63 regular-season appearances during his first year with the Nets in 2025-26, but he's all but certain to begin the new campaign as a reserve instead. Brooklyn drafted Mikel Brown in the first round this summer and is also set to get Egor Demin back in the mix, potentially leaving Mann behind Drake Powell, Ben Saraf and Nolan Traore (foot) in a position to fight for scraps with Keon Ellis off…

3908845.h: Collins plans to use his versatility to complement Cade Cunningham after joining the Pistons during the offseason, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.
3908845.s: The veteran forward highlighted Cunningham's playmaking ability and said he wants to generate easy baskets by playing off the star guard. Collins shot 40.6 percent from three-point range during the 2025-26 regular season, and his combination of perimeter shooting and finishing ability should give Cunningham another versatile offensive option.

3908845.h: Collins could be the most significant offseason addition for the Pistons, per Coty M. Davis of The Detroit News.
3908845.s: Collins is replacing Tobias Harris, who left for San Antonio this summer, in the starting lineup this year. The veteran power forward is a strong lob threat and pick-and-roll big man, which could play well with Cade Cunningham running the show at point guard. Collins got off to a rough start last season but experienced a second-half turnaround from Jan. 1 onward, averaging 14.4 points, 5.8 rebounds and 1.5…

3912848.h: Wade won't start Monday's game against Chicago, Keith Pompey of The Philadelphia Inquirer reports.
3912848.s: LeBron James (back) is back in the starting five, pushing Wade to the second unit. Over five regular-season appearances (four starts), Wade's averaging 3.6 points, 3.0 rebounds, 2.6 assists and 2.0 steals in 27.8 minutes per tilt.

3912848.h: Wade finished Friday's 98-93 win over New York with two rebounds, one assist and three steals in 27 minutes.
3912848.s: Wade was moved into the 76ers' starting lineup Friday due to the absence of Jaylen Brown (knee), but the former barely showed up on the box score and didn't attempt a shot. Wade has taken only one shot over his last two games, and his lack of shooting gives him little fantasy value even in the deepest of leagues. He would likely revert to a bench role if Brown is cleared to play against the Hornets on Saturday.

3912848.h: Wade will start Friday's game against the Knicks, Noah Levick of NBC Sports Philadelphia reports.
3912848.s: With Jaylen Brown (knee) sidelined, Wade will get the starting nod for the third time in Philadelphia's last four games. In two starts this season, Wade has averaged 7.0 points, 3.5 rebounds, 2.5 steals and 1.0 blocks in 32.5 minutes per game.

3912848.h: Wade will come off the bench in Wednesday's game against the Pacers.
3912848.s: Wade started the past two games with Joel Embiid and LeBron James alternating rest days on a back-to-back set, but with those two back in action Wednesday evening, Wade will return to a reserve role. Wade averaged 32.6 minutes as a starter, but he'll likely be working with minutes in the 20s as a member of the second unit.

3912848.h: Wade (ankle) is available and starting Saturday's game against the Bucks, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.
3912848.s: Wade will return from a two-game absence due to a sprained ankle and enter the starting lineup in LeBron James' (back) stead. Wade will be joined in the first unit by Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe, Jaylen Brown and Joel Embiid in the front end of this back-to-back set.

3913174.h: Kennard (knee) is available for Saturday's game against the Warriors, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.
3913174.s: Kennard will shed his questionable tag and return to action after missing Wednesday's season-opening loss to Portland. The sharpshooter figures to see meaningful burn off the bench behind Jalen Green.

3913174.h: Kennard (knee) is questionable to play Saturday against the Warriors.
3913174.s: A decision on Kennard's status will be made closer to Saturday's contest. If he ends up being ruled out for a second straight game, then Jordan Goodwin should be more involved off the bench.

3913174.h: Kennard (knee) practiced Friday, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.
3913174.s: Kennard is trending positively ahead of Saturday's game against the Warriors. The veteran sharpshooter can be tentatively deemed questionable before the Suns release an official injury report later Friday.

3913174.h: Kennard (knee) won't play Wednesday versus Portland, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.
3913174.s: Kennard is seemingly making progress after experiencing soreness in his knee near the end of the preseason. His next opportunity to suit up will come Saturday in Golden State. Without Kennard on the floor, Jordan Goodwin should be more involved.

3913174.h: Kennard (knee) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game against Portland.
3913174.s: Kennard began experiencing knee soreness near the end of the preseason. While the sharpshooter has been increasing his activity level in recent practices, he may need to miss a game or two to begin the 2026-27 campaign. If that's the case, Jordan Goodwin could see more minutes.

3913176.h: Ingram (Achilles) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game at Phoenix, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.
3913176.s: Ingram is nearing a return to action, though he won't make his season debut Tuesday. The veteran swingman's next opportunity to suit up will come Friday against Oklahoma City.

3913176.h: Ingram (Achilles) won't play in Sunday's game against New Orleans, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.
3913176.s: Ingram hasn't played yet this season. While the veteran is reportedly moving in a positive direction, he won't make his 2026-27 campaign debut Sunday versus his former team. Ingram's next opportunity to suit up will come Tuesday in Phoenix. In the meantime, Darius Garland will remain the Clippers' No. 1 scoring option.

3913176.h: Ingram (Achilles) has progressed to full contact basketball activities, per NBA writer Justin Russo.
3913176.s: Ingram told reporters Friday he's close to returning, though a concrete timeline for his season debut has yet to be disclosed. The star forward is recovering from a partial Achilles tear, and it sounds like he'll be ready to roll at some point in mid-November.

3913176.h: The Clippers recalled Ingram (Achilles) from the G League's San Diego Clippers on Sunday.
3913176.s: Ingram appears to be making steady progress after missing the opening run of the 2026-27 season through a partial Achilles tear, although it remains unclear when he'll be an option again for the Clippers and how quickly he'll regain playing time. Having worked with the G League squad Sunday, the versatile man is back with the main team, and his eventual return to action will restore a major piece of the rotation.…

3913176.h: Los Angeles assigned Ingram (Achilles) to the G League's San Diego Clippers on Saturday.
3913176.s: Ingram has continued to progress in his recovery from a partial Achilles tear that has forced him to sit out the initial stretch of the season. He'll likely spend a few days with the G League team as he aims to come closer to a full recovery. The versatile player will give Los Angeles' rotation a significant boost once he makes his season debut. Until then, players like Darius Garland and Kris Dunn will hold…

3914044.h: Shamet will start in Wednesday's game against the Bulls, Stefan Bondy of The New York Post reports.
3914044.s: With Josh Hart (knee) ruled out, Shamet will move into the starting lineup. The 2018 No. 26 overall pick started 12 regular-season games in 2025-26, averaging 8.7 points, 2.8 rebounds and 1.8 assists over 26.6 minutes per contest in those appearances.

3914044.h: Shamet (ankle) returned to Wednesday's game against the Bulls with 4:54 remaining in the second quarter, per the broadcast.
3914044.s: Shamet stepped on an opposing player's foot and exited to the locker room early in the second quarter. He returned to the bench and checked back in shortly thereafter.

3914044.h: Shamet (ankle) exited Wednesday's game against the Bulls, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
3914044.s: After a dunk in the second quarter, Shamet inadvertently stepped on Caleb Wilson's foot. He immediately grabbed his right ankle/foot and exited the contest. Shamet has since made his way to the bench, though until he's back on the floor, he should be considered questionable to return.

3914044.h: Shamet (rest) didn't play in Tuesday's 148-98 preseason loss to the Raptors.
3914044.s: New York presumably gave the veteran swingman Tuesday night off along with the rest of its routine starters. It's possible Shamet will be available for Thursday's meeting with Toronto for a final tune-up appearance.

3917376.h: Brown (knee) is available for Saturday's game in Charlotte.
3917376.s: Brown is back after a one-game absence, and he should see a nice uptick in usage Saturday with LeBron James (rest) and Joel Embiid (rest) unavailable. Brown is averaging 20.6 points, 6.6 rebounds, 4.2 assists, 1.8 triples and 1.2 steals per game this season.

3917376.h: Brown (knee) is questionable for Saturday's game in Charlotte.
3917376.s: Brown sat out Friday's 98-93 win over the Knicks and is now in jeopardy of missing his second straight game. If he's out again, Dean Wade would likely get another start, and it will be the Tyrese Maxey show on offense with Joel Embiid (foot) and LeBron James (back) already ruled out for Halloween.

3917376.h: Brown (knee) is out for Friday's game against the Knicks.
3917376.s: Brown is sitting out the first leg of this back-to-back set, and he figures to be facing a short-term absence. Kentavious Caldwell-Pope and Dean Wade should see more playing time as a result of Brown's absence, while Joel Embiid, Tyrese Maxey and LeBron James are all in line to handle more usage.

3917376.h: Brown (knee) is doubtful for Friday's game against the Knicks.
3917376.s: The star forward is expected to sit out the front end of this back-to-back set. Kentavious Caldwell-Pope and Dean Wade should both pick up more playing time Friday.

3917376.h: Brown (knee) is questionable for Friday's game against the Knicks.
3917376.s: Brown is in danger of sitting out Friday's showdown with the defending champions, which is the front end of a back-to-back set. More pressure would fall on Tyrese Maxey, Joel Embiid and LeBron James if Brown is out, while Kentavious Caldwell-Pope would be the most likely choice to enter the starting lineup.

3934673.h: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.
3934673.s: DiVincenzo is approaching six months since tearing his right Achilles during the first round of the playoffs and has been rehabbing with the expectation that he'll play at some point this season. The veteran guard has sought advice from Jayson Tatum, Tyrese Haliburton and Damian Lillard during his recovery, though Minnesota has yet to establish a timetable for his return.

3934673.h: Team president Tim Connelly believes DiVincenzo (Achilles) will return at some point this season, Jack Borman of the Locked On Wolves Podcast reports.
3934673.s: DiVincenzo underwent surgery to repair a ruptured Achilles in late April, but there's optimism he'll be able to contribute for the Timberwolves later this year. Although the door is open for the sharpshooter to make a late-season return, he's highly unlikely to be a factor in fantasy leagues in 2026-27.

3934719.h: Anunoby (rest) is set to play in Thursday's preseason game against the Raptors, James L. Edwards III of The Athletic reports.
3934719.s: Thursday's exhibition represents a tune-up opportunity for the Knicks' starters. Anunoby could see close to a normal workload as a result.

3934723.h: Bryant (coach's decision) did not play in Thursday's 114-106 loss to Philadelphia.
3934723.s: Bryant was left out of Cleveland's rotation despite the Cavaliers entering the season with some frontcourt injury concerns. With Jarrett Allen and Evan Mobley handling the primary frontcourt responsibilities, Bryant could struggle to see consistent playing time when the team is healthy.

3936099.h: Jones (knee) has been removed from the injury report ahead of Wednesday's game against the Heat, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.
3936099.s: Jones will be back in action Wednesday following a one-game stint on the sidelines, which should result in Kobe Sanders returning to the second unit. Jones is averaging 11.5 points, 4.8 rebounds, 2.2 triples and 1.2 steals per game this season.

3936099.h: Jones (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Raptors.
3936099.s: Jones exited Sunday's loss to the Warriors and did not return due to a right knee injury. He's now listed on the injury report with right knee soreness, and the veteran forward's next chance to play will come Wednesday against Miami. In the meantime, Kobe Sanders, Baba Miller and Gradey Dick are candidates for increased playing time.

3936099.h: Jones (right knee) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Warriors, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.
3936099.s: Jones appeared to sustain the injury in the third quarter of Sunday's game, and he'll be sidelined for the rest of the contest. Gradey Dick and Kobe Sanders are both in line for minutes the rest of the way in the absence of Jones, who will finish with nine points (3-11 FG, 1-5 3Pt, 2-2 FT), seven rebounds and one assist over 28 minutes.

3936099.h: Jones will only suit up for the first half of Sunday's preseason game against the Warriors, Joey Linn of SI.com reports.
3936099.s: Jones will join Darius Garland, Max Strus, Rui Hachimura and Isaiah Jackson in the first unit, though none of them will play in the second half. Jones started 45 of his 50 regular-season appearances in 2025-26, averaging 10.1 points, 3.5 rebounds, 1.4 assists, 1.0 blocks and 0.9 steals across 27.0 minutes per contest on the campaign.

3936099.h: Max Strus gives the Clippers another veteran wing capable of occupying many of the same lineup slots as Jones.
3936099.s: While Jones offers considerably more defensive versatility and athleticism, Strus provides superior floor spacing and could be preferred in lineups that need additional shooting. The added competition makes Jones' minutes somewhat less secure and reinforces his status as a low-usage contributor whose fantasy value will generally come from defensive statistics rather than offensive volume.

3936299.h: Murray (leg) has been cleared to play Monday against Houston.
3936299.s: Murray was initially added to the injury report as questionable due to left shin contusion, though he was upgraded to probable earlier Monday and has now been given the green light to suit up. The 29-year-old has scored 30-plus points in three of eight games this season but has cooled off recently, tallying 30 total points over his last two matchups.

3936299.h: Murray (leg) has been upgraded to probable for Monday against Houston.
3936299.s: Murray is expected to play through a left shin bruise Monday. The star guard should be able to handle a normal workload if he's cleared to suit up.

3936299.h: Murray is questionable for Monday's game against the Rockets due to a left shin contusion.
3936299.s: Murray could miss his first game of the season, as the Nuggets list their entire starting lineup as questionable for Monday. If he is unavailable, Tyus Jones could see an expanded role.

3945274.h: Doncic (back) is off the injury report for Monday's game against Atlanta, per Dave McMenamin of ESPN.com.
3945274.s: After sitting out Sunday's matchup in Detroit, Doncic is good to go for the second half of this back-to-back set. The MVP candidate is on an absolute tear, having dropped at least 40 points in six of his last seven appearances.

3945274.h: Doncic has been ruled out for Sunday's game at Detroit due to lower-back tightness, Trevor Lane of LakersNation.com reports.
3945274.s: Doncic will be held out of the front end of this back-to-back set, with his next chance to suit up coming Monday at Atlanta. With the superstar floor general sidelined, Austin Reaves will likely see increased scoring and playmaking duties, while Quentin Grimes and Collin Sexton could see an uptick in minutes.

3945274.h: Doncic (back) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Pistons.
3945274.s: Doncic dropped his second 50-piece of the season during Friday's 124-118 win over Portland, but the Lakers' superstar is dealing with tightness in his lower back that will leave his status for Sunday's outing up in the air. If Doncic is unable to suit up, Austin Reaves will take over primary offensive responsibilities while Quentin Grimes and Collin Sexton would see a substantial increase in minutes for the first…

4017837.h: Zubac (ankle) is available for Wednesday's game against the Grizzlies, Alex Golden of SI.com reports.
4017837.s: Zubac will return Wednesday after missing the last five games due to an ankle injury. While Zubac may see fewer minutes in his first game back from the layoff, his presence will likely result in Jay Huff retreating to the bench.

4017837.h: Zubac (ankle) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game against the Grizzlies.
4017837.s: Zubac has missed the last five regular-season games due to an ankle injury. While it's not clear how healthy he is, the questionable designation at least suggests he's moving in the right direction. If Zubac is sidelined again Wednesday versus Memphis, Jay Huff is expected to remain in the starting lineup at the five.

4017837.h: Zubac (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Hawks.
4017837.s: Zubac is slated to miss a fifth straight game due to an ankle sprain, and while the Pacers were optimistic about a quick return, it's fair to treat the big man as week-to-week now, given he continues to be ruled out on the team's initial injury report. In the starting center's absence, Jay Huff and Larry Nance (illness) have handled increased roles.

4017837.h: Zubac (ankle) will remain on the inactive list for Sunday's game against the Nets.
4017837.s: This will be Zubac's fourth consecutive game on the sidelines, which should result in another start for Jay Huff and extended minutes for Larry Nance. Zubac's next chance to play will come Monday against the Hawks.

4017837.h: Zubac (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Heat.
4017837.s: The Pacers continue to view the veteran big man as day-to-day due to an ankle sprain. Jay Huff figures to continue to start at center for the Pacers on Friday, while Obi Toppin could see a larger share of the frontcourt minutes.

4065648.h: Tatum (rest) is off the injury report for Friday's game versus Charlotte, per Taylor Snow of the Celtics' official site.
4065648.s: Tatum is ready to suit back up following a rest day Wednesday against the Bucks. The star forward's presence will force either Hugo Gonzalez or Sam Hauser to shift back to a bench role Friday.

4065648.h: Tatum will be rested Wednesday against the Bucks, Jack Simone of BostonSportsJournal.com reports.
4065648.s: The writing was on the wall for this one with the Celtics looking to get Tatum some planned rest. There's been no report of an injury, to be clear. Paul George, who is coming off a maintenance day himself, is in line for a big bump in usage Wednesday.

4065648.h: Tatum (rest) is questionable for Wednesday against the Bucks, Taylor Snow of the Celtics' official site reports.
4065648.s: Tatum's questionable designation suggests Boston could give its star forward a night off for maintenance purposes. His status will be worth monitoring ahead of Wednesday's tip-off, as his potential absence would open up additional scoring opportunities for the Celtics' remaining starters.

4065648.h: Tatum (head) returned to Sunday's game against Orlando, Gary Washburn of The Boston Globe reports.
4065648.s: Tatum bumped heads with Jamal Cain in the first quarter and went to the locker room to address bleeding from his head. He's back on the floor, though his condition is certainly worth monitoring the rest of the way.

4065648.h: Tatum (head) exited Sunday's game against the Magic, Bobby Krivitsky of Forbes.com reports.
4065648.s: Tatum bumped heads with Jamal Cain late in the first quarter and exited for further medical treatment. For now, he should be considered questionable to return. If Tatum can't get back on the floor Sunday, Sam Hauser could see more minutes the rest of the way.

4065654.h: Isaac (knee) is out for Tuesday's game against Sacramento.
4065654.s: Isaac has yet to make his 2026-27 debut while continuing his rehab from a left knee injury. He can be considered week-to-week moving forward.

4065654.h: Orlando recalled Isaac (knee) from the G League's Osceola Magic on Wednesday.
4065654.s: Isaac was assigned to Osceola but recalled again on the same day while he continued his recovery from a knee issue. Having yet to play this season, the forward is not expected to find a meaningful role in the short term, and he'll likely appear on the bench when he's available again.

4065654.h: Orlando recalled Isaac (knee) from the G League's Osceola Magic on Sunday.
4065654.s: Isaac has been working on his rehabilitation from a significant knee injury and remains without a defined timeline for his 2026-27 season debut. He was assigned to the G League club Sunday and recalled shortly after, presumably getting some practice with the affiliate team. Once he's healthy, Isaac could see minutes off the bench for Orlando.

4065654.h: Isaac (knee) is out for Friday's game in Toronto.
4065654.s: Isaac holds no timetable for a return due to an ongoing left knee injury. The oft-injured forward can be considered week-to-week until the Magic update his timeline.

4065654.h: Isaac (knee) has been ruled out ahead of Wednesday's game against the Raptors.
4065654.s: The oft-injured forward isn't ready to make his season debut. His next chance to do so arrives Friday in Toronto for a rematch with the Raptors.

4065663.h: Okogie will start in Tuesday's game against Miami.
4065663.s: With Utah down several key players, Okogie will make his first start of the 2026-27 season Tuesday night. The 28-year-old started 32 regular-season games for the Rockets in 2025-26, averaging 6.6 points, 3.4 rebounds, 1.1 assists and 1.3 steals over 24.1 minutes per contest in those appearances.

4065673.h: Bradley (quadriceps) is available for Friday's game versus the Pelicans.
4065673.s: The journeyman center is getting the green light to make his Jazz debut Friday. He fortifies Utah's frontcourt depth while Jusuf Nurkic (foot) is injured, but Kyle Filipowski should remain firmly ahead of Bradley for the backup center gig behind Jaxson Hayes.

4065673.h: Bradley (quadriceps) is questionable for Friday's game against New Orleans.
4065673.s: Bradley sat out Wednesday's season-opening loss to the Grizzlies and continues to deal with a left quad issue. The team will presumably monitor his status closely before issuing another update ahead of Friday's tipoff.

4065673.h: Bradley is out for Wednesday's game in Memphis due to a left quadriceps strain.
4065673.s: It's unclear when Bradley suffered this injury, but he'll begin the 2026-27 season on the sidelines. For now, he should be considered questionable for Friday's meeting with the Pelicans.

4065673.h: Bradley was claimed off waivers by the Jazz on Saturday, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.
4065673.s: Bradley is now on a non-guaranteed deal with Utah after being waived by New York. He appeared in 40 regular-season games (four starts) between Atlanta and Indiana in 2025-26, averaging 4.1 points and 2.9 rebounds in 11.3 minutes per showing.

4065673.h: The Knicks waived Bradley on Wednesday, Ian Begley of SportsNet New York reports.
4065673.s: The Knicks made several moves Wednesday and also cut ties with Drew Eubanks (chest) and Ochai Agbaji. Bradley was previously on an Exhibit 9 contract and will now look for work elsewhere.

4065731.h: Huff is not listed in the starting lineup for Wednesday's game against Memphis.
4065731.s: With Ivica Zubac (ankle) back on the floor, Huff will return to the bench after starting the last five games for the Pacers. While Huff is expected to see fewer minutes in a reserve role, he should remain heavily involved, especially if Zubac takes on a limited workload.

4065731.h: Huff will start Monday's game against the Bucks, Scott Agness of FieldhouseFiles.com reports.
4065731.s: Ivica Zubac (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's clash, opening the door for Huff to start at center. He started the second half of Sunday's matchup after Zubac went down and put together a strong final line, finishing with 14 points, two rebounds, three assists and three blocks in 21 minutes.

4065731.h: Huff (coach's decision) did not play in Wednesday's 123-120 win over New Orleans.
4065731.s: Indiana opted not to use Huff despite the tightly contested matchup. The veteran center appears to be behind other frontcourt options in the Pacers' rotation, limiting his immediate fantasy appeal unless his workload increases.

4065732.h: Hunter (illness) is not listed on the injury report ahead of Sunday's game against Miami.
4065732.s: Hunter didn't play in Friday's 124-109 loss to the Spurs, marking his first absence of the season. He will return Sunday versus the Heat, likely meaning Leaky Black will head back to the bench.

4065732.h: Hunter (illness) is listed as out for Friday's game against San Antonio.
4065732.s: Hunter was listed as questionable but has now been ruled out for the first time this season. His next opportunity to play will come Sunday versus the Heat. With Hunter unavailable, Malik Monk might find his way into the starting lineup.

4065732.h: Hunter is questionable for Friday against the Spurs due to an illness.
4065732.s: Hunter is a late addition to the injury report. If he doesn't suit up Friday, Malik Monk and Leaky Black should soak up more playing time for the Kings.

4065732.h: Hunter will start Wednesday's game against the Clippers, Tomer Azarly of ClutchPoints.com reports.
4065732.s: Ben Simmons is out for the season with a torn Achilles, opening the door for Hunter to step into the starting five. The 28-year-old appeared in only two games after being traded to Sacramento last season, and he averaged 13.7 points, 4.1 rebounds, 2.0 assists and 0.7 steals across 26.1 minutes per contest in 45 regular-season games (25 starts) between the Kings and Cavaliers.

4065732.h: Hunter (rest) is available to play in Friday's exhibition against the Spurs, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.
4065732.s: Hunter missed Tuesday's preseason loss to Portland for maintenance, but he's been cleared for Sacramento's preseason finale. Hunter is averaging 3.3 points, 2.3 rebounds and 2.3 turnovers per game this preseason.

4065733.h: Jerome (back) is not listed on the injury report ahead of Monday's game against New Orleans.
4065733.s: Jerome didn't play in the 136-105 victory over the Kings on Saturday, though he will return from his one-game layoff for Monday's meeting with the Pelicans. With Jerome cleared to play, Cam Spencer will presumably head back to the bench. However, since Scotty Pippen (back) is doubtful, Spencer should see more minutes than usual.

4065733.h: Jerome (back) won't play in Saturday's game versus Sacramento, Chris Herrington of The Daily Memphian reports.
4065733.s: Jerome has been battling a nagging back injury, and it will force him to miss his first game of the 2026-27 campaign. With Scotty Pippen (back) also sidelined, Cam Spencer is the favorite to start at the one.

4065733.h: Jerome (back) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against the Kings.
4065733.s: This isn't the first mention of Jerome's nagging back issue, though it didn't stop him from suiting up for the 124-103 win over the Trail Blazers on Thursday. The 29-year-old has played at an All-Star level in his five regular-season appearances in 2026-27, averaging 25.8 points, 2.2 rebounds and 5.8 assists -- all career highs -- along with 1.0 steals in 29.8 minutes per contest. If Jerome can't get on the floor…
