Meleek Thomas, Mario Hezonja and Tyrese Proctor could see more playing time with Merrill sidelined Saturday.

4066757.h: Merrill (elbow) won't return to Friday's game against the 76ers, Dave McMenamin of ESPN.com reports.
4066757.s: Merrill has been dealing with a right elbow issue since the preseason. While he hasn't missed any games during the regular season, he's now in danger of missing Saturday's game against the Knicks. If Merrill can't play in that contest, Meleek Thomas and Tyrese Proctor could see more playing time.

4066757.h: Merrill is in the starting lineup for Friday's game against the 76ers, Serena Winters of FanDuel Sports Network Ohio reports.
4066757.s: Merrill is moving to the starting lineup due to the absence of Jarrett Allen (knee), as Evan Mobley has moved to center and Peyton Watson will get the nod at power forward. Merrill is averaging 8.6 points and 3.5 rebounds per game while shooting 34.1 percent from three. This will be his first start of the season.

4066993.h: Smith (calf) is available for Wednesday's season opener versus Minnesota.
4066993.s: Smith has made good progress with a right calf strain and is ready to roll for Opening Night. He's set to be the No. 2 point guard off the bench behind Davion Mitchell on Wednesday.

4066993.h: Smith (calf) participated in practice Monday, Anthony Chiang of the Miami Herald reports.
4066993.s: Smith was also able to suit up for Sunday's practice, so he appears to be trending in the right direction despite dealing with a right calf strain. More clarity on his status for Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Timberwolves should come once the team releases an injury report Tuesday evening.

4066993.h: Smith (calf) participated in Sunday's practice, Anthony Chiang of the Miami Herald reports.
4066993.s: Smith didn't play in the preseason due to a strained right calf. While his level of participation in Sunday's session is unclear, it's encouraging to see Smith practicing. He can be considered questionable for Wednesday's regular-season opener against Minnesota.

4066993.h: Smith (calf) has been ruled out for Friday's preseason game against the Magic, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.
4066993.s: Smith strained his right calf in the beginning of training camp and will end up missing the entire preseason. His next chance to play will come in Wednesday's regular-season opener against Minnesota.

4066993.h: Smith will miss a couple of weeks with a strained right calf, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.
4066993.s: This is a tough blow for the point guard who was penciled in as the top backup behind Davion Mitchell. If he misses only a couple of weeks, Smith could be back in time for their final preseason contest Oct. 16.

4222252.h: Hartenstein (ankle) is good to suit up in Tuesday's preseason game against the Pacers, Justin Martinez of The Oklahoman reports.
4222252.s: Hartenstein is in line to make his 2026 preseason debut after dealing with an ankle injury. The big man is coming off an injury-plagued 2025-26 season in which he appeared in 47 regular-season games (46 starts), averaging 9.2 points, 9.4 rebounds, 3.5 assists and 1.8 combined steals-plus-blocks in 24.2 minutes per contest.

4222252.h: Hartenstein (ankle) won't play in Monday's preseason game against the Hawks, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
4222252.s: Hartenstein and the rest of Oklahoma City's regulars won't travel to Atlanta for the first half of a back-to-back set. The veteran center has yet to suit up during the preseason due to an ankle injury, and his status for Tuesday's home game against Indiana remains unclear.

4222252.h: Hartenstein (ankle) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against the Bucks, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
4222252.s: Hartenstein is sitting out once again with ankle soreness after missing the Thunder's preseason opener. His next chance for exhibition action is Monday against the Hawks.

4222252.h: Hartenstein (rest) will not play in Tuesday's preseason opener against the Pelicans, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
4222252.s: Hartenstein will travel to Tulsa despite sitting out the contest. The veteran center is among several key rotation players whom Oklahoma City will hold out Tuesday as the club manages workloads during the preseason.

4222252.h: Hartenstein dropped nearly 10 pounds ahead of the 2026-27 season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
4222252.s: Hartenstein has been a full go for several weeks after tweaking his ankle while playing for Germany during the offseason. He's expected to play a similar role in 2026-27 and is fresh off a three-year, $75 million extension.

4277811.h: Sexton (calf) isn't listed on the injury report for Friday's game against the Clippers.
4277811.s: Sexton took a seat for Wednesday's 2026-27 season opener against the Warriors as a precaution, but he'll be ready to make his team debut Friday evening. He's expected to be utilized off the bench behind Luka Doncic and will be on a minutes restriction, Thuc Nhi Nguyen of the Los Angeles Times reports.

4277811.h: Head coach JJ Redick said that Sexton (calf) did not experience a setback, but the Lakers will sit him out of Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Warriors as a precaution, Daniel Starkland of Lakers Nation reports.
4277811.s: It sounds like Sexton is day-to-day, so for now, he should be considered questionable for Friday's meeting with the Clippers. Quentin Grimes, Jake LaRavia and Sandro Mamukelashvili will help pick up the slack in Sexton's absence.

4277811.h: Sexton (calf) won't play in Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Warriors, per Khobi Price of The California Post.
4277811.s: Sexton isn't ready to make his Lakers debut Wednesday due to a calf strain. The veteran guard's absence should open the door to more playing time for Quentin Grimes, Jake LaRavia and Sandro Mamukelashvili.

4277811.h: Sexton (calf) is questionable for Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Warriors.
4277811.s: Sexton did not play during the preseason due to a right soleus strain, but he was able to get through the Lakers' past two practices, so he's trending in the right direction. He'll likely have some minutes restrictions if he's cleared to play.

4277811.h: Sexton (lower leg) fully practiced Monday, per Dan Woike of The Athletic.
4277811.s: Sexton missed the end of the preseason with a lower right leg injury, but he's trending in the right direction. His status remains uncertain for Wednesday's season opener against the Warriors.

4277813.h: Jones will start Monday's game against the Warriors, Rod Walker of The Times-Picayune reports.
4277813.s: Jones will earn his fifth start of the 2026-27 campaign with Zion Williamson (rest) out Monday. Jones has averaged 9.5 points, 4.0 rebounds, 1.8 assists and 1.0 steals in 30.5 minutes per tilt across four starts this season.

4277813.h: Jones is not starting Friday against the Timberwolves,
4277813.s: Jones will return to the bench due to the return of Trey Murphy (knee). Jones is averaging just 6.5 points, 3.0 rebounds and 1.0 assists per game this season while starting in four of his eight appearances.

4277813.h: Jones will start Thursday's game against the Kings, Jim Eichenhofer of the Pelicans' official site reports.
4277813.s: With Dejounte Murray (personal) unavailable, Jones will get the starting nod for the first time this season. He has yet to play 20-plus minutes in a game and is averaging 3.5 points, 2.0 rebounds and 1.0 steals in 17.5 minutes per contest across four regular-season outings.

4277813.h: Jones is not in the starting lineup for Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Pacers.
4277813.s: The Pelicans will go small for Wednesday's season opener, starting Dejounte Murray and Jeremiah Fears in the backcourt. Jones still should see quality minutes in the reserve role, but his upside will be limited.

4277813.h: Jones won't start Thursday's preseason game against the Heat.
4277813.s: Jones got the starting nod in the Pelicans' preseason-opening win over the Thunder on Tuesday, though he'll slide to the second unit Thursday. Bennedict Mathurin will enter the first unit in Jones' place.

4277843.h: Trent (illness) isn't listed on the injury report for Tuesday's game against New York.
4277843.s: Trent is set to be available Tuesday following a one-game absence due to an illness. However, he isn't guaranteed to see the floor against New York.

4277843.h: Trent (illness) won't play in Sunday's game versus the Celtics.
4277843.s: Trent was a late addition to the injury report due to an illness. The veteran wing has totaled 13 minutes over two regular-season appearances, so his absence wouldn't impact the rotation.

4277843.h: Trent (illness) is out for Sunday's game against the Celtics.
4277843.s: Trent has not been in the rotation to start the season, but he will miss Sunday's game due to an illness. His absence doesn't impact the rotation.

4277843.h: Trent (illness) has been downgraded to questionable for Sunday's game against Boston.
4277843.s: Trent was a late addition to the injury report due to an illness. The veteran wing has totaled 13 minutes over two regular-season appearances, so his potential absence wouldn't impact the rotation.

4277843.h: Trent (coach's decision) did not play in Wednesday's 128-116 loss to Washington.
4277843.s: The veteran sharpshooter was unable to crack Milwaukee's rotation despite the team's Opening Night defeat. Trent has the perimeter shooting ability to contribute when called upon, but his uncertain workload makes him difficult to trust in fantasy formats.

4277869.h: Alvarado (ankle) is available for Monday's game against the Nets, Ian Begley of SportsNet New York reports.
4277869.s: Alvarado will shed his questionable tag and suit up for the first time since Oct. 23. His return from a four-game absence will likely mean fewer opportunities for Tyler Kolek and Jordan Clarkson off the Knicks' bench.

4277869.h: Alvarado (ankle) is questionable for Monday's game against the Nets.
4277869.s: Alvarado has missed four straight games and was ruled out at least 24 hours in advance of each absence. However, it appears he's nearing a return to action. If available Monday, Alvarado would likely face limitations, while Jordan Clarkson and Tyler Kolek would be candidates for fewer minutes.

4277869.h: Alvarado (ankle) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Philadelphia.
4277869.s: Alvarado will miss a fourth straight game with a left ankle sprain, and it's not a positive sign that he's being ruled out a day before tipoff. He can be considered week-to-week until the Knicks offer an update on his status. Tyler Kolek will likely continue seeing increased burn in Alvarado's absence.

4277869.h: Alvarado (ankle) is out for Wednesday's game against the Bulls.
4277869.s: Alvarado will miss a third straight game for New York. With the veteran guard out, Tyler Kolek will likely continue to pick up some backup point guard minutes.

4277869.h: Alvarado (ankle) is out for Tuesday's game against the Pistons.
4277869.s: Alvarado will miss a second consecutive game with a sprained ankle. Tyler Kolek entered the New York rotation in Sunday's loss to the Magic and should continue to play a bench role while Alvarado is sidelined.

4277919.h: Bamba (ankle) is available for Wednesday's game in New Orleans.
4277919.s: Bamba will push through an ankle issue and make himself available for Wednesday's game. He's averaging 9.0 points, 5.8 rebounds and 1.8 blocks per contest this season.

4277919.h: Bamba (ankle) participated in Wednesday's morning shootaround, per Shreyas Laddha of The Salt Lake Tribune.
4277919.s: Bamba is trending in a positive direction ahead of Wednesday's game in New Orleans. He can be tentatively placed on the right side of his questionable designation.

4277919.h: Bamba is questionable for Wednesday's game in New Orleans due to a sprained right ankle.
4277919.s: Bamba must have tweaked his ankle during Monday's 119-97 loss to the Spurs, and now he's in danger of sitting out Wednesday's game. If Bamba is forced to the sidelines, Kyle Filipowski would likely pick up most of his minutes.

4277919.s: Utah leaned on Jaxson Hayes and Jaren Jackson in the frontcourt, leaving Bamba without an opportunity in the season opener. The veteran center appears to be a depth option and could struggle to find consistent minutes without injuries ahead of him.

4277922.h: Sims (undisclosed) is not listed on the injury report for Wednesday's game against the Wizards.
4277922.s: The high-flying big man is ready to suit up in Milwaukee's 2026-27 regular-season opener in Washington after missing the preseason finale. With the addition of Kel'el Ware during the offseason and Myles Turner entering his second season with the franchise, Sims is set to be the third center on any given night as the Bucks begin to rebuild following their trade of franchise pillar Giannis Antetokounmpo to the Heat.

4277922.h: Sims (undisclosed) didn't play in Friday's 128-127 preseason win over the Pacers in overtime.
4277922.s: Sims was held out of Friday's preseason finale for undisclosed reasons. The big man's next opportunity to play will come in Wednesday's regular-season opener against Washington, though his absence wouldn't significantly impact the rotation.

4277922.h: Sims is in the starting lineup for Wednesday's preseason game against Chicago.
4277922.s: Sims will enter the starting lineup for the first time this preseason with several Milwaukee regulars resting. In 67 regular-season appearances (19 starts) last season, the big man averaged 5.0 points, 5.5 rebounds and 1.6 assists in 19.7 minutes per contest.

4277951.h: Garza (nose) went to the locker room late in the fourth quarter of Saturday's preseason game against the 76ers, Bobby Manning of CLNS Media Network reports.
4277951.s: Garza took an inadvertent elbow to the nose from teammate Chris Cenac, and the former was taken to the locker room shortly thereafter. He didn't return to the hardwood, ending his night with eight points (4-9 FG), seven rebounds and one assist over 11 minutes.

4277951.h: Garza is not in the starting lineup for Saturday's preseason game against the 76ers, Sean Grande of NBC Sports Boston reports.
4277951.s: Garza returns to the bench with Mitchell Robinson (undisclosed) getting the start at center. Garza provided 22 points (6-17 FG, 3-10 3Pt, 7-8 FT), 10 rebounds, three blocks and two assists across 27 minutes in Thursday's 124-113 preseason win over Cleveland, and he's making a strong case to earn a spot in the rotation even if he'll compete with Neemias Queta and Robinson for playing time.

4277951.h: Garza will start Thursday's preseason game against Cleveland, Bobby Krivitsky of Forbes.com reports.
4277951.s: The Celtics are expected to rest several rotation players Thursday, opening the door for Garza to step into the first unit. The 27-year-old center will face an uphill battle for steady minutes during the regular season.

4277956.h: Poole (ankle) is available for Wednesday's game against Utah.
4277956.s: Poole was initially listed as probable due to left ankle tendinopathy, and he's since been cleared to play Wednesday. The veteran guard is averaging 6.0 points, 3.0 assists, 2.0 rebounds and 1.3 steals in 16.0 minutes per contest across four regular-season games.

4277956.h: Poole (ankle) is listed as probable for Wednesday's game against Utah.
4277956.s: Poole is expected to return from a three-game layoff for the meeting with the Jazz on Wednesday. If Poole is cleared for action, it would likely mean fewer minutes for Bryce McGowens and Trendon Watford.

4277956.h: Poole (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Grizzlies.
4277956.s: Poole will miss his third consecutive contest due to a sprained left ankle. His next chance to suit up will come Wednesday versus Utah. Bennedict Mathurin and Herbert Jones should continue to earn more run in Poole's absence.

4277956.h: Poole (ankle) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Hawks.
4277956.s: Poole will miss a second straight game due to a sprained left ankle. His next chance to suit up will come Monday at Memphis. Bennedict Mathurin and Herbert Jones are candidates for increased playing time in Poole's absence.

4277956.h: Poole (ankle) has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Kings.
4277956.s: Poole will miss the second leg of this back-to-back set after spraining his left ankle in Wednesday's loss to Denver. His next chance to play will come Saturday against Atlanta. In the meantime, Bennedict Mathurin and Herbert Jones are candidates for increased burn. With Dejounte Murray (personal) also out, AJ Johnson could enter the rotation.

4277961.h: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
4277961.s: Jackson sustained the injury early in Monday's loss to Memphis, and he's now expected to miss at least a month and a half of action. The star big man's absence creates a major void in the Utah lineup, one that is likely to be filled by a timeshare of Jaxson Hayes (shoulder), Kyle Filipowski and Mo Bamba. The Jazz could also shift Lauri Markkanen (wrist), when healthy, to the center spot at times, perhaps allowing…

4277961.s: An opposing player landed on Jackson's leg early in the second quarter, and after initially remaining in the game, he ultimately checked out and went to the locker room. The severity of the injury is unknown at this time, but Jackson has been shut down for the rest of the evening. Lauri Markkanen (wrist) also left Monday's game in the first half and is questionable to return, potentially opening up minutes for Svi…

4277961.h: Jackson is still developing chemistry with Utah's core after having limited time alongside his teammates following his arrival last season, according to Jazz reporter Eric Spyropoulos.
4277961.s: Head coach Will Hardy said Tuesday that Jackson's familiarity with the roster doesn't change the fact that he's still early in the learning process after appearing in only three games for Utah last season. Hardy was encouraged by Jackson's communication during the Jazz's opening practice and highlighted the big man's versatility as something that gives the team several options. Developing chemistry with Lauri…

4277961.h: With Walker Kessler now in Los Angeles, Jackson (knee) figures to be an even more essential piece for the Jazz in 2026-27, per ESPN's Tim MacMahon.
4277961.s: Jackson was traded from Memphis to Utah in February, though he appeared in only three regular-season games for the Jazz before undergoing surgery due to a growth in his left knee. The 2022-23 Defensive Player of the Year will look to make his presence felt on that end of the floor and anchor a now Kessler-less Jazz frontcourt. Jackson's two-way production will be crucial for a Utah team that's looking to return to…

4278049.h: Gafford went to the locker room during the third quarter of Monday's game against the Heat due to an undisclosed injury, but he returned with 8:52 remaining in the period, Grant Afseth of DallasHoopsJournal.com reports.
4278049.s: Gafford looked to take a knee to the body on a Giannis Antetokounmpo dunk, and the big man was spotted going into the locker room right after. However, Gafford was able to return later in the quarter after getting checked out.

4278049.h: Gafford (rest) is not listed on the injury report ahead of Friday's preseason finale with the Hawks.
4278049.s: Gafford sat out Wednesday's exhibition for rest, but he'll be back in action for Friday's final exhibition before the regular season. Over 55 regular-season games (44 starts) in 2025-26, Gafford averaged 9.5 points, 6.9 rebounds, 1.1 assists and 1.3 blocks per contest.

4278049.h: Gafford (rest) won't play Wednesday against the Pelicans, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.
4278049.s: The big man is receiving a maintenance day Wednesday. His next chance to play comes Friday against the Hawks.

4278053.h: Mitchell (rest) is in line to play in Wednesday's preseason game against the Nets, Will Manso of Local 10 Miami reports.
4278053.s: The Heat plan to get most of their regular players some minutes Wednesday. Mitchell should get some burn in the first half of this exhibition.

4278053.h: Mitchell (rest) won't suit up for Saturday's exhibition against the Timberwolves, Eric Nehm of The Athletic reports.
4278053.s: The Heat will be resting their entire starting lineup for Saturday's preseason game, so expect ample minutes for guys like Ryan Conwell and Bez Mbeng. Mitchell should return for Wednesday's exhibition against the Nets.

4278053.h: Mitchell could be in line for a larger role after Miami traded Tyler Herro in the deal for Giannis Antetokounmpo, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sentinel reports.
4278053.s: With the Heat expected to lean on Mitchell as a primary backcourt facilitator, he'll have the opportunity to capitalize on the attention Antetokounmpo commands offensively. Over 70 regular-season appearances in 2025-26, he averaged 9.3 points, 6.5 assists, 2.7 rebounds and 1.0 steals while…

4278067.s: Claxton will suit up for the first time this season after missing time due to a hamstring injury. 4278067.s: Collins was originally marked as probable for Sunday's contest, but he appears to be trending in the wrong direction as game day approaches. If Claxton needs to sit out another game, Jalen Smith (hand) would presumably continue to operate as the Bulls' starting center.

4278067.s: Splitter stopped short of confirming Claxton's availability, but the big man is certainly trending in the right direction. Once Claxton is cleared to make his Bulls debut, Jalen Smith (hand) is likely to fall into a reserve role.

4278067.s: Claxton was assigned to the G League earlier in the day to log a practice as part of his rehab. He'll rejoin the NBA squad following his workout and could make his 2026-27 debut as early as Sunday against the 76ers.

4278067.h: The Bulls assigned Claxton (hamstring) to the G League's Windy City Bulls on Thursday.
4278067.s: This is the next stage of Claxton's rehab, and he'll be recalled shortly after practicing Thursday. Claxton drew a questionable tag prior to Wednesday against the Knicks and is closing in on his season debut.

4278076.h: Richards won't start Friday's preseason game against the Magic, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.
4278076.s: Richards will slide to the second unit after starting Miami's past two games. The Heat will go with a starting five of Davion Mitchell, Klay Thompson, Andrew Wiggins, Bobby Portis and Nikola Jovic in the absences of Giannis Antetokounmpo (rest) and Bam Adebayo (groin).

4278076.h: Richards will start in Saturday's preseason game against the Timberwolves, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.
4278076.s: Richards will get the start with Bam Adebayo (rest) and Giannis Antetokounmpo (rest) taking the night off. There should also be additional minutes available for Bobby Portis.

4278076.h: Richards agreed to a one-year deal with the Heat on Thursday, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
4278076.s: Miami fortifies its center depth with the move. Over 20 regular-season appearances for the Bulls in 2025-26, Richards averaged 9.3 points, 7.6 rebounds and 0.9 blocks in 22.4 minutes per game while shooting 52.3 percent from the field following a trade from Phoenix. The big man is likely to settle for a lesser role in his new digs, but he has a chance to serve as the No. 2 center behind Bam Adebayo.

4278077.h: Vanderbilt (undisclosed) is not listed on the injury report ahead of Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Warriors.
4278077.s: Vanderbilt skipped the Lakers' preseason finale, but he'll be available for Opening Night. However, he's not guaranteed a spot in the rotation.

4278077.h: Vanderbilt (undisclosed) isn't expected to play in Friday's preseason game against the Nuggets, Thuc Nhi Nguyen of the Los Angeles Times reports.
4278077.s: Vanderbilt was spotted in street clothes, though it's unknown why he isn't playing in the Lakers' preseason finale. His next chance to suit up will come in Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Warriors.

4278077.s: Vanderbilt's defensive versatility, size and rebounding make him a theoretical fit for what Los Angeles wants from the role, but Buha is skeptical that he'll win the competition after playing a modest role last season. Jake LaRavia and Ziaire Williams appear to have the inside track entering camp, so Vanderbilt may need a strong preseason to move up the pecking order.

4278077.h: Vanderbilt should continue to provide defensive value after LeBron James' exit from the Lakers, Broderick Turner of the Los Angeles Times reports.
4278077.s: Despite James' absence, the arrivals of Matisse Thybulle, Ziaire Williams and Sandro Mamukelashvili give the Lakers additional options on the wing and in the frontcourt. While Vanderbilt's rebounding and defensive versatility remain valuable, increased competition for minutes could make it difficult for him to carve out a reliable fantasy role.

4278078.h: Washington (ankle) will play in Sunday's preseason game against the Rockets, Grant Afseth of DallasHoopsJournal.com reports.
4278078.s: Washington missed Friday's preseason opener due to a left ankle sprain but will return to action Sunday, sliding into the starting lineup next to Cooper Flagg, Zaccharie Risacher, Kyrie Irving and Daniel Gafford. As a starter last season (53 games), Washington averaged 14.5 points, 7.2 rebounds, 1.7 assists, 1.1 blocks and 1.0 steals per game.

4278078.h: Washington won't play in Friday's preseason game against the Rockets due to a left ankle sprain.
4278078.s: The severity of Washington's ankle injury is unclear, but his next chance to suit up will come during Sunday's rematch against the Rockets in China. The veteran forward is expected to have a key role for the Mavs heading into the 2026-27 season, though head coach Dusty May isn't ready to commit to the Kentucky product as a mainstay in the starting five. 4278078.s: Washington is expected to have a key role for the Mavs heading into the 2026-27 season, though coach Dusty May is not yet ready to commit to the Kentucky product being a mainstay in the starting five. It's worth noting that Washington has come off the bench only four times in 113 regular-season appearances for Dallas over the last two years. However, the addition of rookie Morez Johnson could complicate the…

4278129.h: Ayton (leg) is not listed on the injury report ahead of Monday's game against the Pistons.
4278129.s: Ayton left Saturday's game against the Thunder early due to a lower-leg injury, but he will be available Monday. Over his last five completed games, Ayton holds averages of 6.0 points, 5.6 rebounds and 1.4 assists in 17.4 minutes per contest.

4278129.h: Ayton won't return to Saturday's game against the Thunder due to a lower leg injury.
4278129.s: Ayton will end his evening with two points (1-2 FG), one rebound and one turnover in seven minutes. For now, he should be considered questionable for Monday's game in Detroit.

4278129.h: Ayton will come off the bench in Saturday's game against the Thunder.
4278129.s: Bilal Coulibaly will replace Ayton in the first unit for Saturday's game. As a reserve this season, Ayton is averaging 5.6 points and 4.3 rebounds per contest.

4278129.h: Ayton will start Friday against the Hawks.
4278129.s: Ayton is getting the start with Anthony Davis (ankle) unavailable, and he'll be joined in the first unit by Trae Young, Kyshawn George, AJ Dybantsa and Alex Sarr. In Ayton's previous start this season, he finished with four points, six rebounds and two assists over 25 minutes.

4278129.h: Ayton won't start Wednesday's game against the Hawks.
4278129.s: With Alex Sarr (knee) back in the lineup, Ayton will retreat to the second unit. The veteran center has averaged 5.7 points and 4.3 rebounds in 14.3 minutes per game across six outings off the bench this season.

4278355.h: Toppin (back) is available for Wednesday's game against the Grizzlies.
4278355.s: Toppin has missed the last three games due to a back injury, though he will return Wednesday against Memphis. As a result, Larry Nance will presumably see fewer minutes. 4278355.h: Toppin (back) is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Grizzlies.
4278355.s: Toppin was available for emergency purposes Monday against the Hawks, so he figures to have a good chance of playing Wednesday. The Pacers should update his status closer to tipoff.

4278355.h: Toppin (back) will dress for Monday's game against the Hawks but will only play in an emergency, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.
4278355.s: Toppin has missed the last two games while dealing with a lumbar strain, and the only reason he's dressing Monday is in the event of an emergency, as the Pacers are down to eight active players (including Toppin). Jay Huff, Kelly Oubre, Kobe Brown, Jarace Walker and Jalen Slawson will be tasked with eating up minutes in the frontcourt with Toppin, Ivica Zubac (ankle) and Larry Nance (illness) sidelined.

4278355.h: Toppin (back) is questionable for Monday's game against Atlanta.

4397886.h: Bassey (knee) is available for Monday's game against the Nuggets.
4397886.s: Bassey will play in his second consecutive contest after sitting out the first two outings of the season for Golden State. He posted 10 points (4-4 FG, 2-3 FT), seven rebounds and two blocks in just 13 minutes during Saturday's loss to Phoenix, and he should see limited minutes again with Draymond Green (back) returning to the lineup.

4397886.h: Bassey is probable for Monday's game against the Nuggets due to right patellar tendinopathy.
4397886.s: Bassey has been dealing with a right knee issue for some time, but he is likely to make a second straight appearance. The big man played well during Saturday's loss to the Suns, logging 10 points (4-4 FG, 2-3 FT), seven rebounds and two blocks in just 13 minutes.

4397886.h: Bassey (knee) is available for Saturday's game against the Suns.
4397886.s: Bassey will return to action after missing the first two games of the regular season due to right patellar tendinopathy. The Warriors will be shorthanded in the second leg of this back-to-back set, so the big man will likely see significant minutes.

4398207.h: Slawson will come off the bench in Wednesday's game against the Grizzlies.
4398207.s: Pascal Siakam is back after resting Monday, so Slawson will head back to the second unit. As a reserve this season, Slawson is averaging 2.7 points and 3.0 rebounds per game.

4398207.h: Slawson will start in Monday's game against the Hawks, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.
4398207.s: Slawson will enter the starting lineup for the first time this season with Indiana dressing just eight players.

4398207.h: Slawson registered two points (2-2 FT), one rebound, one assist, one block and one steal in 12 minutes during Wednesday's 114-109 loss to the 76ers.
4398207.s: Slawson played double-digit minutes for the second time this season, providing serviceable defensive contributions. Indiana is without both Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring) and Ivica Zubac (ankle), meaning there are minutes up for grabs. Should Slawson manage to carve out a 20-minute per-night role for himself, he could make sense as a defensive streamer, even in standard formats.

4398207.h: Slawson signed a two-way contract with the Pacers on Tuesday, per Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com.
4398207.s: Indiana extended Slawson a qualifying offer in June, and the two sides have officially reached an agreement on a new deal. Preparing for his second season with the Pacers, the 2023 second-rounder figures to spend most of his time with the G League's Noblesville Boom in 2026-27.

4398390.h: Pickett and the Clippers agreed to a two-way contract Wednesday, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.
4398390.s: The Nuggets declined their team option for Pickett on June 29, but he lands in a pretty good spot with the Clippers in the early stages of a rebuild. Pickett figures to get plenty of G League reps to open the 2026-27 campaign.

4411057.h: McCullar signed a two-way contract with the Raptors on Thursday, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.
4411057.s: McCullar quickly found a new home after being waived by the Knicks in late October. The forward is expected to play a prominent role for Toronto's G League affiliate.

4411057.h: The Knicks plan to waive McCullar on Friday, per Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com.
4411057.s: Previously a two-way player for New York, McCullar is now searching for another opportunity ahead of the upcoming G League season. Dalton Knecht is taking McCullar's place on the roster.

4411057.h: McCullar (coach's decision) won't play in Thursday's preseason game against the Wizards but is in line to suit up for Monday's preseason matchup with Minnesota, Stefan Bondy of The New York Post reports.
4411057.s: McCullar will join Ochai Agbaji, Drew Eubanks and Tony Bradley on the sidelines, though all of them are expected to play Monday. The two-way player is once again expected to spend most of his time with the G League's Westchester Knicks in 2026-27.

4411057.h: McCullar agreed to a two-way contract with the Knicks on Sunday.
4411057.s: McCullar has seen most of his action in the G League since being drafted in 2024. However, the 24-year-old has some experience at the NBA level, averaging 2.2 points and 1.4 rebounds over 7.4 minutes per contest in 25 regular-season games for the Knicks.

4431671.h: McDaniels agreed to a one-year, $40 million extension with the Timberwolves on Monday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
4431671.s: McDaniels will now be under contract with Minnesota through the 2029-30 season, earning $124 million over the life of his deal. The 26-year-old forward could see an uptick in usage this season with Julius Randle no longer around, and he'll be a reliable source of stocks, making him an attractive draft-day target.

4431671.h: McDaniels (rest) is expected to play in Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Heat.
4431671.s: McDaniels and most of the Timberwolves' projected regular-season rotation sat out Friday's preseason finale, though he should be back in the lineup Wednesday. The 26-year-old forward is coming off the best year of his career in 2025-26, averaging 14.8 points, 4.2 rebounds, 2.7 assists, 1.1 steals and 1.0 blocks across 31.7 minutes per contest in 73 regular-season appearances.

4431671.h: McDaniels (rest) won't play in Friday's preseason game against the Bulls, Alan Horton of the Timberwolves Radio Network reports.
4431671.s: McDaniels will join several other key Timberwolves players on the inactive list Friday. However, he should be good to go by Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Heat.

4431675.h: Watford (ankle) is out for Wednesday's game against the Nets.
4431675.s: Watford continues to nurse a right ankle sprain. The forward lacks a concrete timetable for a return to the floor.

4431675.h: Watford (ankle) is out for Monday's game versus the Warriors.
4431675.s: Watford presumably picked up a right ankle sprain in Sunday's loss to the Clippers. His timeline for a return is uncertain. In his absence, DeAndre Jordan could re-enter the rotation, given Yves Missi (knee) remains out indefinitely.

4431675.h: Watford agreed to a one-year deal with the Pelicans on Monday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
4431675.s: The 76ers declined Watford's team option in June, but he's found a new home ahead of training camp. In New Orleans, Watford will likely provide some emergency depth in the frontcourt, and he may have a tough time carving out a consistent role.

4431679.h: Achiuwa left Tuesday's 107-100 loss to the Magic with a left lower leg contusion and did not return, Matt George of ABC 10 Sacramento reports.
4431679.s: With Achiuwa exiting the game after 14 minutes, more minutes became available for Dylan Cardwell. If Achiuwa needs to miss Friday's game against the Trail Blazers, Keegan Murray would likely return to the starting lineup, and Cardwell would have the chance for some extended run.

4431679.h: Achiuwa (ankle) is available for Wednesday's game against the Lakers.
4431679.s: Achiuwa was previously listed as probable for the Kings, but he will push through his ankle soreness Wednesday. He's off to a great start this season with averages of 11.6 points, 6.6 rebounds, 1.3 assists, 1.9 steals and 1.0 blocks over 28.6 minutes per contest.

4431679.h: Achiuwa (ankle) is listed as probable for Wednesday's game against the Lakers.
4431679.s: Achiuwa is currently bothered by left ankle soreness, though it doesn't appear as if it will be enough to keep him off the floor against Los Angeles. The 27-year-old has played well in his seven regular-season appearances in 2026-27, averaging 11.6 points and 1.9 steals, both career highs, along with 6.6 rebounds, 1.3 assists and 1.0 blocks over 28.6 minutes per contest. However, the potential return of Dylan…

4431679.h: Achiuwa is in the starting lineup for Sunday's game against the Grizzlies, Frankie Cartoscelli of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.
4431679.s: With Keegan Murray (ankle) out, Achiuwa will start at power forward alongside Domantas Sabonis in the frontcourt. Achiuwa has enjoyed an excellent start to the season, averaging 14.5 points, 5.5 rebounds and 2.0 steals per game in two appearances off the bench.

4431679.h: Achiuwa is not in the starting lineup for Friday's preseason game against the Spurs, Tristi Rodriguez of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.
4431679.s: Achiuwa was deemed available for Friday's preseason finale after tweaking his ankle in Tuesday's 110-98 preseason loss to Portland. However, he won't be starting, as Sacramento will deploy Keegan Murray and Domantas Sabonis in the frontcourt.

4431680.h: Okongwu (throat) returned to Saturday's game against Brooklyn.
4431680.s: Okongwu took an inadvertent shot to the throat from Julius Randle early in the first quarter. He was deemed questionable to return, though he is back on the floor after getting checked out in the locker room.

4431680.h: Okongwu went back to the locker room after getting elbowed in the face during Saturday's game against the Nets, Lauren L. Williams of The Atlanta Journal-Constitution reports.
4431680.s: Okongwu took an elbow to the face on the first play of the game, and he was down on the ground for a bit before making his way back to the locker room. For now, he should be considered questionable to return.

4431680.h: Okongwu (rest) will play in Friday's preseason finale against the Mavericks, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
4431680.s: Okongwu and most of Atlanta's regulars rested Monday against the Thunder but will return to action for the final exhibition. It's unclear how many minutes Okongwu will play Friday, but he should be a full go for the regular-season opener.

4431680.h: Okongwu (rest) is out for Monday's preseason game against the Thunder, per Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network.
4431680.s: Okongwu is getting the night off Monday, with Atlanta resting a number of starters. His next chance to play arrives Friday against Dallas.

4431684.h: Jackson-Davis is questionable for Wednesday's game against Boston with an illness.
4431684.s: Toronto is likely to re-evaluate Jackson-Davis at some point closer to tipoff Wednesday. Jakob Poeltl would likely handle a larger share of the center minutes if Jackson-Davis isn't feeling well enough to play.

4431684.h: Jackson-Davis will not start Monday's game against the Clippers, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.
4431684.s: Jackson-Davis will slide back to the bench with Collin Murray-Boyles starting at center in place of the injured Jakob Poeltl (shoulder). Jackson-Davis played just nine minutes during Sunday's 131-125 loss and finished with five points (2-3 FG, 1-1 FT), five rebounds and two steals.

4431684.h: Jackson-Davis will start at center in Sunday's game against the Lakers, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports.
4431684.s: Jackson-Davis will earn his first start of the season due to Jakob Poeltl being a late scratch due to a shoulder injury. Collin Murray-Boyles will likely see an uptick in minutes off the bench as well.

4431684.h: Jackson-Davis won't start Wednesday's meeting with the Bulls.
4431684.s: Jackson-Davis will come off the bench after getting the spot start in Friday's preseason finale. The big man is expected to begin the regular season as Toronto's third-string center and isn't guaranteed to see meaningful playing time.

4431684.h: Jackson-Davis will start in Friday's preseason game against Detroit, Josh Lewenberg of TSN.ca reports.
4431684.s: Jackson-Davis will start to close out the preseason. The 26-year-old most recently appeared in Tuesday's 148-98 preseason victory over New York, amassing nine points, three rebounds, one steal and two blocks over nine minutes of action.

4431687.h: Williams (groin) said he will play Friday against Boston, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.
4431687.s: Williams was listed as questionable on the official injury report, but he went through shootaround with no setbacks and has the green light to suit up. He's yet to see the floor this season and is not guaranteed minutes, to be clear.

4431687.h: Williams (adductor) is questionable for Friday's game in Boston.
4431687.s: Williams is looking to be available for his season debut Friday. The forward could test out the issue prior to Friday's contest before Chicago clarifies his status.

4431687.h: Williams (adductor) won't play in Wednesday's game against the Knicks, Joel Lorenzi of The Athletic reports.
4431687.s: Williams continues to battle left adductor soreness. His next opportunity to make his season debut arrives Friday, when the Bulls square off with the Celtics in Boston.

4431687.h: Williams (groin) is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Knicks.
4431687.s: Williams is in danger of missing his third straight game Wednesday. However, even when healthy, he was not in the rotation.

4431687.h: Williams (groin) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Celtics.
4431687.s: Williams is in line for a second straight absence due to right groin/adductor soreness. He's yet to appear in a game this season for Chicago even when healthy.

4431690.h: Nnaji (coach's decision) did not play in Thursday's 96-84 loss to Oklahoma City.
4431690.s: Nnaji was left out of Denver's rotation, with the team using Marvin Bagley and Trevon Brazile off the bench. With both players ahead of him in the frontcourt pecking order, Nnaji appears unlikely to provide consistent fantasy production without a change in his role.

4431695.h: The Suns claimed Timme off waivers Monday, per Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com.
4431695.s: After being let go by Minnesota on Saturday, Timme didn't go through waivers unclaimed. With Mark Williams (shoulder) likely out through the All-Star break, Timme helps reinforce Phoenix's depth at center.

4431695.h: Timme was waived by the Timberwolves on Saturday.
4431695.s: Timme had 18 points, seven rebounds, three assists and one steal over 27 minutes in Friday's 133-116 preseason loss to the Bulls. Despite the strong showing, he couldn't land a spot with the Timberwolves. The 23-year-old has appeared in 36 regular-season games for the Nets and Lakers throughout his career, averaging 5.6 points, 2.7 rebounds and 1.2 assists over 13.6 minutes per contest. Timme could find work in the…

4431695.h: Timme signed a training camp contract with the Timberwolves on Friday, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.
4431695.s: Timme was a two-way player for the Lakers in 2025-26, though Los Angeles declined to tender him a qualifying offer this offseason. He'll now compete for a spot on Minnesota's regular-season roster. The big man appeared in 27 regular-season games (one start) last season, averaging 3.4 points, 1.2 rebounds and 0.9 assists in 8.7 minutes per tilt.

4431714.h: Wilson agreed to a two-way deal with the Hawks on Monday, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.
4431714.s: A second-round pick of the Nets in 2023, Wilson will move on to a new organization after three seasons in Brooklyn. He was an occasional member of the Brooklyn rotation in 2025-26, averaging 6.4 points, 2.1 rebounds and 1.0 three-pointers in 15.9 minutes per game over 54 appearances. As one of Atlanta's three two-way players, Wilson will be little more than a depth option at forward and could end up seeing most of…

4431736.h: Camara should continue to play a major role following Portland's trade for Ja Morant, according to Robert Ohman of Willamette Week.
4431736.s: The Trail Blazers have been reluctant to include Camara in trade discussions because of his defensive value, and he'll remain an important complementary piece alongside Ja Morant, Damian Lillard and Deni Avdija. Camara's fantasy value should continue to be driven primarily by steals, rebounds and hustle stats in general.

4431767.h: Braun (left calf contusion/illness) is available for Monday's game against the Rockets.
4431767.s: Braun was questionable to suit up with a calf contusion and an illness, but he'll shake off both and likely start Monday's contest. He's averaging 13.5 points, 3.9 rebounds, 2.1 assists, 2.0 steals and 1.8 three-pointers in 34.3 minutes across eight outings in 2026-27.

4431767.h: Braun (left calf contusion/illness) has been upgraded to probable for Monday's matchup against the Rockets.
4431767.s: Braun is dealing with both a calf contusion and an illness, but his probable designation indicates neither issue is expected to prevent him from playing. The versatile wing should remain an important part of Denver's perimeter rotation, contributing across multiple statistical categories. His final status will be worth confirming before tipoff.

4431767.h: Braun (calf/illness) is listed as questionable for Monday's game against Houston.
4431767.s: Braun is under the weather and dealing with a left calf contusion. Nikola Jokic (elbow), Jamal Murray (shin), Aaron Gordon (lower body), Cameron Johnson (lower body) and DeMar DeRozan (back) are all listed as questionable as well, so the Nuggets could be shorthanded Monday. If Braun is ruled out, Spencer Jones, Cam Whitmore and Bryce Hopkins would be candidates for increased minutes.

4431767.h: Braun said Monday that increasing both his three-point volume and efficiency was his biggest developmental focus during the offseason, Ryan Blackburn of MileHighSports.com reports.
4431767.s: "Shoot more. Make more. Don't hesitate to shoot, just let it go," Braun said. The 25-year-old connected on just 30.1 percent of his three-pointers across 44 regular-season appearances in 2025-26 after shooting 39.7 percent from deep the previous season. A return to form from beyond the arc would help Braun provide more reliable floor spacing alongside Nikola Jokic and Jamal Murray.

4431767.h: Braun appears cemented as a starter for the Nuggets in 2026-27 after Peyton Watson was traded to Cleveland.
4431767.s: Despite playing a career-low 44 regular-season games, Braun was a full-time starter last year and should be locked into a similar role this season. The swingman is searching for a bounce-back campaign, closing last regular season with averages of 12.0 points, 4.8 rebounds and 2.7 assists in 31.8 minutes per game.

4431785.h: Pippen (back) remains out for Wednesday's game against Denver, Michael Wallace of the Grizzlies' official site reports.
4431785.s: With Pippen set to miss another game, Memphis will continue to operate without one of its backcourt reserves. He has now been sidelined for six straight contests due to the back issue and can be considered week-to-week until Memphis offers an update on his recovery. Cam Spencer remains worth streaming in most fantasy leagues.

4431785.h: Pippen (back) won't play in Monday's game versus the Raptors.
4431785.s: It will be a fifth consecutive absence for Pippen, who has been sidelined by back soreness. His next opportunity to play will come Wednesday against Denver. In the meantime, Cam Spencer is in line for more minutes.

4431785.h: Pippen (back) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Oklahoma City.
4431785.s: Pippen is set for his fourth consecutive absence while dealing with a back issue. His next opportunity to return will arrive Monday in Toronto.

4431785.h: Pippen (back) won't play Wednesday against the Pacers.
4431785.s: This will be Pippen's third straight game on the sidelines, which should continue resulting in more minutes for Cam Spencer. Pippen's next chance to play will come Friday against the Thunder.

4431785.h: Pippen (back) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Pelicans.
4431785.s: Pippen will miss a second consecutive contest due to lower-back soreness, with his next chance to suit up coming Wednesday against Indiana. Cam Spencer will likely see increased playing time off the bench with the 25-year-old sidelined.

4431823.h: McBride isn't listed in the starting five for Thursday's preseason matchup with Toronto.
4431823.s: New York will have four of its usual starting five in the first unit Thursday, pushing McBride to the bench. Mohamed Diawara will get the starting nod alongside Jalen Brunson, Mikal Bridges, OG Anunoby and Karl-Anthony Towns.

4431823.h: McBride is starting Tuesday's preseason game against the Raptors, Jared Schwartz of the New York Post reports.
4431823.s: Typically the Knicks' sixth man, McBride is getting a chance to start Tuesday's exhibition. He could see significant run in the first unit.

4431823.h: McBride once again expressed his desire to remain in New York moving forward, James L. Edwards III of The Athletic reports.
4431823.s: McBride is entering the final season of a three-year, $13 million contract. While the 25-year-old stated Wednesday that he would like to end his career with the organization, that may not be possible, considering Knicks' owner James Dolan is not willing to go into the second apron. McBride has appeared in 277 regular-season games since being drafted in the second round of the 2021 NBA Draft, averaging 7.1 points,…

4431893.h: Battle (back) is expected to make his preseason debut Thursday against the Knicks, Michael Grange of Sportsnet.ca reports.
4431893.s: Battle has yet to suit up this preseason while dealing with a back issue, but he appears to be nearing a return. Thursday's contest should give the Raptors an opportunity to evaluate the forward before the regular season, though it's unclear whether he'll face any minutes restrictions in his first appearance.

4431893.h: Battle (undisclosed) has been ruled out for Tuesday's preseason matchup with the Knicks, Vivek Jacob of the Raptors' official site reports.
4431893.s: It's unclear exactly why Battle isn't playing Tuesday, though it's worth noting he previously dealt with a lower-back issue this preseason. His penultimate chance to play before the regular season will come Thursday against New York.

4431893.h: Battle (lower back) isn't listed on the injury report for Saturday's preseason game against the Clippers, Esfandiar Baraheni of The Athletic reports.
4431893.s: Battle missed the preseason opener last weekend but returned to practice this past week and is slated to suit up Saturday. He's made 120 regular-season appearances over the past two seasons, but his path to playing time this year is muddled after the additions of Kawhi Leonard and Allen Graves.

4431893.h: Battle (lower back) was a limited participant in Monday's practice, Esfandiar Baraheni of The Athletic reports.
4431893.s: The severity of the lower-back issue is unclear, though it kept Battle out of last Saturday's preseason-opening loss to the Heat. He'll look to continue making progress in practices ahead of Saturday's preseason matchup with the Clippers.

4431893.h: Battle (back) has been ruled out for Saturday's preseason game against the Heat, Josh Lewenberg of TSN.ca reports.
4431893.s: Battle was held out of Thursday's scrimmage due to a lower-back injury, and he'll remain sidelined for Toronto's preseason opener. His next chance to play in the preseason will come next Saturday against the Clippers.

4431941.h: Dennis (Achilles) has been ruled out for Saturday's Summer League game against the Wizards, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
4431941.s: Dennis will miss a third consecutive contest due to a right Achilles issue. He appeared in just one Las Vegas Summer League game, posting 10 points, three assists, three steals and two rebounds in 16 minutes during the July 9 win over the Spurs.

4431941.h: Dennis (Achilles) is out for Thursday's Summer League game against the Grizzlies, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
4431941.s: Dennis is nursing a right Achilles issue and will miss another Summer League matchup as a result. He'll have another opportunity to return to the hardwood over the weekend, though it wouldn't be a surprise to see the Hawks hold him out as a precaution.

4432107.h: Sasser (hip) is not listed on the injury report for Friday's exhibition versus the Hawks.
4432107.s: Sasser missed Dallas' first three preseason games, but he'll be out there for the Mavericks' final exhibition. He had been generating some buzz at training camp before going down with the hip injury, so it'll be interesting to see what his role looks like Friday evening.

4432107.h: Sasser (groin) is expected to play in Friday's preseason finale against Atlanta, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.
4432107.s: Coach Dusty May indicated Thursday that he anticipates Sasser returning after dealing with left adductor tightness. The guard's expected availability should give Dallas another backcourt option for its final exhibition, though it's unclear whether he'll face any minutes restrictions.

4432107.h: Sasser (adductor) has been ruled out for Wednesday's preseason game against New Orleans, Grant Afseth of DallasHoopsJournal.com reports.
4432107.s: Sasser has yet to appear in a preseason game due to left adductor tightness. His next chance to play will come Friday against Atlanta.

4432107.h: Sasser (adductor) won't play in Sunday's preseason game against the Rockets, Grant Afseth of DallasHoopsJournal.com reports.
4432107.s: Sasser will miss a second straight exhibition game due to left adductor soreness. It's unclear when he'll be cleared to play again, but Sasser has three more chances to suit up during the preseason beginning with Wednesday's game against the Pelicans.

4432107.h: Sasser won't play in Friday's preseason game against the Rockets due to left adductor soreness.
4432107.s: Sasser is competing for a bench role ahead of the 2026-27 season, and he's showing early on why he deserves a spot in the rotation, though missing time won't help his cause. Sasser averaged 5.2 points, 1.0 rebounds and 2.0 assists in 38 regular-season appearances a season ago in Detroit before joining Dallas in June as part of a six-team trade.

4432165.h: Suggs (knee) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Kings.
4432165.s: The 25-year-old floor general hasn't played since Oct. 25 due to a right knee bone bruise, though he's "progressing positively" and has returned to on-court activity, according to Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel. The Magic said that Suggs' return will depend on how his knee responds to increased on-court activities, so he can be considered week-to-week until the the team provides another update on his progress.

4432165.h: Suggs has been diagnosed with a mild bone bruise in his right knee and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
4432165.s: Suggs suffered the injury during Sunday's win over the Knicks when his right knee buckled following a layup attempt. Fortunately, further testing revealed no major structural damage, though the 25-year-old will miss at least two weeks before being re-evaluated. Anthony Black and Jase Richardson could see increased opportunities in Orlando's backcourt during Suggs' absence.

4432165.h: Suggs (knee) did not return to Sunday's game against the Knicks.
4432165.s: Suggs exited the game late in the fourth quarter due to a non-contact right knee injury and was unable to return. He concluded the contest with four points (2-8 FG, 0-3 3Pt), six rebounds, six assists and three steals in 33 minutes. Initial reports postgame suggest that Suggs will undergo an MRI in the coming days to determine the extent of the injury.

4432165.h: Suggs went down with an apparent right knee injury during Sunday's game against the Knicks and needed to be helped to the locker room, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
4432165.s: Suggs couldn't put much pressure at all on his right leg as he was helped back to the locker room, so for now, he should be considered doubtful to return. Anthony Black will likely be elevated to a starting role if Suggs needs to miss time, and there will be more minutes available for Jase Richardson.

4432165.h: Suggs (illness) is available for Tuesday's preseason game against the Cavaliers, Dan Savage of the Magic's official site reports.
4432165.s: Suggs missed the Magic's first two preseason games while under the weather, though he'll return to action Tuesday. With the 25-year-old floor general back in action, Jase Richardson will likely shift to the second unit.

4432170.h: Jackson (groin) has been cleared to play Tuesday against Phoenix, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.
4432170.s: Jackson was unable to suit up for Sunday's game against the Pelicans due to a groin injury, but he'll be back in the mix for Tuesday's action. The Kentucky product is averaging 8.6 points, 6.1 rebounds, 2.3 assists and 1.4 steals through eight appearances this season but has recently lost hold of his place in the first unit, paving the way for Brook Lopez to make three straight starts.

4432170.h: Jackson (groin) won't suit up for Sunday's game against the Pelicans, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.
4432170.s: Jackson played through the groin issue in Wednesday's 117-116 loss to the Heat but logged a season-low 13 minutes, suggesting the injury was bothering him. For now, Jackson should be considered questionable for Tuesday's game in Phoenix. Baba Miller will serve as the backup center with Jackson sidelined Sunday.

4432170.h: Jackson (groin) is available for Wednesday's game against the Heat, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.
4432170.s: Jackson was a late addition to the injury report Wednesday, though he'll ditch his questionable tag and suit up. The big man posted 19 points, eight rebounds and two assists across 26 minutes off the bench in Monday's loss to Toronto, and he'll continue operating with the second unit Wednesday.

4432170.h: Jackson is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Heat with left groin soreness, per Law Murray of The Athletic.
4432170.s: Jackson is a late addition to the injury report, which is a bad sign for his chances of playing Wednesday. If Jackson is ultimately downgraded to out, Brook Lopez would likely remain in the starting lineup.

4432170.h: Jackson won't start Monday's game against the Raptors, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.
4432170.s: Jackson will slide to the second unit in favor of Brook Lopez. Through six regular-season games, Jackson is averaging 8.0 points, 6.2 rebounds, 2.3 assists, 1.7 steals and 1.0 blocks in 21.5 minutes per tilt.

4432171.h: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
4432171.s: Moody has been limited to individual court work, but team sources indicate he's ahead of Jimmy Butler (knee) in the rehabilitation process and is expected to return before the veteran forward. The 24-year-old still has several recovery checkpoints to complete, and Golden State has not established an official timetable. His eventual return would help replenish a Warriors wing rotation that will open the season…

4432171.h: Moody has progressed to light on-court activities as he continues his recovery from a ruptured left patellar tendon, Evan Webeck of The Mercury News reports.
4432171.s: Moody suffered the injury March 23 and underwent season-ending surgery four days later. The 24-year-old had been targeting September to resume running and on-court work, so his latest progress appears to keep his rehabilitation on track, though he remains without a firm timetable for his return to game action.

4432181.h: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

4432185.s: The Grizzlies cut Peavy loose while he tended to an ankle injury during training camp, but it didn't take particularly long for the forward to find another home. Peavy is replacing Otega Oweh (Achilles), who was waived earlier Friday, on the Thunder's roster.

4432185.s: Peavy missed a third consecutive contest due to an ankle injury. His final chance to play in the preseason will come next Friday against Charlotte.

4432194.h: Sharpe (shoulder) will play in Monday's preseason game against the Wizards, Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.
4432194.s: Sharpe will return to action after sitting out Thursday's exhibition. With two more preseason contests, Sharpe continues to sit atop the center depth chart.

4432194.s: Sharpe ended the 2025-26 campaign as the team's starting center, and he's entering his first full NBA season with the expectation of tackling a larger workload. "I feel like I played against starters last year as well. Sometimes, when I would come in the game, they…

4432241.h: Shead will start Friday against the Bucks, Esfandiar Baraheni of The Athletic reports.
4432241.s: Shead will get his first start of the season with Immanuel Quickley (hamstring) unavailable. As a starter during the 2025-26 regular season, Shead averaged 11.5 points, 7.5 assists, 1.8 triples, 1.3 steals and just 1.6 turnovers per contest on 41/40/84 shooting splits.

4432241.s: Shead sat out Friday's preseason finale but isn't dealing with an injury ahead of the regular-season opener. He's expected to operate as Immanuel Quickley's primary backup in 2026-27.

4432241.s: Toronto's regulars are getting the night off to rest up before Wednesday's season opener against the Bulls. Shead is expected to play a backup point guard role to begin the campaign.

4432241.s: The Raptors have now secured their backup point guard through the 2029-30 season. Last regular season, Shead averaged 6.6 points, 5.4 assists and 1.7 rebounds in 22.6 minutes per game across 82 outings (12 starts). He's poised for a similar role in 2026-27.

4432247.h: Clark will come off the bench in Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Heat.
4432247.s: Clark started in the Timberwolves preseason finale with Anthony Edwards (rest) taking the night off, but Edwards is back and starting on Opening Night. As a reserve last season, Clark averaged 4.0 points in 12.8 minutes per game.

4432247.s: Clark will draw his second preseason start with all of Minnesota's regulars resting. He'll be joined by Zyon Pullin, Terrence Shannon, Cody Williams and Joan Beringer.

4432247.s: Jaden McDaniels (rest) and Jonathan Kuminga (rest) are out, so Clark will be thrust into the starting unit for Saturday's exhibition. Clark earned one start last season and finished with eight points, three rebounds, two assists, two triples and one block over 30 minutes.

4432247.s: Clark currently provides depth at shooting guard and small forward, but Kuminga's expected starting role might push Ayo Dosunmu into a more prominent reserve role while occupying substantial minutes at the forward spots. Clark's defensive ability should keep him in consideration for situational minutes, though he's unlikely to enter the season with a significant fantasy role.

4432446.h: Walker (knee) is available for Saturday's game versus the Hornets, Chris Hine of The Philly Inquirer reports.
4432446.s: Walker missed the last three games but will return for Saturday's meeting with Charlotte. The 24-year-old has averaged just 6.3 minutes this season. However, with LeBron James (rest), Dominick Barlow (back) and Joel Embiid (foot) sidelined, Walker might see a little more action.

4432446.s: Walker will miss a second consecutive contest due to left knee soreness. According to Ky Carlin of USA Today, the 24-year-old forward didn't practice Tuesday but was able to go through individual on-court workouts. His next chance to play will come Friday against New York.

4432446.h: Walker has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Pistons due to left knee soreness.
4432446.s: It was reported after Saturday's win over the Bucks that Walker exited the contest early due to a right knee injury, though he's now listed on the injury report with left knee soreness. With the 24-year-old sidelined, Dean Wade and Kentavious Caldwell-Pope may see increased minutes, while Justin Edwards could enter the rotation.

4432573.h: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
4432573.s: Banchero left during Friday's loss against the Timberwolves due to an ankle injury, and follow-up tests have confirmed a high-ankle sprain for the fifth-year forward. With an extended absence expected, the Magic will have to rely more heavily on Franz Wagner and Desmond Bane offensively, and Tristan da Silva figures to be the top candidate to enter the Magic's starting lineup for as long as Banchero is sidelined.

4432573.h: Banchero is doubtful to return to Friday's game against the Timberwolves due to a sore right ankle, NBA reporter Marc Stein reports.
4432573.s: The Magic are currently down by 20-plus points with four minutes to go in the fourth quarter, so that may be impacting Orlando's decision to hold Banchero out of the remainder of the game. For now, Banchero should be considered questionable for Sunday's game in New York.

4432573.h: Banchero (ankle) has checked back into Friday's game against the Timberwolves, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.
4432573.s: Banchero tweaked his ankle coming down from a rebound, but after getting checked up in the locker room, he's been cleared to return. He's off to a hot start, scoring 14 points on eight shots in his first 23 minutes of play.

4432573.h: Banchero exited Friday's game against the Timberwolves and went to the locker room after appearing to have tweaked his ankle, Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com reports.
4432573.s: Banchero appeared to tweak his ankle when he and Jalen Suggs went crashing in for a rebound early in the third quarter, and the former departed straight to the locker room. Losing Banchero would be huge for Orlando, as he scored 14 points on 6-for-7 shooting before leaving. If he doesn't return, Tristan da Silva could be in line for a bigger role in the frontcourt.

4432573.h: Banchero drew praise from teammate Wendell Carter on Monday for the work he put in during the offseason, with Carter saying the star forward is "looking like young Paolo," Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.
4432573.s: Carter described Banchero as "very springy" and "very bouncy" after seeing him work out this summer, an encouraging assessment of his conditioning and athleticism heading into training camp. 4432582.h: Christie (hip) is listed as available for Friday's game against Utah.

4432582.s: The swingman is primed to end a one-game absence Friday due to a hip injury. 4432639.h: Smith remained a key contributor for Houston, providing frontcourt size, floor spacing and defensive versatility throughout the 2025-26 season.
4432639.s: Smith's ability to complement both Kevin Durant and Alperen Sengun gives him an important role on a team with championship aspirations. After an otherwise quiet offseason, Smith is expected to retain a prominent place in Houston's starting lineup entering 2026-27.

4432737.s: Bradley started Friday's preseason finale, though he'll slide to the second unit Wednesday. The rookie guard faces plenty of competition for minutes and isn't expected to see meaningful playing time to begin the regular season.

4432737.s: Bradley will get the start in his second appearance of the preseason. He most recently logged 12 minutes in Tuesday's 148-98 preseason win over the Knicks, finishing with three points, three rebounds and two assists.

4432823.h: Williams (back) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against the Trail Blazers.

4432823.h: Williams (back) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game against the Cavaliers.
4432823.s: Williams is battling lower-back spasms, so his availability for Wednesday's meeting with Cleveland is in jeopardy. 4432847.h: Shannon (hip) is not listed on the injury report ahead of Sunday's game against the Jazz.
4432847.s: Shannon missed the last three games because of a hip injury, though he will return for the meeting with the Jazz. With Shannon back on the floor, it could mean fewer minutes for Jaylen Clark, Cody Williams and Trey…

4432847.s: Shannon is in danger of missing a third straight game while tending to a bruised left hip. He'll presumably need to prove his health during shootaround and warmups to gain clearance to play Friday night.

4432847.s: Shannon was unable to shake his questionable tag for this contest. He's having an excellent season off the bench for Minnesota, and his absence opens the door for players such as Bones Hyland, Isaiah Evans and Jaylen Clark.

4432847.h: Shannon (hip) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game in Houston.

4432848.h: Jaquez (rest) is available for Friday's preseason game against the Pacers.

4432848.h: Jaquez (rest) won't play Wednesday against the Bulls, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.
4432848.s: The Bucks are set to rest a number of key players for this exhibition. Jaquez's last chance for preseason reps comes Friday against the Pacers.

4432907.h: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.
4432907.s: The forward underwent surgery Wednesday to address a fractured foot, and the Wizards hope Champagnie will be ready to return around the All-Star break in February.
