4848625.h: The Bulls recalled Swain (back) from the G League's Windy City Bulls on Sunday.
4848625.s: Swain has already been ruled out for the parent club's game against the 76ers on Sunday due to a back issue. The rookie forward's next chance to play for Chicago will come Wednesday against the Spurs.

4848625.h: Swain has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the 76ers due to right disc irritation.
4848625.s: Swain hasn't made much of an impact while making just two brief appearances at the NBA level, but his absence will take away from the Bulls' frontcourt depth. His next opportunity to play will come Wednesday against the Spurs.

4848625.h: The Bulls assigned Swain to the G League's Windy City Bulls on Thursday.
4848625.s: With just two brief appearances to his name at the NBA level, this is a move designed to get the rookie some needed reps. He remains miles off the fantasy radar.

4848625.h: Swain (back) isn't listed on the injury report for Monday's game against the 76ers.
4848625.s: Swain was a late addition to the injury report Friday before being ruled out against the Celtics due to lower-back soreness. While he'll be available, the rookie isn't guaranteed minutes, having made only one 12-minute appearance over Chicago's first six games.

4869342.h: Daniels (rest) will play in Friday's preseason finale against the Mavericks, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
4869342.s: Daniels and most of Atlanta's regulars rested Monday against the Thunder but will return to action for the final exhibition. It's unclear how many minutes Daniels will play Friday, but he should be a full go for the regular-season opener.

4869342.h: Daniels (rest) has been ruled out for Monday's preseason game against the Thunder, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
4869342.s: Daniels and most of Atlanta's regulars will rest during the Hawks' penultimate preseason contest. Daniels tallied 13 points (6-16 FG, 1-3 3Pt), 11 rebounds, an assist and a steal across 21 minutes in Thursday's 123-116 preseason win over the Spurs but struggled with his shot against the Pacers on Saturday.

4869342.h: Hawks president of basketball operations Onsi Saleh called Daniels "one of the most impactful players in the NBA" and an "all-world defender" while expressing confidence that his shooting will improve, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
4869342.s: Daniels remained highly productive across the board in 2025-26, averaging 11.9 points, 6.8 rebounds, 5.9 assists and 2.0 steals in 33.2 minutes across 76 regular-season appearances, but he connected on just 18.8 percent of his 1.5 three-point attempts per game. Despite the lack of perimeter shooting, Daniels shot 51.7 percent overall and earned a spot on the All-Defensive Second Team. Atlanta's continued confidence…

4869780.h: The Pelicans exercised their third-year team option on Queen's contract Tuesday, Terry Kimble of SI.com reports.
4869780.s: The No. 13 overall pick in the 2025 NBA Draft is now officially under contract for the 2027-28 season. The big man averaged 11.7 points, 7.1 rebounds, 3.7 assists and 1.9 combined steals-plus-blocks across 25.0 minutes per tilt in 81 regular-season appearances (48 starts) in his rookie season. Queen is expected to compete for minutes with Yves Missi and Karlo Matkovic in 2026-27.

4869780.h: Queen impressed during his rookie campaign despite missing time early in the season due to a wrist injury, flashing the versatile offensive skills that made him a lottery pick.
4869780.s: Queen posted several standout performances, including the first 30-point triple-double by a rookie center in NBA history. Queen should compete for an even larger frontcourt role in 2026-27 as one of New Orleans' top young building blocks.

4870562.h: Head coach Nick Nurse said Wednesday that Barlow (back) likely needs another 10-to-12 days before he's cleared to return to the court, Derek Bodner of AllPHLY.com reports.
4870562.s: Nurse added that the team is "pretty positive" that Barlow's back is getting better, though he'll still need more time before being cleared. The big man has yet to make his season debut due to a lumbar spine bone stress response, and he isn't expected to return until mid-November at the earliest.

4870562.h: Barlow (back) won't play in Wednesday's game against the Pistons, Austin Krell of OnPattison.com reports.
4870562.s: The 76ers were due to re-evaluate Barlow on Tuesday, but the big man remains in recovery mode ahead of Wednesday's action. Until the team updates his return timeline, Barlow can be considered week-to-week.

4870562.h: Barlow (back) has been on the court "a little bit" and will be re-evaluated Tuesday, Austin Krell of OnPattison.com reports.
4870562.s: The Sixers are hoping for positive news so they can progress Barlow's workouts. The big man has yet to make his season debut due to a lumbar spine bone stress response.

4870562.h: Barlow will miss at least the next two weeks due to a lumbar spine bone stress response, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.
4870562.s: The back issue cost Barlow the entire preseason, and now he'll begin the regular season on the sidelines. The earliest we could see Barlow back on the court would be Nov. 2, but it wouldn't be shocking to see his absence extend beyond that two-week window.

4870562.h: Barlow (back) did not participate in Monday's practice, according to 76ers reporter Paul Hudrick.
4870562.s: Barlow wasn't able to make any appearances during the preseason and remains without a timetable to return. The 76ers will release an injury report Monday evening ahead of Opening Night against the Knicks on Tuesday.

4870564.h: The Nets assigned Jefferson to the G League's Long Island Nets on Monday.
4870564.s: Jefferson will head to Brooklyn's G League affiliate to receive additional developmental opportunities after seeing limited action at the NBA level. The rookie forward could move between Brooklyn and Long Island throughout the season but remains off the fantasy radar in standard leagues.

4870564.h: Jefferson (back) is available for Wednesday's game against Charlotte, Sharif Phillips-Keaton of USA Today reports.
4870564.s: After missing the entire preseason, Jefferson practiced in full Monday and has the green light to return. He projects as an emergency depth option to open the season.

4870564.h: Jefferson (back) has yet to fully participate in team activities and remains without a timetable for his return, Erik Slater of ClutchPoints.com reports.
4870564.s: Coach Jordi Fernandez confirmed Friday that the rookie is still dealing with back stiffness and isn't ready to return, although Jefferson has participated in portions of team activities and has been doing conditioning work. Fernandez was also unable to confirm whether Jefferson has undergone imaging. With Brooklyn's regular-season opener against Charlotte scheduled for Wednesday, it's safe to rule him out.

4870564.h: Jefferson (back) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game versus the Heat, per Erik Slater of ClutchPoints.com.
4870564.s: The rookie first-rounder will now have been sidelined for the entire preseason with a back injury, costing him valuable reps this fall. His status is up in the air for Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Hornets.

4870564.h: Jefferson (back) is out for Monday's preseason game against the Wizards, Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.
4870564.s: Jefferson will be sidelined for his third straight exhibition. The rookie forward will have one more chance to return during the preseason, which comes against the Heat on Oct. 14.

4871141.h: Hukporti has been diagnosed with a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
4871141.s: Hukporti went down with an Achilles injury in Monday's preseason opener against the Knicks, and an MRI has since revealed a rupture. He signed a one-year deal with the 76ers over the summer, so Hukporti will be an unrestricted free agent come season's end. With Hukporti's year already finished, Adem Bona (foot) should assume the backup center role behind Joel Embiid.

4871141.h: Hukporti was helped to the locker room during the first quarter of Monday's preseason game against the Knicks after suffering an apparent right lower leg injury, Kristian Winfield of the New York Daily News reports.
4871141.s: Hukporti appeared to grab at his lower leg or ankle after taking a tumble, and he needed the assistance of his teammates to make it down the tunnel. It seems unlikely that he'll return to Monday's exhibition after he was unable to put much weight on his injured leg.

4871141.h: Hukporti will start in Monday's preseason game against the Knicks.
4871141.s: Hukporti is getting the start with Joel Embiid (rest) sitting this one out, but he'll return to a reserve role once the regular season gets underway. Hukporti is not expected to be a consistent part of the 76ers' rotation.

4871144.h: Sengun (back) has been removed from the injury report ahead of Saturday's meeting with the Thunder.
4871144.s: Sengun is set to return after a two-game stint on the sidelines, likely prompting Clint Capela to head back to the second unit. Sengun has gotten off to a hot start this season, averaging 24.5 points, 9.0 rebounds, 7.0 assists, 1.5 triples and 1.8 steals per game.

4871144.h: Sengun (back) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Mavericks, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.
4871144.s: Sengun will miss a second consecutive contest due to lower-back soreness, opening up additional minutes in the frontcourt for Tari Eason and Clint Capela. Sengun's next chance to play will come Saturday against the Thunder in the second leg of this back-to-back set.

4871144.h: Sengun (back) is questionable for Friday's game against the Mavericks.
4871144.s: Sengun has a chance to return from a one-game absence with a back issue. If the star big man indeed gets back in the lineup, less playing time will be available for Tari Eason and Clint Capela.

4871144.h: Sengun (back) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Bucks.
4871144.s: Sengun is dealing with lower-back soreness and will miss his first game of the season, with his next chance to play coming Friday at Dallas. Tari Eason and Clint Capela are both candidates to see increased playing time in Sengun's stead.

4871145.h: Giddey (wrist) is available for Friday's game against the Bucks.
4871145.s: Giddey was previously listed as probable due to a left wrist sprain, but he'll be able to suit up for the first half of Chicago's back-to-back set. The injury reportedly affected his shooting during Wednesday's season opener against Toronto, when he managed just two points on 1-for-10 shooting. His availability is encouraging, though the wrist issue could continue to affect his offensive efficiency.

4871145.h: Giddey (wrist) is probable for Friday's game against the Bucks.
4871145.s: Giddey is expected to suit up for the first half of this back-to-back set. The star guard will be looking to right the ship after scoring just two points during Wednesday's blowout loss in Toronto. Giddey is coming off a career year in 2025-26 and should be able to get back on track. However, the veteran point guard is dealing with a lingering left wrist injury that happened in the first preseason game, per K.C.…

4871145.h: Giddey (ankle) will be a full participant at training camp, Joel Lorenzi of The Athletic reports.
4871145.s: After undergoing ankle surgery in the spring, Giddey will have no restrictions at camp this fall. The star guard is primed for another big season as the Bulls' go-to playmaker, fresh off recording a career-high 17.0 points, 9.1 assists and 8.3 rebounds per game for Chicago in 2025-26.

4873090.h: Philon (coach's decision) didn't play during Tuesday's 106-100 victory over the Knicks.
4873090.s: There was some hope the rookie first-rounder would open the season as Tyrese Maxey's backup at point guard, but Anfernee Simons took on that role in the opener. Philon's fantasy value appears to be more pronounced in dynasty leagues.

4873090.h: Philon faces plenty of competition for minutes and an uncertain role heading into his rookie campaign, per Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com.
4873090.s: Selected with the No. 22 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft, Philon will likely have to impress to take on a steady role after the 76ers added Jaylen Brown, LeBron James, Anfernee Simons, Dean Wade and Kentavious Caldwell-Pope (finger) this offseason. Philon will need to prove he can be effective off the ball to see meaningful burn on a nightly basis during his rookie season, as the 76ers have plenty of…

4873090.h: Philon (rest) won't play in Saturday's Summer League game against the Bucks, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.
4873090.s: Philon will take a seat for the 76ers' Summer League finale. The rookie first-rounder scored at least 15 points in all four of his Las Vegas Summer League appearances, during which he averaged 18.5 points, 5.8 assists, 3.5 rebounds and 1.5 steals in 32.0 minutes per contest.

4873138.h: The Jazz have exercised Bailey's $9.98 million rookie-scale team option for the 2027-28 season, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.
4873138.s: The move keeps Bailey under contract with Utah through the 2027-28 campaign as the franchise continues investing in the young forward's development. The fifth overall pick in the 2025 NBA Draft remains an important part of the Jazz's long-term plans, and the decision has no immediate impact on his fantasy outlook for the current season.

4873138.h: Bailey is in the starting lineup for Friday's game against the Pelicans.
4873138.s: Bailey was productive coming off the bench in Wednesday's loss to the Grizzlies, posting 12 points (5-11 FG, 2-5 3Pt), five rebounds, three assists and three blocks in 24 minutes. He's moving to a first-unit role, sending Jaxson Hayes to the bench. In 61 starts in the 2025-26 season, Bailey averaged 15.3 points, 4.4 rebounds and 1.9 assists per contest.

4873138.h: Bailey will come off the bench in Monday's exhibition against the Spurs, Jazz digital reporter Eric Spyropoulos reports.
4873138.s: Lauri Markkanen (neck) is back after a one-game stint on the sidelines, so Bailey will return to a reserve role. In his previous game off the bench this preseason, Bailey finished with 10 points, four rebounds, one steal and one block over 16 minutes.

4873138.h: Bailey will start in Tuesday's preseason game against the Nuggets.
4873138.s: Bailey will get the start with Lauri Markkanen (neck) unavailable, and he'll be joined in the first unit by Keyonte George, Darryn Peterson, Jaren Jackson and Jaxson Hayes. It'll be interesting to see what Bailey's usage rate looks like in the first unit.

4873138.h: Bailey's (back) role is undetermined heading into the 2026-27 campaign.
4873138.s: The addition of No. 2 overall pick Darryn Peterson may leave Bailey without a spot in Utah's starting lineup to begin the new year. The Jazz are also getting Keyonte George and Lauri Markkanen back in the lineup after the two stars sat out the final stretch of a losing season in 2025-26. Bailey began to blossom late last year, averaging 18.3 points, 4.9 rebounds, 2.0 assists and 1.1 blocks per game in 23…

4873153.h: Johnson (leg) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Pacers.
4873153.s: Johnson will miss his first game of the 2026-27 campaign after tallying four points, nine rebounds and one assist in 19 minutes in the first half of a back-to-back set Sunday against Brooklyn. His absence could open up more minutes for Santi Aldama and Moussa Cisse behind starting center Daniel Gafford.

4873153.h: Johnson (leg) is questionable for Monday's game against Indiana.
4873153.s: The rookie forward is in jeopardy of sitting out the second leg of this back-to-back set. Naji Marshall and Zaccharie Risacher stand to benefit if Johnson is unable to suit up Monday.

4873153.h: Johnson (lower leg) is available for Saturday's game against the Spurs but will play on a minutes restriction, Ron Harrod Jr. of DLLS Sports reports.
4873153.s: Johnson will be available to play Saturday, and while he's recovered from his lower-leg injury, his minutes restriction means the Mavericks are being cautious with the rookie. Johnson has played in Dallas' first two games this season, logging 14 minutes against Houston and 17 against the Pacers while averaging 7.0 points and 4.5 rebounds per contest.

4873153.h: Johnson (shin) is listed as probable for Saturday's game against the Spurs.
4873153.s: Johnson was initially listed as questionable but is now trending in the right direction ahead of tipoff. If he's cleared to suit up, the rookie would likely see increased playing time due to the Mavericks being extremely shorthanded in the second leg of this back-to-back set.

4873153.h: Johnson (shin) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against the Spurs.
4873153.s: Johnson is in jeopardy of missing the second leg of this back-to-back set due to right shin splints. If the rookie forward is unable to suit up, Naji Marshall, P.J. Washington and Tobi Lawal would be candidates to see a bump in minutes.

4873201.h: Newell (toe) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Lakers.
4873201.s: Newell will miss a third consecutive contest due to a left great toe hyperextension. The second-year forward's absence will leave additional playing time for Luguentz Dort and Aaron Wiggins.

4873201.h: Newell (toe)  is out for Saturday's game against the Nets.
4873201.s: Newell missed Friday's game against the Wizards and will also miss Saturday's contest. Newell has a secondary role in the rotation, so his absence shouldn't matter much from a fantasy perspective. His next chance to suit up will come against the Lakers on Monday.

4873201.h: Newell (toe) is out for Friday's game against Washington.
4873201.s: Newell suffered a left big toe injury Wednesday against Washington and was unable to return. The injury will force him to miss at least one game. Newell can be considered day-to-day going forward.

4873201.h: Atlanta exercised Newell's third-year option Sunday, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
4873201.s: With Atlanta exercising the option before the Nov. 2 deadline, Newell remains under team control through the 2027-28 season. The move offers roster certainty for the young forward, though it does not directly change his expected role this season or next.

4873201.h: Newell won't start Friday's preseason finale against the Mavericks, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
4873201.s: With most of Atlanta's regulars resting, Newell drew a spot start against the Thunder on Monday. However, the Hawks are at full strength Friday, so the second-year forward will come off the bench.

4888725.h: Dunn will come off the bench in Friday's preseason finale versus Utah, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.
4888725.s: Miles Bridges (ankle) is back and starting following a two-game layoff, so Dunn will head back to the second unit. As a reserve this preseason, Dunn is averaging 3.0 points, 3.5 rebounds and 1.5 steals in 19.6 minutes per game.

4888725.h: Dunn will start in Saturday's preseason game against the Spurs, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.
4888725.s: Dunn is getting the start with Miles Bridges (ankle) unavailable for Saturday's exhibition. As a starter last season, Dunn averaged 9.3 points, 5.4 rebounds, 2.1 assists, 1.3 triples and 1.3 steals per game.

4888725.h: The Suns exercised Dunn's fourth-year option for 2027-28 on his rookie contract Thursday.
4888725.s: This was the expectation as Dunn plays out the final year of his rookie deal in 2027-28 ahead of restricted free agency the following year. He figures to be contending for a bench role with the likes of Jordan Goodwin, Haywood Highsmith, Rasheer Fleming and perhaps even rookie first-rounder Koa Peat at training camp this fall.

4888725.h: Dunn could be restricted to a reserve role next year after Phoenix acquired Miles Bridges from Charlotte this summer.
4888725.s: The Suns may have lost Grayson Allen and Royce O'Neale this offseason, but they signed sharpshooter Luke Kennard in addition to receiving Bridges in a trade with the Hornets. Dunn opened 2025-26 as a starter before being phased out of Phoenix's rotation entirely during the playoffs, ultimately averaging a pedestrian 5.8 points, 4.2 rebounds and 1.5 assists in 19.4 minutes per game over 70 appearances (16 starts)…

4895758.h: Williams will come off the bench in Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Heat.
4895758.s: Williams started for the resting Jaden McDaniels in Minnesota's preseason finale, but he'll shift to a reserve role with the main guys healthy for Opening Night. Williams could have trouble finding meaningful minutes this season while McDaniels and Jonathan Kuminga are active.

4895758.h: Williams will start Friday's preseason finale against the Bulls.
4895758.s: Williams will draw his second preseason start with all of Minnesota's regulars resting again. He'll be joined by Zyon Pullin, Terrence Shannon, Jaylen Clark and Joan Beringer.

4895758.h: Williams will start in Monday's preseason matchup with the Knicks.
4895758.s: Williams turned some heads at training camp and was singled out for praise by Anthony Edwards, so it'll be interesting to see what he can do in a starting role in Monday's exhibition. Joining him in the first unit will be LaMelo Ball, Anthony Edwards, Jaden McDaniels and Rudy Gobert.

4895758.h: The Jazz traded Williams and John Konchar to the Timberwolves on Friday in exchange for Josh Green and cash considerations, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
4895758.s: Williams will get a fresh start in Minnesota after taking a bit of a leap in his sophomore season. The 21-year-old wing played in 67 regular-season games (41 starts) last season, averaging 8.8 points, 3.0 rebounds, 2.0 assists and 0.8 steals while shooting 46.8 percent from the field in 24.3 minutes per showing. However, the Colorado product faces plenty of competition for minutes in Minnesota and isn't guaranteed…

4895758.h: Williams (illness) is in line to compete for a reserve role during training camp this fall.
4895758.s: Williams closed last season as a starter for a Jazz team that was looking ahead to 2026-27, but they should have most of their key players healthy for Opening Night and added Darryn Peterson with the No. 2 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft. Williams, who started a career-high 41 regular-season games a year ago, failed to stand out in any one particular area, averaging 8.8 points, 3.0 rebounds, 2.0 assists and 0.8…

4896372.h: Clayton signed a two-way contract with the Mavericks on Wednesday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
4896372.s: Clayton will join the Mavericks on a two-way deal after being waived by the Grizzlies on Monday. The No. 18 overall pick in the 2025 NBA Draft appeared in 69 regular-season games (six starts) between the Jazz and Grizzlies in his rookie campaign, averaging 7.8 points, 4.0 assists, 2.0 rebounds and 0.6 steals while shooting 38.4 percent from the field in 20.4 minutes per contest.

4896372.h: Memphis waived Clayton on Monday, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
4896372.s: The Grizzlies were unable to find a trade suitor for Clayton's services prior to Monday's roster deadline. The Florida product was a first-round pick last year and may not pass through waivers unclaimed.

4896372.h: Memphis is actively shopping Clayton ahead of Monday's roster deadline, with Sacramento emerging as a possible destination, NBA reporter Marc Stein reports.
4896372.s: The Grizzlies are attempting to clear roster space before the regular season, and Clayton has become a prominent trade candidate. Although the Kings have surfaced as a potential landing spot, no agreement has been reported. A move could give the second-year guard a fresh opportunity to compete for backcourt minutes, but his role would depend on his destination.

4896372.h: Clayton (knee) has been a full go at training camp, according to Grizzlies reporter Matt Infield.
4896372.s: Clayton missed the entire Summer League due to a sprained right knee, but he made no mention of it during Media Day. Clayton is competing for a roster spot in Memphis and is looking to make an impact in the preseason.

4896372.h: Clayton (knee) won't play in Sunday's Summer League title game against the Warriors, Drew Hill of The Daily Memphian reports.
4896372.s: Clayton is still dealing with a sprained right knee and will end up missing the entirety of Summer League play. The 23-year-old guard will now turn his attention to the 2026-27 campaign, and he's expected to provide backcourt depth during his second season in the Association.

4897262.h: Richard (thumb) is questionable for Wednesday's game against Houston.
4897262.s: Richard has a chance to keep his absence to a one-game minimum with a left thumb UCL tear. It sounds like the guard is opting against surgery and will play with a splint once healthy enough to suit up.

4897262.h: Richard (thumb) is deciding whether to undergo surgery or play with a splint, and the Warriors are expected to provide an update once the swelling goes down in the next week or so, Luca Evans of the San Francisco Chronicle reports.
4897262.s: Richard tore the UCL in his left thumb, presumably in Saturday's 126-119 overtime win over Orlando. He and the Warriors continue to look at treatment options for now, though it's possible he'll miss an extended period. De'Anthony Melton, Brandon Williams and Gary Payton (knee), who has been ruled out for Monday's game against New Orleans, will likely see increased burn for as long as Richard is sidelined.

4897262.h: Richard is out for Monday's game against the Pelicans due to a left thumb UCL tear.
4897262.s: Richard will miss his first game of the season due to a left thumb injury. Gary Payton and Georges Niang could see extra minutes in Richard's absence.

4897262.h: Richard will start Monday's game against the Suns, John Dickinson of 95.7 The Game San Francisco reports.
4897262.s: Richard will earn his second start of the season with Gui Santos (knee) and Brandon Williams (quadriceps) both out versus Phoenix. Richard is averaging 4.4 points, 1.6 rebounds and 1.0 assists in 16.6 minutes across seven regular-season outings in 2026-27.

4897262.h: Richard isn't in the starting lineup for Monday's game against the Nuggets, Danny Emerman of SFStandard.com reports.
4897262.s: Richard drew his first start of the season Saturday with three members of the usual starting five sidelined, but he'll rotate back to the bench for Monday's matchup. He tallied eight points and five rebounds in 20 minutes during the season opener off the bench but was held scoreless in three minutes Friday night against Memphis.

4897943.h: Knecht has agreed to a two-way contract with the Knicks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
4897943.s: Knecht lands in New York after being waived by the Lakers ahead of the regular season. The 25-year-old averaged 4.2 points and 1.4 rebounds across 10.2 minutes per game during the 2025-26 regular season, but the move gives him an opportunity to rebuild his value. He'll likely spend time developing in the G League and face an uphill battle for consistent NBA minutes, limiting his immediate fantasy appeal.

4897943.h: The Lakers waived Knecht on Monday, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
4897943.s: The writing appeared to be on the wall once head coach JJ Redick told reporters Monday that Knecht was excused from practice with an illness. A first-round pick just two years ago, Knecht shouldn't take long to catch on with another NBA club.

4897943.h: Knecht (illness) was excused from Monday's practice, per Jovan Buha of The Athletic.
4897943.s: Knecht is under the weather Monday. The 2024 first-rounder can be viewed as questionable for Wednesday's season opener against the Warriors, but he's not likely to be part of the rotation anyway.

4897943.h: Knecht won't play in Thursday's preseason game against the Kings due to a contusion, Mike Trudell of Spectrum SportsNet reports.
4897943.s: Knecht is dealing with an undisclosed contusion. His next opportunity to take the floor will come in Tuesday's preseason meeting with the Warriors.

4897943.h: Sam Amico of Hoops Wire believes Knecht is on the Lakers' roster bubble.
4897943.s: Despite LeBron James' offseason exit, Knecht still likely finds himself behind newcomers Quentin Grimes, Collin Sexton, Cameron Carr, Matisse Thybulle and Ziaire Williams on the depth chart. A different situation may be needed for Knecht to attain fantasy relevance in 2026-27.

4898371.h: Raynaud (knee) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against Orlando.
4898371.s: Raynaud is expected to be re-evaluated soon, though he can be considered week-to-week until the Kings offer an update on his status. Dylan Cardwell and Precious Achiuwa will likely continue seeing increased burn in Raynaud's absence.

4898371.h: Raynaud (knee) is progressing in his rehabilitation and will be re-evaluated in approximately two weeks, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.
4898371.s: Raynaud's absence is expected to extend into mid-November due to a right patellar subluxation. With Dylan Cardwell (calf) set to miss at least one more week, Precious Achiuwa, Jonathan Mogbo and De'Andre Hunter are candidates for increased minutes in the frontcourt.

4898371.h: Raynaud (knee) is expected to miss at least the first five or six games of the regular season, and potentially longer, Frankie Cartoscelli of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.
4898371.s: Raynaud is recovering from a right patellar subluxation and appears set to begin the campaign on the sidelines. The young center appeared in 74 games last season, helping anchor Sacramento's frontcourt while Domantas Sabonis battled injuries. With Dylan Cardwell (calf) also sidelined, the Kings will be especially dependent on Sabonis until their reserve centers return.

4898371.h: Raynaud has been diagnosed with a right patellar subluxation and will be re-evaluated in approximately two weeks, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.
4898371.s: Raynaud was taken back to the locker room in a wheelchair during Saturday's preseason loss to the Warriors, though he has seemingly avoided a serious injury. The big man will still begin the regular season on the inactive list, leaving additional minutes available for the likes of Precious Achiuwa and Dylan Cardwell (rest).

4898371.h: Raynaud suffered a right knee injury during the second quarter of Saturday's preseason game against the Warriors and will not return, Marc J. Spears of ESPN.com reports.
4898371.s: Raynaud appeared to tweak his knee after bumping into Stephen Curry, per Luca Evans of the San Francisco Chronicle. The injury was severe enough for Raynaud that he had to be taken off the floor and into the locker room in a wheelchair, and the Kings should have an update on the second-year center once he undergoes more tests on his knee. An extended absence would mean more minutes at center would be available for…

4900671.h: Mitchell (ankle) will play Wednesday against the Mavericks, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
4900671.s: With Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder) and Jalen Williams (leg) all inactive, Mitchell should start and see major minutes for Oklahoma City. As a starter last season, Mitchell averaged 14.9 points, 3.8 assists, 1.3 triples and 1.3 steals per game on 49/42/88 shooting splits.

4900671.h: Mitchell (ankle) is questionable for Wednesday's game against Dallas.
4900671.s: Mitchell came away with an ankle sprain in the aftermath of Monday's win over the Suns. With Alex Caruso (ankle) already ruled out for Wednesday, Jared McCain would be worth streaming in shallow fantasy leagues and Bennett Stirtz in deeper formats if Mitchell is sidelined.

4900671.h: Mitchell is in the starting lineup for Monday's game against the Suns, Brandon Rahbar of DailyThunder.com reports.
4900671.s: Mitchell will move to the starting lineup and could be in line for a larger role for the foreseeable future since both Jalen Williams (leg) and Cason Wallace (shoulder) are expected to miss most, if not all, of the remainder of the season. Mitchell recorded 18 points (8-14 FG, 1-2 3Pt, 1-1 FT), six rebounds, four assists and three steals in 27 minutes during Sunday's 108-101 win over the Clippers.

4900671.h: Mitchell won't start Tuesday's game against the Spurs, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
4900671.s: Mitchell got the starting nod in Thursday's preseason finale, though Cason Wallace is back in action and starting Tuesday's regular-season opener. Mitchell should play a sizable role for Oklahoma City this season after averaging 13.6 points, 3.6 assists, 3.3 rebounds and 1.2 steals in 25.8 minutes per game across 57 regular-season appearances (16 starts) in the 2025-26 campaign.

4903027.h: Coward (wrist) is available for Sunday's game against the Kings.
4903027.s: Coward sat out Friday's 111-108 win over the Warriors with a left wrist sprain, but he's back in the starting lineup after a one-game absence. He started his lone appearance this season, tallying seven points, seven rebounds, two assists and a block in 28 minutes.

4903027.h: Coward (wrist) is questionable for Sunday's game in Sacramento.
4903027.s: Coward sat out Friday's 111-108 win over the Warriors due to the wrist issue, which resulted in GG Jackson drawing the start, and Jerami Grant saw a minor bump in minutes. It will likely be more of the same if Coward gets ruled out again.

4903027.h: Coward (wrist) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Warriors.
4903027.s: Coward will miss Friday's contest due to a left wrist sprain, and his next chance to suit up will come Sunday against Sacramento. With the 23-year-old swingman sidelined, Jerami Grant, Scotty Pippen, Cam Spencer and GG Jackson are all candidates for a bump in minutes.

4903027.h: Coward is doubtful for Friday's game against the Warriors due to a left wrist sprain.
4903027.s: Coward is expected to miss Friday's contest after posting seven points, seven rebounds, two assists and one block across 28 minutes in Wednesday's season-opening win over Utah. If he's ultimately ruled out, Jerami Grant, Cam Spencer and Scotty Pippen would all be candidates to see increased playing time.

4903027.h: The Grizzlies exercised their third-year team option on Coward's contract Tuesday.
4903027.s: Coward is now officially under contract for the 2027-28 campaign after averaging 13.6 points, 5.9 rebounds and 2.8 assists in 25.8 minutes per game across 62 regular-season appearances (47 starts) in his rookie season. The 23-year-old swingman will likely begin the 2026-27 season in the Grizzlies' starting five when they host the Jazz on Wednesday.

4914336.h: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his right knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
4914336.s: It's a tough blow to the Trail Blazers' depth on the wing ahead of training camp. Sharpe, who is now likely to be sidelined until after the All-Star break, had been ticketed for a reserve role behind Toumani Camara following an injury-plagued 2025-26 campaign, which saw Sharpe average a career-high 20.8 points, 1.4 steals and 2.1 three-pointers per game over 50 regular-season appearances. The door is now open for…

4914336.h: Sharpe could face increased competition for offensive opportunities after Portland acquired Ja Morant, according to Robert Ohman of Willamette Week.
4914336.s: Sharpe has been mentioned as a potential trade candidate as the Trail Blazers reshape their roster, though he can provide a scoring punch if he stays in Portland. His long-term upside remains intriguing, but Morant's arrival may cap his usage entering 2026-27.

4917149.h: Sacramento recalled Karaban from the G League's Stockton Kings on Saturday.
4917149.s: Karaban has offered limited production across five appearances off the bench during his rookie season, so he may continue to provide depth following a short assignment to the G League team. The forward will need to make the most of any minutes he's given with the parent team, though he might continue to spend time with the Stockton affiliate, where he could see more consistent opportunities in the future.

4917149.h: Karaban was assigned to the G League's Stockton Kings on Saturday, Matt George of ABC 10 Sacramento reports.
4917149.s: Karaban hasn't made much of an impact with Sacramento, scoring just seven total points across five games, but he'll have more of an opportunity to perform and play meaningful minutes at the G League level.

4917149.h: The Kings signed Ben Simmons to a one-year deal Friday, adding another bench option who will challenge Karaban for playing time.
4917149.s: Simmons will return to The Association after sitting out the 2025-26 campaign. With the three-time All-Star in the mix, Karaban faces increased competition for playing time off the bench. Karaban, the No. 29 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft, could see increasingly steady minutes as the season progresses, though the UConn product isn't guaranteed a meaningful role early on, especially if Keegan Murray (ankle) is…

4997526.h: Dieng is in the starting lineup for Wednesday's preseason game against Chicago.
4997526.s: With several Milwaukee regulars resting, Dieng will move into the starting lineup Wednesday. In 30 regular-season appearances (20 starts) with the Bucks last season, the young forward averaged 11.0 points, 4.6 rebounds and 3.6 assists in 26.8 minutes per contest.

4997526.h: Dieng was a DNP-CD during Monday's 116-97 preseason loss to Minnesota.
4997526.s: Dieng was available but didn't see the floor in Milwaukee's first preseason contest. The 23-year-old will look to earn a role in a crowded Bucks frontcourt during the remainder of the preseason.

4997528.h: Jovic will come off the bench in Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Timberwolves, Zachary Weinberger of ClutchPoints.com reports.
4997528.s: Jovic started in Miami's preseason finale with Giannis Antetokounmpo (rest) taking a night off, but Antetokounmpo is back and starting on Opening Night. As a reserve last season, Jovic averaged 7.3 points, 3.3 rebounds and 2.2 assists per game.

4997528.h: Jovic will start in Friday's preseason finale in Orlando, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.
4997528.s: Bam Adebayo (rest) and Giannis Antetokounmpo (rest) are sitting out the preseason finale, so Jovic will draw the start and he'll be joined in the first unit by Davion Mitchell, Klay Thompson, Andrew Wiggins and Bobby Portis. In his previous start this preseason, Jovic finished with 14 points, six rebounds, three assists, two triples, two steals and one turnover across 21 minutes.

4997528.h: Jovic is not listed in the starting lineup for Wednesday's preseason game against the Nets.
4997528.s: Jovic got the start in Saturday's preseason loss to Minnesota, finishing with 16 points, six rebounds, three assists and three steals over 25 minutes. He will come off the bench once again Wednesday, though it's not known what his role will be versus Orlando on Friday.

4997528.h: Jovic is in the starting lineup for Saturday's preseason matchup with the Timberwolves, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.
4997528.s: Simone Fontecchio, Tre Donaldson, Nikola Jovic, Pelle Larsson and Nick Richards will join Jovic in the first unit for Saturday's exhibition with the regular starters all resting. In Jovic's lone start last season, he produced nine points, three rebounds, two triples, one steal and three turnovers in 23 minutes.

4997536.h: Santos (knee) will play Monday against the Pelicans.
4997536.s: As expected, Santos will suit up Monday after initially being added to the injury report as probable. He logged 12 minutes Saturday against Orlando in his first game back since Nov. 1, and while the Warriors will continue to keep a close eye on his workload, he's expected to see more run during Monday's clash, per Luca Evans of the San Francisco Chronicle.

4997536.h: Santos (knee) is listed as probable for Monday's game against New Orleans.
4997536.s: Santos' knee issue isn't anything new, so he'll be on the floor Monday, barring a setback. The 24-year-old has appeared in seven regular-season games in 2026-27, averaging 6.6 points, 3.6 rebounds and 1.1 assists over 18.9 minutes per contest.

4997536.h: Santos (knee) is active for Saturday's game against the Magic.
4997536.s: Santos missed Golden State's previous two contests due to a lingering knee issue, but he's ready to suit up after practicing Friday. His return will likely push Will Richard back to the bench, although Santos could be under a minutes restriction in his return.

4997536.h: Santos (knee) is questionable for Saturday's game versus Orlando, per Nick Friedell of The Athletic.
4997536.s: Santos is feeling better, having participated in Friday's practice. Will Richard would likely retreat back to the bench if Santos is able to suit up Saturday.

4997536.h: Santos (knee) has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Heat.
4997536.s: Santos didn't participate in Wednesday's practice and will remain sidelined for a second straight game Thursday. Will Richard and Georges Niang are candidates for increased burn in Santos' absence.

4997537.h: Vukcevic (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Detroit.
4997537.s: Vukcevic has yet to make his season debut due to a left hip impingement. The big man can be viewed as week-to-week until the Wizards provide an update on his progress.

4997537.h: Vukcevic (hip) is listed as out for Monday's game against Orlando.
4997537.s: The Wizards announced on Oct. 1 that Vukcevic would be sidelined for at least a month. However, there haven't been any definitive updates regarding when he will be able to get back on the floor. In the meantime, Deandre Ayton should see more minutes off the bench.

4997537.h: The Wizards announced Thursday that Vukcevic (hip) will be re-evaluated in four weeks.
4997537.s: Although the big man will remain a limited participant in training camp as he continues his rehab from a hip impingement, it sounds like his absence from game action will extend into the regular season. Deandre Ayton should have the backup center role all to himself until Vukcevic is cleared to return to the floor.

4997537.h: Vukcevic (knee) is unlikely to have a significant role to begin the 2026-27 season.
4997537.s: The Wizards didn't have Anthony Davis (finger) or Alex Sarr (foot) available late last year, allowing Vukcevic to make a career-high 12 starts. This time around, however, Washington boasts a revamped frontcourt that is not only set to feature Davis and Sarr, but it also includes Deandre Ayton as a new face down low. As a result, Vukcevic is likely to be hard-pressed to squeeze into the Opening Night rotation.

4997538.h: Matkovic is in the starting lineup for Thursday's game against the Kings.
4997538.s: Matkovic will make his first start of the 2026-27 campaign. DeAndre Jordan has drawn starts at center in each of the Pelicans' last two games for the injured Yves Missi (knee), but it'll be Matkovic who gets a look Thursday. He's had a limited impact off the bench through three games, averaging 5.0 points and 2.3 rebounds in 11.7 minutes.

4997538.h: Matkovic is not listed in the starting lineup for Friday's preseason game against the Wizards.
4997538.s: Matkovic started in Wednesday's 101-97 preseason victory over the Mavericks. However, he will return to the bench for the Pelicans' final exhibition before they face the Pacers on Opening Night.

5023693.h: Proctor is not listed in the starting lineup for Friday's game versus the 76ers, Serena Winters of FanDuel Sports Network Ohio reports.
5023693.s: Proctor started in Wednesday's 124-116 loss to the Thunder. While Peyton Watson (hamstring) will shift to power forward, Proctor will head back to the bench and Sam Merrill will draw a start at small forward against Philadelphia.

5023693.h: Proctor (ankle) is available for Friday's game against Philadelphia.
5023693.s: Proctor was listed as questionable for this contest, though he will avoid his second absence of the 2026-27 campaign. He started in Wednesday's 124-116 loss to the Thunder, ending with a season-high 11 points. While Proctor may head back to the bench for the meeting with the 76ers if Peyton Watson (hamstring) is available, he should still get more minutes than most off the bench.

5023693.h: Proctor (ankle) is questionable for Friday's game against the 76ers.
5023693.s: Proctor sprained his left ankle in the fourth quarter of Wednesday's 124-116 loss to the Thunder and did not return. The 22-year-old is one of several Cavaliers currently dealing with an injury, as Jaylon Tyson (ankle), Peyton Watson (hamstring) and Jarrett Allen (knee) are all banged up. If he's ruled out, Proctor's next chance to play would come Saturday against the Knicks on the second leg of Cleveland's…

5023693.h: Proctor exited to the locker room in the fourth quarter of Wednesday's game against the Thunder due to an apparent ankle injury, Ethan Sands of The Cleveland Plain Dealer reports.
5023693.s: Proctor appears unlikely to return in the final minutes of this contest after exiting to the locker room with 3:23 remaining in the fourth quarter. If he's forced to miss time, Meleek Thomas and Craig Porter would be candidates to see increased burn.

5023693.h: Proctor will start in Wednesday's game against the Thunder.
5023693.s: With Peyton Watson (hamstring) ruled out, Proctor will make his first start of the 2026-27 campaign. The 2025 No. 49 overall pick has averaged 5.5 points, 2.8 rebounds and 2.2 assists over 13.0 minutes per contest in six regular-season games.

5037871.h: The Spurs exercised the team option on Harper for the 2027-28 season, Jared Weiss of The Athletic reports.
5037871.s: Harper had a quality 2025-26 campaign, averaging 11.8 points, 3.4 rebounds and 3.9 assists over 22.6 minutes per contest in 69 regular-season games, including four starts. The 2025 No. 2 overall pick has All-Star upside, though it may take him another year or two before he gets to that point. Harper will presumably continue to come off the bench behind De'Aaron Fox and Stephon Castle in 2026-27, but he should…

5037871.h: Harper (rest) is in the starting lineup for Wednesday's preseason game against Phoenix, Tom Orsborn of the San Antonio Express-News reports.
5037871.s: Harper is back in the starting lineup after missing Monday's game for rest purposes. The young guard should see a fair amount of playing time but may have his workload limited in the exhibition.

5037871.h: Harper (rest) won't play in Monday's preseason game against Utah, per Tom Orsborn of the San Antonio Express-News.
5037871.s: Harper is joining the rest of the Spurs' regular starters on the sidelines Monday. His next chance to play comes Wednesday against the Suns.

5037873.h: Powell was recalled by the Nets on Saturday.
5037873.s: Powell was assigned to the Nets' G League affiliate Tuesday but has been recalled by Brooklyn ahead of Saturday's game against the Hawks. It remains to be seen if he'll be part of the rotation, though, as he didn't see action in Brooklyn's previous two games before being assigned to Long Island.

5037873.h: Powell has been assigned to the Nets' G League affiliate and won't play Wednesday against the Hornets, Erik Slater of ClutchPoints.com reports.
5037873.s: Powell has been out of the rotation the past two games for Brooklyn, so he'll head down to the G League to stay fresh. His next chance to play will come Saturday in Atlanta.

5037873.h: Brooklyn recalled Powell from the G League's Long Island Nets on Friday.
5037873.s: Assuming he stays with the club for the day, Powell will be available to face the Pistons on Friday. He will remain an emergency depth option for the club going forward.

5037873.h: The Nets exercised Powell's third-year team option for the 2027-28 season, Sharif Phillips-Keaton of USA Today reports Thursday.
5037873.s: Powell remains part of Brooklyn's long-term plans as the organization continues developing its young talent. The second-year wing will have additional time to establish himself at the NBA level, though the contract decision doesn't guarantee a larger rotation role. His fantasy value remains limited without consistent playing time.

5037873.h: The Nets assigned Powell to the G League's Long Island Nets on Monday.
5037873.s: Powell will continue his development with Long Island after struggling to carve out a consistent role in Brooklyn's rotation. The second-year wing could return to the NBA roster as needed, but he isn't currently positioned to provide meaningful fantasy production.

5041951.h: Thomas won't start Monday's game against the Hornets, Serena Winters of FanDuel Sports Network Ohio reports.
5041951.s: With Jarrett Allen (knee) back in the lineup, Thomas will retreat to the second unit. The rookie swingman has averaged 12.0 points, 1.8 rebounds, 1.2 assists and 1.2 steals in 21.4 minutes per contest across five appearances off the bench so far this season.

5041951.h: Thomas will start in Saturday's game against the Knicks, Serena Winters of FanDuel Sports Network Ohio reports.
5041951.s: With Cleveland missing Jaylon Tyson (ankle), Jarrett Allen (knee) and now Sam Merrill (right elbow management), Thomas will earn the second start of his young NBA career. He posted 17 points (7-16 FG, 3-9 3Pt), five rebounds, one assist and one steal across 26 minutes in his first career start against the Thunder on Nov. 2.

5041951.h: Thomas won't start Wednesday's game against the Thunder.
5041951.s: Tyrese Proctor will enter the starting five in Peyton Watson's (hamstring) absence, pushing Thomas to the second unit. The rookie second-rounder has averaged 13.0 points, 2.3 rebounds, 1.0 assists and 1.0 steals in 20.7 minutes per game across three appearances off the bench this season.

5041951.h: Thomas will start Monday's game against Oklahoma City, Serena Winters of FanDuel Sports Network Ohio reports.
5041951.s: Thomas will enter the starting five with Peyton Watson (hamstring) and Jaylon Tyson (ankle) sidelined. Thomas has offered a spark off the bench in three appearances this season, as he's managed to put up 10 or more points in each of those games.

5041951.h: Thomas (foot) is listed as available for Saturday's game against the Bucks.
5041951.s: After missing Thursday's 114-111 loss to the Hawks, Thomas will be back on the floor Saturday. The rookie has appeared in two regular-season games thus far, averaging 13.0 points, 3.0 rebounds and 1.0 steals over 20.0 minutes per contest. He has also shot an efficient 66.7 percent from downtown.

5041953.h: The Suns are shutting down Peat (rest) for the remainder of the Las Vegas Summer League, per John Gambadoro of Arizona Sports 98.7 FM.
5041953.s: Peat wraps up a promising Las Vegas Summer League run, producing at least 12 points, six rebounds and two steals in each of his three appearances. The rookie first-rounder is set to compete with the likes of Haywood Highsmith and Ryan Dunn for a reserve role with the Suns during training camp.

5041955.h: Peterson (nose) started the second quarter of Wednesday's game against the Spurs, per the broadcast.
5041955.s: Peterson took a shot to the head and exited to the locker room with a bloody nose in the first quarter. However, he returned to the bench shortly thereafter and started the second quarter.

5041955.h: Peterson exited to the locker room in the first quarter of Wednesday's game against the Spurs due to an apparent head injury, Shreyas Laddha of The Salt Lake Tribune reports.
5041955.s: The rookie guard took a shot to the head on a dunk attempt and appeared to have a bloody nose. He can be considered questionable to return until further notice.

5044385.h: Miller (groin) is available for Wednesday's regular-season opener in Toronto.
5044385.s: Miller made some noise in December last season, averaging 16.1 points, 7.9 rebounds, 1.6 triples and 0.9 blocks per contest on 58/41/67 shooting splits through the final seven games of the year. It'll be interesting to see what his role looks like in the rotation while Nic Claxton (hamstring) is out.

5044385.h: Miller is probable for Wednesday's game against the Raptors with a right adductor strain.
5044385.s: This is a new injury for Miller, though it sounds minor. The Bulls have quite a few injuries, so Miller could be in the mix for a rotation spot after a strong showing in the preseason.

5060701.h: Charlotte recalled Anderson from the G League's Greensboro Swarm on Friday.
5060701.s: With Dennis Schroder (thigh) questionable for Friday against Boston, the Hornets could be very shorthanded, considering Kon Knueppel (hamstring) is out once again. Anderson is projected to provide emergency depth in the short term.

5060701.h: The Hornets assigned Anderson to the G League's Greensboro Swarm on Thursday.
5060701.s: Anderson will have an opportunity to receive additional playing time and develop his game with Greensboro. The assignment suggests the rookie guard isn't currently part of Charlotte's regular rotation, leaving him without meaningful fantasy value in standard leagues.

5060701.h: Anderson (ankle) is available for Saturday's game against the Heat.
5060701.s: As expected, Anderson will ditch his probable tag due to a left ankle sprain. He's averaging 1.0 points, 2.0 assists and 1.5 combined steals-plus-blocks while shooting 12.5 percent from the field in 14.5 minutes per game across two regular-season outings, and he'll likely continue to back up Dennis Schroder until Coby White (calf) returns.

5060701.h: Anderson (ankle) is probable for Saturday's game against the Heat.
5060701.s: The rookie first-rounder was dealing with an ankle injury during the preseason, and he may have slightly aggravated the issue during the Hornets' 128-81 loss to the Hawks on Friday, when he played 16 minutes and finished with two points, two assists and one block. The injury doesn't appear to be a long-term concern for Anderson, and he's expected to be available for Saturday's contest.

5060701.h: Anderson (ankle) is available for Wednesday's preseason game against the Celtics.
5060701.s: Anderson has recovered from a left ankle injury. The rookie first-rounder is making his preseason debut as he battles for an Opening Night role.

5061568.h: The Spurs exercised the team option on Bryant for the 2027-28 season, Jared Weiss of The Athletic reports.
5061568.s: Bryant, the 2025 No. 14 overall pick, appeared in 71 regular-season games as a rookie in 2025-26. He got off to a slow start but demonstrated signs of growth by ending the year averaging 7.0 points and 1.9 assists in seven regular-season appearances in April. Bryant should be more productive in 2026-27, though the verdict is still out regarding just how high his ceiling can be at the professional level. The Spurs…

5061568.h: Carter (ankle) is available for Wednesday's preseason game against Phoenix, Paul Garcia of ProjectSpurs.com reports.
5061568.s: Bryant didn't play in Monday's preseason meeting with the Jazz. However, he is cleared to return Wednesday versus the Suns.

5061568.h: Bryant (ankle) won't play in Monday's preseason game against Utah, per Tom Orsborn of the San Antonio Express-News.
5061568.s: Bryant exited Saturday's preseason loss to Phoenix after rolling his right ankle in the first half and did not return, so the Spurs are giving him a day to recover Monday. His next chance to play comes Wednesday against the Suns.

5061568.h: Bryant exited Saturday's 102-98 preseason loss to Phoenix after rolling his right ankle in the first half and did not return, Jeff McDonald of the San Antonio Express-News reports.
5061568.s: Bryant suffered the injury after stepping on teammate Devin Vassell's foot and was subsequently ruled out for the remainder of the contest. However, McDonald suggested the decision was precautionary rather than indicative of a serious injury, while coach Mitch Johnson also characterized the early exit as precautionary. The second-year forward's status for Monday's preseason matchup against Utah remains uncertain,…

5061575.h: Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.
5061575.s: Knueppel missed the first eight games of the 2026-27 campaign. He returned for the 114-104 loss to Brooklyn on Wednesday, though he exited the contest after just six minutes of work and didn't return. With Knueppel out of commission for at least a month, Grayson Allen and Sion James are candidates to replace him in the starting lineup, especially with Dennis Schroder (hamstring) sidelined for a minimum of two weeks.

5061575.h: Knueppel (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against the Celtics.
5061575.s: Knueppel aggravated his left hamstring strain in his season debut Wednesday against Brooklyn. The Hornets haven't yet indicated whether the sharpshooter is facing a multi-week absence, but they'll likely proceed with caution. Grayson Allen is back in the mix as a high-end fantasy streaming option for as long as Knueppel is out.

5061575.h: Knueppel exited Wednesday's game against the Nets after experiencing soreness in his left leg, and he will not return, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
5061575.s: This is the same leg that delayed Knueppel's season debut, but for now the team is calling it a leg injury rather than specifically citing his hamstring. Still, it's concerning that he seemingly suffered a non-contact injury after just six minutes of play. For now, Knueppel should be considered questionable for Friday's meeting with the Celtics.

5061575.h: Knueppel (leg) exited to the locker room in the first quarter of Wednesday's game against the Nets, Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.
5061575.s: Knueppel was cleared to make his season debut Wednesday after dealing with a left hamstring strain. However, he limped back to the locker room midway through the opening quarter and can be considered questionable to return until more information comes to light.

5061575.h: Knueppel (hamstring) is available for Wednesday against the Nets.
5061575.s: The second-year star forward will shed his probable tag to make his long-awaited season debut. With this being his first game back, the Hornets may ease him back into action. Sion James will almost certainly move to the bench with this news.

5061589.h: Missi (knee) is out for Friday's game against Minnesota.
5061589.s: Missi has been sidelined since picking up a left knee bone bruise Oct. 23. He remains without a timetable to return and can be considered week-to-week moving forward.

5061589.h: Missi (knee) won't play in Saturday's game against Atlanta.
5061589.s: Missi sustained a bone bruise in his left knee during the 120-119 loss to Utah on Oct. 23. The 22-year-old hasn't played since, and considering he doesn't have a definitive return date, he should be considered week-to-week. Without Missi on the floor, DeAndre Jordan, Derik Queen and Karlo Matkovic could all see more action, though it appears none of them are a lock to take over the interim starting center job at the…

5061589.h: Missi has been diagnosed with a left knee bone bruise and will miss an extended period of time, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
5061589.s: Missi currently has no official timetable for his return, but he appears likely to miss significant time. Derik Queen could be elevated into a starting role while Missi is sidelined, so make sure the former is not floating around on your waiver wire. Missi doesn't offer enough upside to warrant holding onto in redraft fantasy leagues.

5061589.h: Missi (knee) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Nuggets.
5061589.s: Missi exited Friday's loss to the Jazz with what the Pelicans are now calling a left knee bone bruise. His next chance to suit up will come in Wednesday's rematch against Denver. In the meantime, Derik Queen and Karlo Matkovic are candidates to see increased playing time.

5061589.h: Missi won't return to Friday's game against the Jazz due to a left knee injury.
5061589.s: Missi needed to be helped to the locker room after colliding with Zion Williamson, and while we don't know the extent of this knee injury, getting ruled out so quickly is not encouraging. If he needs to miss time, Derik Queen and Herbert Jones would benefit.

5061603.h: Sorber (knee) is out for Wednesday's game against the Cavaliers.
5061603.s: Sorber remains in recovery mode due to knee surgery. Until the Thunder updates his timetable for a return, Sorber can be deemed week-to-week.

5061603.h: Oklahoma City exercised the third-year team option on Sorber (knee) on Sunday, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
5061603.s: Sorber has yet to appear in a game for the Thunder after the franchise selected him with the 15th overall pick in the 2025 NBA Draft. He's still without a clear timetable to return to the court and is considered week-to-week, but the injury-riddled Oklahoma City roster can use any help it can get.

5061603.h: Sorber (knee) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Mavericks.
5061603.s: Sorber is still without a firm timetable for a return to game action. He can be considered week-to-week until the Thunder provide an update on his progress.

5061603.h: Sorber (knee) is out for Monday's game versus the Suns, per Andrew Schlecht of The Athletic.
5061603.s: It appeared earlier Monday on the Thunder's injury report that Sorber was ready to make his season debut, but it was a clerical error. Sorber's return timeline remains in the dark due to offseason knee surgery.

5061603.h: Sorber (knee) is available for Monday's game against the Suns.
5061603.s: Sorber is no longer on the injury report for the Thunder. With how impressive Aday Mara has been in limited run, Sorber is unlikely to crack the rotation right away.

5081727.h: Cissoko will be in the starting lineup for Tuesday's matchup with the Thunder.
5081727.s: Cissoko will replace Scoot Henderson in the first unit Tuesday, with the former earning his first start of the season. Across 26 starts last season, Cissoko averaged 7.3 points, 3.0 rebounds and 1.3 triples per contest.

5082206.h: Burries will start Monday's game against the Timberwolves.
5082206.s: The rookie No. 10 overall pick will get the starting nod for the first time in his young NBA career, pushing Ryan Rollins to the second unit. Over six regular-season games, Burries is averaging 8.8 points, 3.7 rebounds, 1.3 assists and 0.7 steals across 15.8 minutes per tilt.

5082206.h: Burries (coach's decision) is in the starting lineup for Wednesday's preseason game against Chicago.
5082206.s: Burries was unavailable Sunday but will move into the starting lineup Wednesday with several Milwaukee regulars resting. The guard figures to open the regular season in a reserve role but should compete for significant playing time after being selected No. 10 overall in the 2026 NBA Draft.

5082206.h: Burries will not play in Sunday's preseason game against the Hornets due to a coach's decision, Justin Garcia of the Milwaukee Bucks Radio Network reports.
5082206.s: Burries played well in Milwaukee's preseason game Wednesday, logging 16 points, five rebounds, two steals and an assist in 21 minutes, but he will sit out of Sunday's matchup with the Hornets. His next opportunity to play comes Wednesday against the Bulls.

5093267.h: Murray-Boyles (illness) is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Celtics.
5093267.s: The Raptors are likely to check back in with Murray-Boyles closer to Wednesday's tipoff. Jamison Battle would handle an expanded role in the frontcourt if Murray-Boyles ends up sitting out.

5093267.h: Murray-Boyles (illness) is out for Monday's game against the Grizzlies, Esfandiar Baraheni of The Athletic reports.
5093267.s: Murray-Boyles will miss his first game of the season after falling under the weather. Scottie Barnes (groin) is also sidelined Monday, meaning Kyle Anderson, Allen Graves and Jamison Battle could all have a chance to play meaningful minutes.

5093267.h: Murray-Boyles (illness) is questionable for Monday's game versus Memphis, per Josh Lewenberg of TSN.ca.
5093267.s: Scottie Barnes (adductor) and Immanuel Quickley (hamstring) are questionable as well, so Toronto could be very shorthanded Monday. Jamison Battle would be a candidate for an expanded role if Murray-Boyles is unable to play.

5093267.h: Murray-Boyles will start Monday's game against Clippers, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.
5093267.s: Murray-Boyles will join the starting lineup due to the absence of Jakob Poeltl (shoulder). Trayce Jackson-Davis stepped in for a spot start in Poeltl's place Sunday, but it'll be Murray-Boyles who gets a chance to show what he can do Monday evening.

5093267.h: The Raptors exercised their third-year team option on Murray-Boyles' contract Tuesday, Vivek Jacob of the Raptors' official site reports.
5093267.s: Murray-Boyles is coming off a productive rookie campaign, averaging 8.5 points, 5.0 rebounds, 1.9 assists and 1.8 combined steals-plus-blocks in 21.9 minutes per game across 57 regular-season appearances (22 starts). The 2025 No. 9 overall pick is set to play a sizable role as one of the first men off Toronto's bench in 2026-27, and he'll likely step into the starting lineup if Kawhi Leonard or Jakob Poeltl miss…

5101761.h: Brown (rest) is not listed on the injury report ahead of Wednesday's meeting in New Orleans.
5101761.s: Brown rested on the second leg of a back-to-back set Sunday, but he'll be back in action for Wednesday's game. The rookie is averaging 12.9 points, 3.9 assists and 2.0 triples per game this season on 34.6 percent shooting.

5101761.h: Brown (rest) is available for Monday's game against the Knicks.
5101761.s: This is an expected update after Brown was rested Sunday for the first leg of the back-to-back set. There's been no indication of when the Nets will lift Brown's restrictions.

5101761.h: Brown (rest) is out for Sunday's game in Indiana, Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.
5101761.s: Brown will skip the first leg of this upcoming back-to-back set, but he should return for Monday's game in New York. With Brown inactive, there will be more minutes available for Nolan Traore, Terance Mann and Keon Ellis.

5101761.h: Brown (rest) isn't listed on the injury report ahead of Tuesday's game against the Celtics.
5101761.s: Brown was held out of Sunday's matchup against Indiana for rest, but he's expected back in action Tuesday night. He's come off the bench in each of his first two appearances in the NBA, logging six points against Charlotte on Wednesday followed by eight points Saturday in Cleveland.

The rookie guard's next chance to play will come Tuesday at Boston, though he's expected to continue facing restrictions for the time being.

5101845.h: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.
5101845.s: The Spurs are expected to exercise extreme caution with the big man, as Quaintance suffered a torn ACL and meniscus with Arizona State in February 2025 before appearing in only four games with Kentucky last season due to severe complications and persistent swelling. The 19-year-old underwent a cleanup procedure on his meniscus in mid-July, and the Spurs will likely want him at 100 percent before ramping him up to…

5101845.h: Quaintance underwent right knee surgery Wednesday and has no timetable for a return, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
5101845.s: The rookie center faced severe complications and persistent knee swelling last season following February 2025 ACL surgery, and a follow-up procedure was required. It remains to be seen how long he will be sidelined, but this certainly puts his status for training camp in doubt.

5104155.h: Coulibaly (hand) has been removed from the injury report ahead of Wednesday's meeting in Indiana.
5104155.s: Coulibaly is set to return from a one-game absence, which may result in fewer minutes for Will Riley. Coulibaly is averaging 7.2 points, 3.7 rebounds, 1.2 steals and 1.0 blocks per game this season.

5104155.h: Coulibaly (hand) is out for Monday's game against the Pistons.
5104155.s: Coulibaly is missing his first game of the season Monday with a hand injury. Tre Johnson and Bub Carrington both make sense as streaming options for fantasy managers in the short term.

5104155.h: Coulibaly (hand) is listed as questionable for Monday's game against Detroit.
5104155.s: Coulibaly's availability is uncertain ahead of Monday's matchup due to soreness in his hand, leaving Washington's wing rotation potentially shorthanded. If he's unable to suit up, the Wizards could turn to their remaining perimeter options for additional minutes, creating some short-term fantasy opportunities. His status should become clearer closer to tipoff.

5104155.h: Coulibaly will start in Saturday's game against Oklahoma City.
5104155.s: Coulibaly will make his first start since the 110-102 loss to Charlotte on Oct. 26. In four starts during the 2026-27 campaign, the 22-year-old has averaged 8.0 points, 4.3 rebounds and 1.8 steals over 27.3 minutes per outing.

5104155.h: Coulibaly (illness) is available for Wednesday's game against the Hawks.
5104155.s: Coulibaly is under the weather Wednesday but is giving it a go for the Wizards. Now that AJ Dybantsa's minutes restriction is lifted, Coulibaly could see less playing time going forward.

5105337.h: Brown (back) is out for Thursday's preseason game against the Hawks, Tom Orsborn of the San Antonio Express-News reports.
5105337.s: Brown is dealing with some tightness, so this sounds like a precaution. The No. 44 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft is not expected to crack the rotation on Opening Night.

5105462.h: Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
5105462.s: Saunders is still on the mend from a torn right ACL that he suffered during his final year at BYU. However, he has been cleared for on-court activities and will be allowed to practice with the Grizzlies now that he's officially signed with the team.

5105462.h: Saunders' (knee) role with Memphis remains unclear as the Grizzlies work through a roster crunch ahead of the regular season, according to Jonah Dylan of The Memphis Commercial Appeal.
5105462.s: President of basketball operations Zach Kleiman characterized the situation as "wait and see" Wednesday. Saunders was selected by Memphis in the second round of the 2026 NBA Draft but remains unsigned, leaving his immediate future uncertain as the Grizzlies sort through a logjam at the back end of their roster.

5105550.h: Jackson will come off the bench during Sunday's game against the Kings, Frankie Cartoscelli of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.
5105550.s: Jackson got the start Friday due to Cedric Coward (wrist) being out, but the former will return to a reserve role Sunday, with the latter back in action. In two appearances, Jackson is averaging 7.0 points, 6.0 rebounds and 1.0 blocks in 17.0 minutes per contest.

5105550.h: Jackson will start Friday against the Warriors, Damichael Cole of The Memphis Commercial Appeal reports.
5105550.s: Jackson is getting the start with Cedric Coward (wrist) unavailable, and he'll be joined in the first unit by Ty Jerome, Jaylen Wells, Cameron Boozer and Zach Edey. As a starter last season, Jackson averaged 16.0 points, 5.4 rebounds, 1.8 assists, 1.6 triples and 1.0 blocks per game on 50/39/77 shooting splits.

5105550.h: Jackson (ankle) is off the injury report for Wednesday's season opener against the Jazz.
5105550.s: Jackson is good to go for the start of the season after dealing with a tweaked ankle. He's battling with Taylor Hendricks and Olivier-Maxence Prosper for playing time in the frontcourt in the early going.

5105550.s: Head coach Tuomas Iisalo said that Jackson tweaked his ankle during Friday's preseason win over the Bulls, so he'll miss Friday's preseason finale and will be listed as "day-to-day." For now, he should be considered questionable for Wednesday's regular season opener against the Jazz.

5105550.h: With Cameron Boozer, Karim Lopez (undisclosed) and Jerami Grant now in the mix, Jackson faces increased competition for playing time in the 2026-27 campaign.
5105550.s: The Grizzlies are expected to focus on developing their young talent this season, though Jackson still faces plenty of competition for minutes. Memphis drafted Boozer and Lopez in June before acquiring Grant in the Ja Morant deal later that month. Jackson has flashed potential throughout his time in the NBA, which the Grizzlies rewarded this summer by exercising his $2.4 million team option. The 21-year-old's…

5105553.h: Phillips (illness) is available for Wednesday's game against Dallas.
5105553.s: Phillips will shake off his questionable tag for Wednesday's regular-season opener. However, the two-way player isn't likely to be part of the Rockets' rotation.

5105553.s: Phillips is set to begin the season with Houston after working with a training camp pact. Most of his playing time should come with the G League's Rio Grande Valley Vipers.

5105553.s: Phillips will join the Rockets for training camp and compete for a spot on the club's regular-season roster. Over 48 regular-season appearances (two starts) in 2025-26, he averaged 2.9 points in 8.9 minutes per showing.

5105555.h: Awaka (back) is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Spurs.

Awaka could have trouble improving his production now that Nic Claxton (hamstring) is cleared to suit up.

5105555.h: Awaka (knee) is questionable for Sunday's game against the 76ers.
5105555.s: Awaka missed Wednesday's 135-105 loss to the Knicks due to a sprained left MCL, and he's now in danger of missing a second consecutive outing due to the ailment. 5105555.h: Awaka (ankle) is probable for Monday's game against Philadelphia.

5105565.h: Clingan had his team option exercised by the Trail Blazers, the team announced Thursday.
5105565.s: This move locks in Clingan's roster status for the 2027-28 season. He should continue operating as Portland's starting center going forward, though veteran Robert Williams poses a significant threat to Clingan's playing time.

5105571.h: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.
5105571.s: Veesaar suffered the injury during a Sept. 15 workout, and an MRI confirmed the diagnosis. The No. 52 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft, Veesaar was expected to spend a lot of time with Atlanta's G League affiliate this season.

5105592.h: Whitmore made a strong impression on head coach David Adelman during the Nuggets' first day of training camp, standing out alongside Aaron Gordon, Ryan Blackburn of MileHighSports.com reports.
5105592.s: The 22-year-old has received plenty of praise since joining Denver on a two-way contract, and a strong camp could help him push for a spot in the rotation. Whitmore averaged 9.2 points and 2.8 rebounds in 16.9 minutes across 21 regular-season appearances for Washington last season and is looking to take advantage of a fresh start in Denver.

5105592.h: Whitmore agreed to a two-way contract with the Nuggets on Friday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
5105592.s: Whitmore, who is entering his fourth NBA season, holds career averages of 10.5 points and 3.3 rebounds across 119 games. He figures to spend a lot of team with Denver's G League affiliate, but the 2023 first-round pick does have the talent to break into the Nuggets' rotation if he finds his footing.

5105592.h: Whitmore (shoulder) was waived by the Cavaliers on Friday, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.
5105592.s: Whitmore was traded to Cleveland on Aug. 19 as part of the multi-team deal that sent Peyton Watson (hamstring) to the Cavaliers. However, Whitmore will now have to explore other opportunities if he clears waivers. The 22-year-old forward's 2025-26 campaign with the Wizards was cut short due to deep vein thrombosis in his right shoulder, and he finished the season with averages of 9.2 points and 2.8 rebounds in 16.9…

5105592.h: Whitmore (shoulder) was dealt to Cleveland on Wednesday as a part of a multi-team trade between the Cavaliers, Wizards, Nuggets and Clippers involving Peyton Watson (hamstring), Max Strus, Tre Mann and picks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
5105592.s: After being drafted by the Rockets in the first round of the 2023 NBA Draft, Whitmore will now suit up for his third NBA team. The 22-year-old had his best campaign as a rookie, when he averaged a career-high 12.3 points and 3.8 rebounds across 18.7 minutes in 47 regular-season games. Since then, his production has decreased. Whitmore will have a fresh start in Cleveland, though he is likely not close to securing a…

5105623.h: Ware (ankle) is available for Tuesday's game versus the Knicks.
5105623.s: Ware was a late addition to the injury report with an ankle sprain, and he should be able to handle a normal workload if all goes well Tuesday. The third-year big man is struggling over his last four appearances, posting four points or fewer in each game during that span.

5105623.h: Ware is questionable for Tuesday's game against the Knicks due to a left ankle sprain.
5105623.s: Ware was a late addition to the injury report, which is never a good sign, but the severity of the issue remains unclear. If the backup big man is unable to suit up, Jericho Sims, Nate Ament and Ousmane Dieng would be candidates for increased roles.

5105623.s: Ware is now officially under contract for the 2027-28 campaign after being traded to Milwaukee this past offseason. The big man has played a relatively steady role off the Bucks' bench to begin the 2026-27 season, averaging 13.0 points, 8.7 rebounds, 1.4 combined steals-plus-blocks and 0.8 assists in 19.7 minutes per game across six appearances.

5105623.h: Ware is not listed in the starting lineup for Sunday's preseason game against the Hornets, Sam Perley of the Hornets' official site reports.
5105623.s: Ware started in Wednesday's 128-126 preseason win over the Thunder, finishing with an 18-point, 12-rebound double-double. He will come off the bench Sunday, with Kyle Kuzma moving into the starting lineup for Milwaukee's preseason meeting with Charlotte.

5105623.h: Ware will start Wednesday's preseason game against the Thunder.
5105623.s: Ware came off the bench and posted a double-double during his Bucks debut, and he'll now supplant Kyle Kuzma in the starting lineup for Milwaukee's second exhibition game. Ware started 35 regular-season games for the Heat last year, averaging 12.8 points, 11.0 rebounds, 0.9 assists, 1.3 blocks and 0.8 steals per game.

5105626.h: Bilodeau (shoulder) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Indiana.
5105626.s: Bilodeau will miss a third straight game to begin the regular season due to a right shoulder sprain. The two-way player's absence shouldn't affect the rotation.

5105626.h: Bilodeau (shoulder) has been ruled out for Saturday's game in Cleveland.
5105626.s: This will be Bilodeau's second straight game off the court. His next chance to play will come Sunday against the Pacers.

5105626.s: The Nets grabbed Bliodeau in the second round of the draft earlier this summer and quickly signed the rookie to a two-way contract thereafter.
