5105626.h: Bilodeau (rest) won't play in Sunday's Summer League game against the Thunder, Erik Slater of ClutchPoints.com reports.
5105626.s: Bilodeau will be held out of the Nets' Summer League finale. In four Las Vegas Summer League games, the two-way player averaged 4.2 points and 2.8 rebounds in 19.6 minutes per showing.

5105637.h: Bona (back) is out for Tuesday's game against the Celtics.
5105637.s: Bona will miss his third consecutive matchup while nursing a cervical spine sprain. Jabari Walker should once again receive extra looks behind Joel Embiid with Bona and Dominick Barlow (back) sidelined.

5105637.h: Bona (back) is out for Sunday's game in Chicago.

5105637.s: While Bona isn't starting Friday, his absence will open up minutes behind Joel Embiid. With Dominick Barlow (back) also sidelined against Cleveland, the 76ers should need more minutes out of Jabari Walker. Tacko Fall might also see action for the first time of the 2026-27 season.

5105637.h: Bona (back) is doubtful to play in Friday's game against the Cavaliers, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.
5105637.s: Bona is dealing with a cervical spine sprain he sustained in Wednesday's 112-106 win over Detroit. Dean Wade and Jabari Walker would stand to benefit if Bona can't play in Cleveland.

5105637.s: Bona briefly remained in the game before heading back to the locker room with trainers. The big man can be considered questionable to return until more information comes to light.

5105806.h: Howard (calf) is available for Saturday's game against the Spurs.
5105806.s: Howard had been listed as probable in the latest update, so it's not surprising to see him available for this contest. He was ruled out for the first two games of the season, and it remains to be seen whether he'll get any meaningful minutes Saturday.

5105806.s: Howard was listed as doubtful, but shootaround must have gone well with the upgrade to probable. He's not guaranteed minutes in the rotation, though.

5105806.h: Howard (calf) is listed as doubtful against the Spurs on Saturday.
5105806.s: Howard is tracking toward missing each of the first three games of the regular season while tending to a right calf injury. Assuming he's ruled out, the fourth year pro's next opportunity to make his 2026-27 regular-season debut would be Monday against the Heat.

5105806.h: Howard (calf) is out for Friday's game in Indiana.
5105806.s: This will be Howard's second straight game on the sidelines. His next chance to play will come Saturday against the Spurs.

5105806.h: Howard (calf) is listed as doubtful for Friday's game against the Pacers.
5105806.s: Howard is expected to miss a second consecutive contest due to right calf tightness. His potential absence wouldn't cause any significant waves in the rotation.

5105809.h: Reed could have a hard time cracking San Antonio's Opening Night rotation.
5105809.s: Reed lines up as the Spurs' third-string center behind Victor Wembanyama and Luke Kornet in 2026-27. Jayden Quaintance's status for the start of his rookie season appears to be in serious doubt due to offseason knee surgery, but Reed is still likely to need an injury to either Wembanyama or Kornet in order to come into legitimate fantasy relevance.

5105809.h: Reed (rest) won't play in Saturday's Summer League game against the Suns, Paul Garcia of ProjectSpurs.com reports.
5105809.s: Reed will hit the inactive list for the Spurs' Summer League finale. The rookie first-rounder will finish the Las Vegas Summer League with averages of 7.7 points, 8.7 rebounds, 2.3 assists and 0.7 steals in 23.1 minutes per game across three outings.

5105837.h: Houston recalled Thornton from the G League's Rio Grande Valley Vipers on Saturday.
5105837.s: Thornton is back with the Rockets after delivering a strong display in Friday's G League game against the Austin Spurs, during which he racked up 31 points, eight rebounds and five assists. It has been more difficult for him to find playing time at the NBA level though.

5105837.h: The Rockets assigned Thornton to the G League's Rio Grande Valley Vipers on Thursday.
5105837.s: This is a move designed to get Thornton some extra live reps. He remains off the fantasy radar in most leagues.

5105839.h: Sensabaugh (hip) is not listed on the injury report for Monday's preseason game against San Antonio.
5105839.s: Sensabaugh sat out Utah's first two preseason games due to a left hip injury, but his omission from the injury report paves the way for the Ohio State product to return to action Monday. In 75 games (22 starts) last season, he averaged 14.9 points, 3.1 rebounds and 1.9 assists in 23.5 minutes per contest.

5105839.h: Sensabaugh (hip) won't play in Tuesday's preseason game against the Nuggets.
5105839.s: A left hip injury will keep Sensabaugh off the floor for the rematch with Denver. The Jazz will likely be cautious with the 22-year-old, so it's reasonable to believe he could also miss Monday's exhibition versus the Spurs.

5105839.h: Sensabaugh won't play in Sunday's preseason opener against the Nuggets due to a left hip injury, Shreyas Laddha of The Salt Lake Tribune reports.
5105839.s: Sensabaugh's absence from Sunday's exhibition seems largely precautionary. His next chance to play will come Tuesday in a rematch with the Nuggets.

5105854.h: Smith will start Monday's game against the Hawks, Dustin Dopirak of The Indianapolis Star reports.
5105854.s: The Pacers will be extremely shorthanded in the second half of this back-to-back set, opening the door for Smith to make his first career start. The two-way player has logged double-digit minutes just once this season, but the Pacers will need him to take on a heavy workload Monday.

5105977.h: Fleming (ankle) is active for Saturday's game against the Rockets.
5105977.s: Fleming will return from a two-game absence due to a sprained left ankle. His presence is not likely to have an impact on the Suns' rotation, as he's played a total of 15 minutes across five contests in 2026-27.

5105977.h: Fleming (ankle) is questionable for Saturday's game against the Rockets.
5105977.s: Fleming missed the Suns' last game and could be in line to miss a second straight contest due to a sprained left ankle. His absence shouldn't have much impact fantasy-wise, as he's averaging just 0.5 points and 1.5 rebounds in two outings off the bench this season.

5105977.h: Fleming is out for Thursday's game against the Magic due to a sprained left ankle.

5105977.h: Fleming is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Trail Blazers due to a sprained left ankle, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.
5105977.s: Fleming must have tweaked his ankle at practice because he's been out of the rotation the past two games. The Suns will update his status closer to Wednesday's tip.

5106058.h: Sharp faces increased competition for playing time after the Kings signed Ben Simmons to a one-year deal Friday.
5106058.s: Although Russell Westbrook is out of the picture now, Ben Simmons will return to The Association and figures to see a steady role in the Kings' rotation thanks to his defensive versatility and playmaking. Along with fellow rookie Alex Karaban, Sharp isn't guaranteed a meaningful role to begin his professional career. However, the No. 45 overall pick out of Houston could see increasingly steady minutes as the season…

5106060.h: Walker won't start Wednesday's game against Memphis.

5106060.h: Walker won't start Sunday's game against Brooklyn.
5106060.s: Aaron Nesmith will return to the starting lineup, pushing Walker to the bench. The 23-year-old forward is averaging 2.5 points, 3.5 rebounds and 1.5 assists in 17.5 minutes per tilt across two regular-season appearances (one start).

5106060.h: Walker will start Friday's game against the Mavericks, Grant Afseth of DallasHoopsJournal.com reports.
5106060.s: Aaron Nesmith will come off the bench in his return from a hamstring injury, opening the door for Walker to enter the first unit. He logged 19 minutes in Wednesday's season-opening win over New Orleans, recording three points, six rebounds, two assists, one block and four turnovers while shooting 1-for-6 from the field.

5106060.h: Walker (rest) is off the injury report for Wednesday's season opener against the Pelicans.
5106060.s: Walker missed the end of the preseason, likely for maintenance reasons. With Aaron Nesmith sidelined with a hamstring injury, Walker and Kelly Oubre stand out as the most likely candidates to enter the Pacers' Opening Night starting lineup.

5106258.h: Dick won't start in Wednesday's game against Miami, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.
5106258.s: Dick started in Monday's 125-118 loss to Toronto, finishing with 12 points, four rebounds, three assists and two steals. However, with Rui Hachimura (quadriceps) back in the lineup, Dick will return to the bench.

5106258.h: Dick will start Monday's game against the Raptors, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.
5106258.s: Dick will get the nod at small forward due to Derrick Jones (knee) sitting out Monday. Dick got off to a strong start this season by dropping 12 points in the opener against the Kings, but he's been held to single digits in the scoring column in five games since.

5106258.h: Dick could see increased opportunities to begin the season while Brandon Ingram recovers from a partially torn Achilles and right heel surgery.
5106258.s: Dick arrived in Los Angeles alongside Ingram in the Kawhi Leonard trade and will compete for minutes on a Clippers team currently thin on the wing. Ingram's absence gives Dick an opportunity to earn a consistent rotation role, though he'll still face competition for playing time.

5106258.h: The Clippers and Raptors mutually agreed Monday to complete the trade sending Leonard to Toronto in exchange for Brandon Ingram (heel), Gradey Dick, two unprotected first-round picks, one first-round pick swap and two second-rounders, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
5106258.s: The trade hit a snag in July when the league investigated Leonard and the Clippers for salary cap circumvention, but the deal is now official ahead of training camp. The 2023 first-rounder is searching for a fresh start in Los Angeles after averaging 6.0 points and 1.9 rebounds in 14.0 minutes per game across 76 regular-season appearances (one start) for the Raptors last year.

5106258.h: The NBA has concluded its investigation into salary cap circumvention involving Kawhi Leonard and the Clippers, and the trade sending Dick to Los Angeles is expected to be finalized in the coming days, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
5106258.s: Among other punishments, the Clippers were stripped of five first-round picks Wednesday. Furthermore, Leonard was fined $700,000 in restitution for improper benefits. 5159925.s: Topic is ready to make his season debut following offseason back surgery. His return comes at an opportune juncture for the Thunder, as Topic helps fortify the team's backcourt depth after Oklahoma City lost Jalen Williams to a serious ankle injury Sunday.

5159925.h: Topic (back) won't play in Thursday's game against the Nuggets.
5159925.s: Topic is out again Thursday, as expected. He doesn't have a definitive return date, so he should be considered week-to-week.

5160992.h: Sarr (knee) is available for Wednesday's game against the Hawks.
5160992.s: Sarr is returning Wednesday from a one-game absence due to a knee injury and should have no restrictions. His presence will send Deandre Ayton back to the bench in all likelihood.

5160992.h: Sarr (knee) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game against Atlanta.
5160992.s: Sarr is dealing with left knee soreness that could force him to miss another contest after sitting out Monday's win over Orlando. If the big man remains sidelined, Deandre Ayton could continue to handle an increased workload in Washington's frontcourt. Sarr's availability should become clearer closer to Wednesday's tipoff.

5160992.h: Sarr (knee) is out for Monday's game against Orlando.
5160992.s: Sarr was previously listed as questionable after picking up the knock Friday against the Hornets. With Sarr out of commission, the Wizards could lean more on backup center Deandre Ayton and may slide him into the first unit.

5160992.h: Sarr (knee) is questionable to play in Monday's game against the Magic.
5160992.s: Sarr seems to have picked up the knee issue after logging a season-high 29 minutes during Friday's 95-79 win over Charlotte. If he's unable to suit up in Orlando, Deandre Ayton would likely earn his first start of the season.

5160992.h: The Wizards exercised the fourth-year team option on Sarr on Sunday, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
5160992.s: Sarr was the No. 2 overall pick in the 2024 NBA Draft. Since then, he has appeared in 121 regular-season games, averaging 14.1 points, 6.8 rebounds, 2.5 assists and 1.7 blocks over 27.0 minutes per contest. Sarr seemingly has All-Star upside, though injuries have certainly slowed down his progression.

5164559.h: Ament (coach's decision) did not play in Wednesday's 128-116 loss to Washington.
5164559.s: The rookie forward was left out of Milwaukee's rotation after dealing with an ankle issue during the preseason. Although Ament was listed as probable entering the contest, the Bucks elected not to use him. His opportunities could remain inconsistent as he adjusts to the NBA.

5164559.h: Ament (ankle) is available for Wednesday's season opener against the Wizards.
5164559.s: Ament sustained a left ankle sprain in a preseason game two weeks ago, but he's recovered in time for Opening Night. Although the rookie first-rounder is a big part of the rebuilding Bucks' long-term plans, Ament is unlikely to play meaningful minutes in the early stages of 2026-27 while Milwaukee is healthy.

5164559.h: Ament is probable for Wednesday's season opener against the Wizards with a right ankle sprain.
5164559.s: The rookie forward is expected to be available for his league debut Wednesday. However, Ament doesn't appear to be in line for a considerable role.

5164559.h: Ament (ankle) didn't play in Friday's 128-127 preseason win over the Pacers in overtime.
5164559.s: Ament ended the preseason with a third straight absence due to a left ankle sprain. The rookie forward's status will be worth monitoring ahead of Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Wizards, though his absence likely wouldn't cause many waves in the rotation.

5164559.h: Ament (ankle) is out for Wednesday's preseason game against Chicago, Cameron Ezeir of CBS Milwaukee reports.
5164559.s: Ament will remain sidelined due to a left ankle sprain he sustained Oct. 7 against Oklahoma City. His availability for Friday's matchup against Indiana remains uncertain, though Milwaukee head coach Taylor Jenkins suggested the rookie should be ready for the regular season.

5170947.h: New Orleans recalled Johnson from the G League's Laketown Squadron on Sunday.
5170947.s: Johnson has recorded just three minutes of NBA play this campaign as he continues to be constantly assigned to the G League side. Still, he may have an opportunity to add backup behind the primary options Dejounte Murray and Jeremiah Fears in upcoming contests. While his value is limited in his current role, Johnson may be more active for the Squadron if he's assigned again when they open their G League season Nov.…

5170947.h: The Pelicans recalled Johnson from the G League's Laketown Squadron on Friday.
5170947.s: New Orleans has some injuries on the roster, so the team presumably recalled Johnson to add depth. However, even if he remains with the Pelicans for a limited time, he likely won't be on the floor much.

5170947.h: The Pelicans assigned Johnson to the G League's Laketown Squadron on Friday.
5170947.s: Johnson has yet to suit up for the Pelicans this season. He'll look to get some much-needed reps with the Squadron in the meantime.

5170947.h: The Pelicans declined Johnson's team option Tuesday, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.
5170947.s: As a result, Johnson is now set to become an unrestricted free agent after the 2026-27 season. A 2024 first-rounder by the Bucks, he's looking for a fresh start in New Orleans following multiple offseason trades but is unlikely to begin the year in the rotation.

5170947.h: Johnson was traded from the Grizzlies to the Pelicans on Tuesday along with Taj Gibson in exchange for Jordan Hawkins, Micah Peavy, a future second-round pick and a future second-round pick swap, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
5170947.s: Johnson is already headed to his fifth organization since being selected 23rd overall in the 2024 NBA Draft. The 21-year-old has averaged 4.9 points across 77 career regular-season appearances and remains a developmental project despite his first-round pedigree. Johnson figures to compete for a depth role in New Orleans and is unlikely to have much fantasy relevance unless injuries open up additional playing time.

5174563.h: The Wizards exercised the fourth-year team option on George on Sunday, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
5174563.s: Washington selected George 24th overall in the 2024 NBA Draft. Since then, the 22-year-old has appeared in 122 regular-season games, averaging 11.4 points, 4.6 rebounds, 3.4 assists, 1.0 steals and 0.8 blocks in 27.7 minutes per contest. Even with the Wizards' selection of AJ Dybantsa with the first overall pick in 2026, George continues to start and remains a key piece of the organization's future.

5174655.h: Johnson will come off the bench for Saturday's game against the Hawks, Erik Slater of ClutchPoints.com reports.
5174655.s: Johnson will revert back to a reserve role after starting the last four games for Brooklyn. Danny Wolf enters the first unit in place of Johnson following the former's impressive outing on Wednesday.

5174655.h: Johnson will start Friday's game against Detroit.
5174655.s: With Egor Demin (leg) unavailable, Johnson will get the starting nod for just the second time in his career. He's averaging 7.3 points, 3.5 rebounds, 1.3 assists and 0.8 steals in 20.8 minutes per contest across four regular-season outings.

5174655.h: Johnson (rest) is getting ready to reprise his role as a two-way player for Brooklyn in 2026-27.
5174655.s: Johnson signed a two-way contract with the Nets in June after occupying a two-way roster spot with the club a year ago. Such a role leaves Johnson more likely to begin the new season as a featured part of the G League's Long Island Nets as opposed to the NBA squad, unless injuries strike the parent team at some point between training camp and the regular season.

5174655.h: Johnson (rest) has been ruled out for Sunday's Summer League game versus Oklahoma City, Erik Slater of ClutchPoints.com reports.
5174655.s: Johnson will take a seat for the Nets' Summer League finale. The two-way player was productive in four Las Vegas Summer League appearances, averaging 13.0 points, 8.2 rebounds, 3.2 steals and 1.8 assists in 26.6 minutes per game.

5174983.h: Mara is not listed in the starting lineup for Tuesday's game against the Trail Blazers, Brandon Rahbar of DailyThunder.com reports.
5174983.s: Mara will head back to the bench after starting and impressing in Saturday's 114-75 victory over Washington. He tallied 18 points (8-10 FG, 1-1 3Pt, 1-2 FT), eight rebounds, three assists and three blocks in what was his second career start. 5174983.h: Mara will start Saturday against the Wizards, Rylan Stiles of SI.com reports.
5174983.s: Mara will replace Jared McCain in the first unit for Saturday's game. In his previous start this season, Mara finished with nine points, five rebounds, two assists and three blocks over 25 minutes.

5174983.s: Mara entered the starting lineup in Wednesday's win over Cleveland but will move back to the bench to begin Friday's contest. Kenrich Williams will move into the four spot as a result, while Ajay Mitchell starts at the three and Jared McCain gets the nod at the two.

5174983.h: Mara will start Wednesday against the Cavs, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
5174983.s: Mara will replace the injured Jaylin Williams (back) in the starting lineup for Wednesday's game, and it'll be Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Ajay Mitchell, Kenrich Williams and Isaiah Hartenstein rounding out the first unit Wednesday evening. Mara has been heating up over the past four games, so it'll be interesting to see what the rookie can do in his first career start. Per 36 minutes this season, Mara is averaging…

5175643.h: Demin (leg) is probable for Wednesday's game against the Pelicans, Erik Slater of ClutchPoints.com reports.

5175643.s: Brooklyn's decision keeps Demin under contract through the 2027-28 campaign as the organization continues investing in its young backcourt. Demin is currently dealing with a right leg bone bruise and is scheduled to be re-evaluated in one week.

5175643.s: Demin appears likely to miss multiple games while recovering from the injury, though Brooklyn has yet to establish a definitive timetable for his return. His absence could open additional backcourt minutes for the Nets' remaining guards. A clearer picture of his availability should emerge following next week's re-evaluation.

5175643.h: Demin (leg) stated Tuesday he isn't sure if he will be able to play in Friday's game against Detroit, Erik Slater of ClutchPoints.com reports.
5175643.s: Demin exited Tuesday's 125-124 overtime loss to the Celtics in the first half and didn't return. The 20-year-old has had a slow start to the 2026-27 campaign, averaging 7.8 points, 2.3 rebounds, 2.8 assists and 1.0 steals while shooting 28.6 percent…

5175643.s: Demin hasn't had a good night, though it got even worse after he was seen limping off the floor with 2:22 left in the first half. If the second-year guard can't return, it should mean more minutes for Mikel Brown and Keon Ellis.

5175647.s: Gonzalez started in the Celtics' last three regular-season contests. He will head back to the bench for Friday's NBA Cup meeting with the Hornets, though he should still get opportunities as a reserve.

5175647.s: The move keeps Gonzalez under contract through the 2027-28 campaign as Boston continues investing in the young wing's development. His long-term fantasy value will depend on his ability to carve out a consistent role.

5175647.h: Gonzalez will come off the bench in Saturday's preseason game against the 76ers, Sean Grande of NBC Sports Boston reports.
5175647.s: After sitting out the Celtics' preseason opener, Jayson Tatum (rest) and Paul George (rest) are back and starting, so Gonzalez will shift to a reserve role. Gonzalez averaged 3.8 points and 3.2 rebounds as a reserve last season.

5175647.s: Gonzalez is auditioning for a prominent role in the rotation, so he will need to be at his best during the preseason. 5175737.h: Lendeborg (foot) is available for Wednesday's game in Minnesota, as expected.

5203685.s: This was a no-brainer decision after Maluach was selected in the first round last year. The second-year big man could be primed to take on a significantly larger role in Phoenix's frontcourt, which has a major void due to Mark Williams' offseason shoulder injury, and the camp battle between Maluach and Oso Ighodaro for the top center spot could stretch all the way up until the end of the preseason.

5203685.h: Maluach earned significant praise from Devin Booker on Monday for the progress he's made during the offseason, Shane Young of the Suns' official site reports.
5203685.s: "I'd say he's taken the biggest leap of anyone I've seen this summer," Booker said of the second-year center. Maluach averaged just 8.9 minutes across 46 regular-season appearances as a rookie, but he followed that limited role with an impressive showing at Summer League. Booker's strong praise provides another encouraging sign that Maluach could be ready to take on a substantially larger role in Phoenix's…

5211175.h: Risacher is not listed in the starting lineup for Friday's game against Utah, Christian Clark of The Athletic reports.
5211175.s: With Max Christie (hip) unavailable for Wednesday's game in San Antonio, Risacher got the start. However, neither Christie nor Risacher will start Friday. Instead, Caleb Martin will roll with the first five.

5211175.h: Risacher will start in Wednesday's game against San Antonio.
5211175.s: Risacher will make his second start of the 2026-27 campaign Wednesday. The 21-year-old also started in the Mavericks' first meeting of the season with the Spurs on Oct. 24, finishing with 11 points, four rebounds, two assists, one steal and two blocks over 32 minutes.

5211175.s: After being traded from Atlanta to Dallas this past offseason, Risacher is now officially under contract for the 2027-28 campaign. The 2024 No. 1 overall pick is averaging 8.0 points, 6.0 rebounds, 2.0 steals, 2.0 blocks and 1.5 assists while shooting 30.8 percent from the field through four regular-season games (one start) with the Mavericks.

5211175.h: Risacher won't start Monday's game against the Heat, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.
5211175.s: With Cooper Flagg (shoulder) back from a one-game absence, Risacher will slide to the second unit. 5211175.h: Risacher will be in the starting lineup for Saturday's matchup with the Spurs.
5211175.s: Kyrie Irving (rest) and Cooper Flagg (shoulder) are out, so Risacher will draw the start, and he'll be joined in the first unit by Max Christie, Naji Marshall, P.J. Washington and Daniel Gafford. Risacher has been struggling with his shot through the first two games of the year, converting just 33.3 percent of his field-goal attempts.

5211176.h: The Hornets declined their fourth-year team option on Salaun's contract Monday, Rod Boone of The Charlotte Observer reports.
5211176.s: Salaun is set to enter unrestricted free agency following the 2026-27 campaign. He hasn't played a significant role for the Hornets early in the season, recording double-digit points just once in seven regular-season appearances.

5211176.h: Salaun said Monday that he's focused on becoming a more versatile contributor as he competes for playing time in Charlotte's rotation, Sam reports.
5211176.s: The third-year forward identified facilitating, efficient catch-and-shoot play, screening and the ability to defend all five positions as areas that could help him earn minutes. Salaun also made improving his physicality a priority during the offseason. After averaging 6.1 points and 4.7 rebounds across 62 regular-season appearances in 2025-26, he'll face increased competition for playing time in a deeper Hornets…

5211983.h: Dadiet (undisclosed) will play in Thursday's Summer League game against Golden State, James L. Edwards III of The Athletic reports.
5211983.s: Dadiet appears to have been held out as a precaution Monday and will be back in the mix for Thursday's matchup. 5214637.s: Penda was limited at the start of training camp due to a right hamstring injury, and he's now in danger of missing Wednesday's regular-season opener against Atlanta. If the 21-year-old is forced to miss time, Jamal Cain could see a slight bump in minutes.

5214637.h: Penda exited Friday's game against the Heat with a right hamstring injury and went straight to the locker room, Cody Taylor of USA Today reports.
5214637.s: Penda came up grabbing his right hamstring and trainers wasted no time getting him to the locker room for further evaluation. Penda notably dealt with the same injury at the start of training camp. His status for the rest of this game, as well as the regular-season opener against the Hawks on Oct. 21, could be in jeopardy.

5214637.h: Penda (hamstring) isn't listed on the Magic's injury report for Sunday's preseason game against Cleveland.
5214637.s: Penda missed the preseason opener after tweaking his hamstring in late September. He's been involved in recent practices, though it wouldn't be surprising to see the Magic limit his minutes during his first game back.

5214637.h: Penda (hamstring) is out for Wednesday's preseason game in Memphis, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.
5214637.s: Penda has been working his way back from a hamstring injury, and while he was able to participate in Sunday's practice, he's not quite ready for game action. His next chance to play will come Sunday in Cleveland.

5214640.h: The Bucks exercised Jakucionis' team option for the 2027-28 season Monday.
5214640.s: Jakucionis will remain until contract with Milwaukee for the 2027-28 campaign following this transaction. He's averaging 8.3 points, 2.8 rebounds and 4.0 assists in 22.5 minutes over his first six appearances of the 2026-27 regular season.

5214640.h: Jakucionis (coach's decision) is in the starting lineup for Wednesday's preseason game against Chicago.
5214640.s: Jakucionis didn't see any action Sunday against Charlotte but will move into the starting lineup Wednesday against Chicago with several Milwaukee regulars resting. In 53 regular-season appearances (12 starts) with Miami last season, the Illinois product averaged 6.2 points, 2.6 rebounds and 2.6 assists in 17.8 minutes per contest.

5214640.h: Jakucionis (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's preseason game against Charlotte, Justin Garcia of the Milwaukee Bucks Radio Network reports.
5214640.s: Jakucionis was a DNP-CD in Monday's 116-97 preseason loss to Minnesota, and he then logged 18 minutes in the two-point win over Oklahoma City on Wednesday. However, Jakucionis will take a seat once again Sunday, with his next opportunity to play being this coming Wednesday versus Chicago.

5214640.h: Jakucionis was a DNP-CD during Monday's 116-97 preseason loss to the Timberwolves.
5214640.s: Jakucionis was one of several Bucks who didn't see the floor despite Milwaukee using 14 players. 5217746.h: Hansen was assigned to the Rip City Remix on Wednesday, the Trail Blazers announced.

5231919.s: Lopez has moved between the NBA and G League frequently over the past week, as Saturday's move marks his third time being assigned to the Hustle in five days. 5231919.h: Memphis recalled Lopez from the G League's Memphis Hustle on Thursday.
5231919.s: Lopez was sent to the G League squad only for Thursday's practice before rejoining the Grizzlies. 5231919.h: Memphis recalled Lopez from the G League's Memphis Hustle on Tuesday.
5231919.s: Lopez has rejoined the parent club ahead of Wednesday's game against the Pacers following his short assignment to the G League affiliate. While his contribution could be useful in the Memphis rotation, he's likely to retain…

Even when he was healthy prior to the absence, the rookie first-rounder was not a part of the regular rotation for Memphis, and that will likely be the case again in Utah.

5231919.h: Lopez (knee) is questionable for Monday's game in Utah.
5231919.s: The rookie first-rounder has a chance to be cleared for his NBA debut Monday. However, Lopez may not see meaningful playing time even if he's available Monday.

5238230.h: Washington exercised the third-year team option on Johnson on Sunday, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

5238230.h: Johnson (Achilles) is available for Friday's game against Charlotte.
5238230.s: Johnson will shed his questionable tag due to right Achilles tightness and return from a one-game absence. The second-year guard is averaging 12.0 points, 2.0 rebounds and 1.8 triples across 22.8 minutes per contest in four regular-season outings.

5238230.h: Johnson (rest) is likely to revert to a bench role to open 2026-27 after finishing last season as a starter.
5238230.s: The Wizards are set to send out a new starting lineup this year, now headlined by veteran stars Trae Young (quad) and Anthony Davis (finger) as well as rookie No. 1 overall pick AJ Dybantsa, and they're also set to get Kyshawn George and Alex Sarr (foot) back in the fold. 5239561.s: Richardson started the last six games for Orlando, but he'll slide to the bench Saturday night with Tristan da Silva starting. Richardson is averaging 6.4 points, 1.9 rebounds, 2.5 assists and 0.8 steals in 21.9 minutes across eight contests in 2026-27.

5239561.h: Richardson is in the starting lineup for Sunday's game against the Knicks, Cody Taylor of USA Today reports.
5239561.s: Richardson will make his first start of the season Sunday due to the absence of Paolo Banchero (ankle), and the second-year guard will share the backcourt alongside Jalen Suggs, with Desmond Bane and Franz Wagner at the three and four, respectively. Richardson is averaging 4.0 points and 3.0 assists in 14.0 minutes per game in two bench appearances this season.

5239561.h: The Magic exercised Richardson's team option Wednesday, per Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel.
5239561.s: This is an expected transaction after Orlando chose Richardson in the first round of last year's draft. Richardson is cleared to play through a back injury for Opening Night, but he's unlikely to play a significant role Wednesday.

5239561.h: Richardson (back) is off the injury report for Wednesday's season opener against the Hawks.
5239561.s: Richardson is cleared to play through a back injury for Opening Night. However, he's unlikely to play a significant role Wednesday.

5239590.h: The Hornets exercised the third-year team option on McNeeley on Sunday.
5239590.s: McNeeley was the 29th overall pick in the 2025 NBA Draft. Since then, the 21-year-old has appeared in 34 regular-season games, averaging 4.0 points, 2.4 rebounds and 0.7 assists in 11.4 minutes. He has not been a factor early in the 2026-27 campaign, playing just 6.3 minutes per game across his three outings so far.

5239590.h: McNeeley is not in the starting lineup for Wednesday's preseason game against Boston.
5239590.s: McNeeley started the first two preseason games but will shift to a reserve role in Boston, making way for Royce O'Neale in the starting five. In 31 regular-season appearances as a rookie last season, McNeeley averaged 4.3 points and 2.4 rebounds in 11.9 minutes per contest.

5239590.h: McNeeley is starting Tuesday's preseason opener against the Nets.
5239590.s: McNeeley is filling in for the injured Brandon Miller (leg) on Tuesday. He's looking to carve out a meaningful Opening Night role off the Charlotte bench.

5241364.h: Stirtz will come off the bench for Tuesday's preseason matchup against Indiana, Justin Martinez of The Oklahoman reports.
5241364.s: After receiving a starting opportunity in Monday's preseason loss to Atlanta, Stirtz will return to a reserve role as Oklahoma City rolls out a more experienced starting five featuring Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Cason Wallace, Alex Caruso, Jalen Williams and Isaiah Hartenstein. The rookie's playing time could be more limited Tuesday with several of the Thunder's regulars back in the lineup.

5241364.h: Stirtz is in the starting lineup for Monday's preseason game against Atlanta, Justin Martinez of The Oklahoman reports.
5241364.s: Stirtz will make his second preseason start with several Oklahoma City guards, including Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Cason Wallace, Ajay Mitchell, and Jared McCain, resting. The rookie is averaging 17.5 points, 5.0 rebounds and 4.0 assists in 26.4 minutes per contest across two preseason appearances.

5241364.h: Stirtz won't start Wednesday's preseason game against the Bucks, Brandon Rahbar of DailyThunder.com reports.
5241364.s: With the Thunder resting most of their key players, Stirtz played a team-high 31 minutes in Tuesday's preseason loss to the Pelicans, scoring a game-high 15 points (6-9 FG, 3-6 3Pt) and adding six assists and five rebounds. However, with Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace back in action, the rookie will return to a reserve role.

5241364.h: Stirtz will start in Tuesday's preseason game against the Pelicans, Justin Martinez of The Oklahoman reports.
5241364.s: Stirtz is getting the start with Jalen Williams, Cason Wallace and Alex Caruso all sitting out Tuesday's exhibition. Stirtz played well for the Thunder at Summer League, so it'll be interesting to see what he can do against tougher competition in the preseason.

5241364.h: Stirtz will miss the final two Summer League games, Rylan Stiles of SI.com reports.
5241364.s: The No. 16 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft, Stirtz is not dealing with an injury, but the Thunder are happy with the amount of reps he's received. Through five exhibitions, he averaged 13.6 points, 3.4 assists and 1.6 rebounds.

5242496.h: Essengue (head) is available for Monday's game against Boston.
5242496.s: Essengue was held out of Saturday's clash against Washington after being diagnosed with a head contusion, but the issue won't force him to miss any additional action. He's totaled five points, four rebounds, one assist, three steals and one blocks in 27 total minutes through his first two appearances of the 2026-27 campaign.

5242496.h: Essengue (head) is listed as questionable for Monday's game against Boston.
5242496.s: Essengue was held out of Saturday's loss to the Wizards as a precaution due to a head contusion, though he's now in danger of missing a second straight game. His absence would leave additional minutes available for guys like Leonard Miller and Zach Collins.

5242496.h: Essengue (head) won't suit up for Saturday's game against the Wizards, Joel Lorenzi of The Athletic reports.
5242496.s: Head coach Tiago Splitter said he's holding Essengue out of Saturday's game as a precaution, so it doesn't sound like he'll be out long. His next chance to play will come Monday in Boston.

5242496.h: Essengue (head) has been downgraded to questionable for Saturday's game against the Wizards.
5242496.s: Essengue initially drew a probable tag due to a head contusion, though he's trending in the wrong direction ahead of the second leg of this back-to-back set. If the 19-year-old forward is ultimately ruled out, Leonard Miller and Zach Collins could see increased minutes.

5242496.h: Essengue (head) is probable for Saturday's game against the Wizards, Joel Lorenzi of The Athletic reports.
5242496.s: Essengue may have picked up the injury during Friday's 132-125 win over the Bucks, when he played 17 minutes and finished with four points, one rebound, one assist, three steals and one block. The probable tag indicates that the injury isn't considered a serious one, but that could change up until Saturday's 8:00 p.m. ET tipoff.

5242502.h: The Nets exercised Saraf's third-year team option for the 2027-28 season, Sharif Phillips-Keaton of USA Today reports Thursday.
5242502.s: Brooklyn will retain Saraf for another season as the young guard continues his development. The decision reflects the organization's commitment to evaluating its recent draft investments, though it doesn't signal any immediate change in his playing time. Saraf will need to establish a consistent rotation role before becoming a reliable fantasy contributor.

5242502.h: The Nets assigned Saraf to the G League's Long Island Nets on Monday.
5242502.s: Saraf will have an opportunity to receive more consistent playing time with Brooklyn's G League affiliate after seeing limited action early in the NBA season. The second-year guard faces considerable competition for backcourt minutes with the Nets and is unlikely to hold significant fantasy value unless his role expands.

5242502.h: Saraf (coach's decision) did not play in Wednesday's 110-103 loss to Charlotte.
5242502.s: Brooklyn opted not to use Saraf in its season opener, leaving the young guard outside the initial backcourt rotation. His playing time could remain sporadic while the Nets evaluate their other perimeter options.

5242502.h: Saraf (rest) is in line for a reserve role in 2026-27 after the Nets drafted Mikel Brown earlier this summer.
5242502.s: The 2025 first-rounder bookended his rookie campaign as a starter, but a bench role appears more likely to open this season now that Brown is in the fold and Egor Demin is healthy. Nolan Traore is recovering from offseason knee surgery but is expected to be ready for the start of training camp in the fall, so Saraf is set to battle with youngsters Traore and Drake Powell as well as veterans Keon Ellis and Terance…

5242502.h: Saraf (rest) has been ruled out for Sunday's Summer League game against the Thunder, Erik Slater of ClutchPoints.com reports.
5242502.s: Saraf is healthy but will be sidelined for the Nets' Summer League finale for rest purposes. He'll close the summer averaging 10.0 points, 3.3 assists, 2.5 rebounds and 1.2 steals in 23.9 minutes per contest across six appearances between the California Classic and Las Vegas Summer League.

5254165.h: Wagler is not in the starting lineup for Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Kings, Farbod Esnaashari of SI.com reports.
5254165.s: Wagler will come off the bench to begin his NBA career, but he should still see quality minutes with Max Strus (foot) and Bradley Beal (knee) out. The Clippers selected Wagler with the No. 5 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft, so he should be a big part of their plans this season.

5254165.h: Head coach Ty Lue said Wednesday the Clippers are going to give Wagler a lot of on-ball opportunities, per Joey Linn of SI.com.
5254165.s: With Brandon Ingram (Achilles) sidelined to begin the season, Los Angeles is already short on proven playmakers beyond Darius Garland. Bradley Beal (knee) appears ticketed for a reserve role, meaning Wagler has a chance to be the team's second scoring option behind Garland while Ingram is sidelined.

5254165.h: Wagler (rest) has been ruled out for Wednesday's Summer League game against the Wizards, Joey Linn of SI.com reports.
5254165.s: Wagler will get a break after playing in each of the Clippers' first three games of the Summer League, and his next chance to play is Friday against the Timberwolves. The No. 5 overall pick of the 2026 NBA Draft, Wagler figures to start alongside Darius Garland in the backcourt for the 2026-27 season. Wagler averaged 17.9 points, 5.0 rebounds and 4.3 assists over 33.9 minutes per game last year with Illinois.

5258459.h: Okorie registered two points (2-2 FT) across two minutes during Sunday's 106-93 victory over Philadelphia.
5258459.s: Okorie made his NBA regular-season debut Sunday, scoring his first points at the charity stripe. The rookie first-rounder is unlikely to see meaningful playing time early on unless Cade Cunningham or Daniss Jenkins miss time.

5258459.h: Okorie (coach's decision) didn't play during Tuesday's 121-113 win over the Celtics.
5258459.s: While the Pistons traded up in the draft to acquire Okorie's services earlier this year, the team doesn't look to be ready to throw the rookie first-rounder into the fire. Okorie appears to have more fantasy value in dynasty leagues.

5258459.h: Coach J.B. Bickerstaff has been impressed by Okorie so far in camp and wants the guard to continue to gain experience against NBA-caliber talent in the preseason, Coty M. Davis of The Detroit News reports.
5258459.s: Okorie hit the game-winning bucket during Monday night's preseason game against the Suns as the team continues to evaluate where the young guard will fit into the rotation. Bickerstaff has been particularly impressed by Okorie's maturity and poise, and his ability to take care of the basketball. The 19-year-old was selected by the Pistons with the No. 17 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft and is in a position to…

5279129.h: De Larrea (knee) is out for Friday's game against Utah.
5279129.s: De Larrea continues to miss time with a right knee strain, and it's not clear at this time where he's at in his rehab. He can be considered week-to-week until further notice.

5279129.h: Head coach Dusty May said Friday that de Larrea (knee) will be re-evaluated next week, Noah Weber of TheSmokingCuban.com reports.
5279129.s: De Larrea sprained his right knee in Monday's win over Miami and is without a definitive timetable for a return to action. However, his absence shouldn't cause any significant waves in the rotation.

5279129.h: De Larrea (knee) is out for Friday's game against the Rockets.
5279129.s: De Larrea remains sidelined with a knee sprain, which he suffered during Monday's win in Miami. His next chance to play comes Monday against the Kings.

5279129.h: De Larrea (knee) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Thunder.
5279129.s: De Larrea sustained a right knee sprain in Monday's win over the Heat and will be held out of Wednesday's contest. His next chance to play will come Friday against Houston. With the rookie guard sidelined, Marcus Sasser could see a slight bump in minutes.

5279129.h: De Larrea is doubtful to return to Monday's game against the Heat due to a right knee strain.
5279129.s: De Larrea suffered the injury during the second quarter while trying to corral an inbound pass. Walter Clayton could pick up a few additional minutes in the second half, assuming de Larrea doesn't return.

5279130.h: Traore (calf) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game against New Orleans.
5279130.s: Traore has played well throughout the 2026-27 campaign. He has appeared in 10 regular-season games, starting seven, and has averaged 12.9 points, 2.0 rebounds, 2.6 assists and 1.4 steals while shooting 46.2 percent from deep over 22.1 minutes per contest. The 20-year-old is now in danger of missing his first game of the season Wednesday versus New Orleans. If that happens, Mikel Brown, Keon Ellis and Terance Mann…

5279130.h: The Nets exercised Traore's team option Thursday, per Sharif Phillips-Keaton of USA Today.
5279130.s: This decision is merely a formality, with the second-year first-rounder already playing a key role for the rebuilding Nets. He's logged at least 24 minutes in back-to-back games.

5279130.h: Traore will start Tuesday's game at Boston, C.J. Holmes of the New York Daily News reports.
5279130.s: With Mikel Brown sidelined for rest purposes in Sunday's loss to the Pacers, Traore logged a season-high 25 minutes, posting 17 points, five assists, two rebounds, two blocks and a steal. The second-year guard will enter the first unit following his productive performance Sunday, pushing Keon Ellis to the bench.

5279130.h: Nets general manager Sean Marks said Sunday that Traore (knee) is healthy and ready to participate in training camp, Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.
5279130.s: Traore underwent a procedure on his right knee in June after dealing with soreness during the 2025-26 campaign, causing him to miss Summer League. The second-year guard appears to have completed his recovery on schedule and should enter camp with mild restrictions as he competes for a role in Brooklyn's crowded backcourt.

5279133.h: Beringer (nose) will play in Sunday's game against Utah, Dane Moore of 'The Dane Moore NBA Podcast' reports.
5279133.s: Beringer is dealing with a broken nose he sustained in Friday's win over New Orleans, though he'll still suit up for Sunday's contest. Through 10 regular-season outings (one start), the second-year big man is averaging 5.8 points, 6.5 rebounds and 0.8 blocks across 16.5 minutes per tilt.

5279133.h: Beringer (nose) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Jazz.
5279133.s: Beringer broke his nose during Friday's win over the Pelicans, so he might need to miss Sunday's game. If he's out, Trey Lyles would have the chance for some extended run.

5279133.h: Beringer was ruled out for the second half of Friday's game against the Pelicans due to a nasal fracture, Dane Moore of 'The Dane Moore NBA Podcast' reports.
5279133.s: Although Beringer's nasal fracture will prevent him from returning to Friday's contest, he may be able to play through the injury during future games while wearing a mask. Trey Lyles may stand to benefit from increased minutes in the meantime.

5279133.h: Beringer will not start Monday's game against the Bucks.
5279133.s: As expected, with Rudy Gobert (back) returning to the lineup Monday, Beringer will shift back to the bench.

5279133.h: Beringer will start Saturday against the Spurs, Jack Borman of Lockedon Wolves reports.
5279133.s: Beringer will draw the start with Rudy Gobert (back) out, making him an intriguing plug-and-play option in daily fantasy leagues. Beringer can struggle with foul trouble, and he'll have a tough matchup against San Antonio, but he can rack up the rebounds and defensive stats when given the opportunity.

5281370.h: Charlotte assigned Steinbach to the G League on Tuesday.
5281370.s: The rookie first-rounder is coming off back-to-back appearances for the Hornets amid Moussa Diabate's (quadriceps) absence. Steinbach still has a clearer path to action with the Greensboro Swarm.

5281370.h: The Hornets recalled Steinbach from the G League's Greensboro Swarm on Friday.
5281370.s: Additionally, the Hornets listed the rookie center as available to play Friday against Boston. He will continue to provide depth at center, and he may be more involved if Moussa Diabate (quadriceps) can't play.

5281370.h: The Hornets assigned Steinbach to the G League's Greensboro Swarm on Thursday.
5281370.s: Steinbach will spend time with Greensboro as Charlotte looks to provide the young forward with additional developmental opportunities. The assignment shouldn't significantly affect the Hornets' NBA rotation, and Steinbach remains off the fantasy radar in most redraft formats.

5281370.h: Steinbach (coach's decision) did not play in Wednesday's 110-103 win over Brooklyn.
5281370.s: The rookie big man remained on Charlotte's bench throughout the Opening Night victory. With the Hornets having other frontcourt options available, Steinbach may face an uphill battle for consistent playing time early in the season.

5289900.h: Diawara will come off the bench in Tuesday's regular-season opener against the 76ers, Kristian Winfield of the New York Daily News reports.
5289900.s: Diawara started New York's final two exhibition games with Josh Hart nursing a minor ankle injury, but Hart is back and starting for Opening Night, so Diawara will shift back to a reserve role. As a member of the second unit last season, Diawara averaged 3.2 points and 1.2 rebounds in 8.2 minutes per game.

5289900.h: Diawara is starting Thursday's preseason game against the Raptors.
5289900.s: Diawara will draw a second straight start at power forward ahead of Josh Hart in the final matchup of the preseason. Diawara finished with 13 points, three rebounds, one assist and one steal in 29 minutes in his previous appearance Tuesday, also against Toronto.

5289900.h: Diawara is starting Tuesday against Toronto, Jared Schwartz of the New York Post reports.
5289900.s: The Knicks are resting their usual starting lineup. Diawara is trying to make a case for an Opening Night role.

5289900.h: Diawara said he's completely healthy after undergoing surgery for a minor finger injury this summer, Steve Popper of Newsday reports Saturday.
5289900.s: Diawara missed the Knicks' final three Las Vegas Summer League games due to the finger injury, though he should be ready to go for Monday's preseason opener against the 76ers. The 21-year-old forward appeared in 69 regular-season games (seven starts) in his rookie season, averaging 3.6 points and 1.4 rebounds in 9.2 minutes per contest.

5289900.h: Diawara (finger) didn't play in Friday's 110-88 Summer League loss to the Mavericks.
5289900.s: The severity of the finger injury is unknown, though it kept Diawara from playing in New York's final three Las Vegas Summer League outings. Over two outings in Las Vegas this summer, he averaged 3.5 points and 5.5 rebounds in 24.7 minutes per tilt.
